It forms most of the part of Chauhar Valley (Barot Valley).The sanctuary is home to the western tragopan(monal), black bear, snow leopard and ghoral. It can be reached by the same road to Barot.

name: Narrow Gauge Railway
description: The railway platform lies in the midst of the town. The train leaves twice at early in the morning at 7AM and in noon towards Pathankot. It goes through other beautiful hill resorts namely Baijnath, Palampur and Kangra. On the way, it offers spectacular views of mighty Dhauladhar ranges which remain snow clad almost whole of the year. The ticket fare is very low as not expected. You can ride through it spending 60 bucks only and reach 163 km distant station at Pathankot.

name: Winch Camp
description: Winch Camp is situated at an altitude of 8,000 feet (2,400 m). The height of the peak is near about 8,800 feet (2,700 m). It can be reached on riding through Haulage way car or by trekking which may take 4 hours and is a bit tiring. The haulage way car reaches here nearby 10AM after leaving off at 8:30AM at the base station at Buffer stop in Shanan Power house. On the way to Winch camp there are thick forests of Rhododendron (Burans or locally known as Brah ka fool) from which people prepare delicious sauce having a great medicinal use. One needs to pack himself sufficiently with food as it is not available since no restaurant or shops are near around. One rest-house is also available for higher officials visiting Winch Camp free of cost. A govt. owned rest-house is under construction near the village of Fooladhar which is half kilometre from this site. From this place one is able to see kilometres of distance including Beas River, Mandi Hills, Kangra district and Hamirpur boundaries. In winter season there is heavy snowfall over these mountains which sometimes even scales up to 2 feet (0.61 m) or above. At this time local people, tourists, students from schools and colleges step onto these marvelous mountains for having the gorgeous pleasure of snowfall on their feet. On the other side of the mountain is Headgear, the next haulage way station at an altitude of 8,300 feet (2,500 m). This spot packs outstanding scenery of Himalayan ranges, including Dhauladhar, which are about 16,000 feet (4,900 m) or above from the sea level. From Headgear haulage way car descends the steep hill having a large gradient. This steep hill is known as ‘Khooni Ghati’ literally meaning to ‘Valley of death’ as it is locally considered dangerous. Further coming station is Katheru set up at an altitude of 7,000 feet (2,100 m) above sea level. The next short journey track is called as Zero Point at 6,050 feet (1,840 m).

name: Angling at Barot
description: Barot is a famous hotspot for fishing and is known for two most recognized breeds of fish: the trout and the rainbow which are exported to major hotels in the country. One needs to register oneself at Fishery Farm Office at Barot and apply for a valid license which is necessary otherwise angling is treated as illegal.

name: Paragliding in Dhelu and Jhatingri
description: For adventure seekers, this option should not be missed. One can fly in the air with the local paragliders who often take flights from Dhelu, 2 km from the town towards Pathankot and Dharmsala highway spending a few bucks. Dhelu is a hotspot for picnickers and those who like sightseeing near around. While the other take-off site is Jhatingri at 2100 m (6700 feet) and packs wider ranges for paragliding but you may need to manage a paraglider yourself.

name: Ride Haulage Way Car
description: With special permissions from the authority of Shanan Power House, one can ride through this one of its own kind vehicle which runs on a railway track and is bound using a metal cable wire. It rides up slowly towards the altitude at a high gradient and provides a lot of thrill and enjoyment for the riders. It takes its riders to Winch Camp at 8000 feet. Undoubtedly the journey seems to be quite thrilling and amazing.

name: Trek towards Winch Camp and Barot
description: One can trek towards Winch Camp and Barot. Starting from the Zimzima or at Buffer Stop in Shanan Power House, you can trek directly towards winch camp through local routes or along Haulage Car track. One is able to see kilometers of distance as one approaches high up in the mountains. After reaching Winch Camp one may trek further towards Barot along a railway track from Winch Camp which is now not in use.

name: Swim in Machyal Lake
description: 8 km from the town is this small but sacred lake which remains groomed with visitors throughout the year. One can enjoy swimming in the streams but remember fishing is strictly prohibited here rather they are worshiped and fed offerings. For a better swimming experience one may head towards a larger lake situated at a distance of 1.5 km towards Uhl Project III site.

name: Billing Complex
description: It is the largest shopping complex in the town. It has some of the famous brand shops for clothing, jewellery, banking and others. It is situated in Cinema road 0.2 km from the bus stand.

name: Herbal Plants
description: They can be bought from herbal garden nurseries of Herbal Garden.

name: Rishav Cafe
description: It is considered to be the most popular Chinese food restaurant and is particularly famous for momo. It is 1 km from the bus stand beside NH 20 towards Mandi.

name: Hotel Anshdeep
description: It is almost a kilometre away from the town in Dhelu beside NH 20. It too provides accommodation and good food in reasonable price tag.

name: Hotel City Heart
description: It has good facilities, such as a restaurant and parking, along with beautiful surroundings.

name: Hotel Trekkers Nest
description: It lies in a serene roadside and has a restaurant and parking facilities. The fresh trout from the river nearby is the specialty here.

name: Hotel Uhl
description: Govt. Tourism Dept. owned deluxe hotel nearby Civil Hospital beside highway towards Mandi lies Hotel Uhl which provide cheap accommodation options along with good food and a variety. It has a self owned park and good parking facilities as well. One may opt for luxury, semi luxury and economy suites.

name: Himalayan Hamlet Valley view Hotel & resort
Hotel Shobla Royale
description: Has a restaurant, bar and parking.

name: The Garsa village homestay
description: A Pahari cottage-villa. Reasonable. Beautiful surroundings. If you are planning to stay for few days or weeks, then try hiring some huts on the hills they are much cheaper, comfortable (a bit inconvenient to reach as situated few feet above the ground on the hill) then staying in hotels and you really enjoy the beauty of the hills closely. If you're looking to stay for a month or more, you'll do well to be away from the main Manali Road.

name: Indian Himalaya Homestay
description: Try a homestay experience where you are cared for by a local family - simple accommodation set high on the mountainside overlooking the beautiful Kullu Valley.

name: Ramgarh Heritage Villa
description: Located in the small town of Raison, midway between Kullu & Manali. A heritage bungalow built in 1928, during the British era, with high ceilings, spacious bedrooms and fireplaces, and surrounded by apple orchards & kiwi plantations. It is managed by the descendants of the same family that built it. Behind the home-stay is the village of Benchi, who's residents work on the orchards. The village offers a glimpse of the Himachali countryside with its by-lanes overlooking the Beas and the Dhalaudhar range.

name: Sunken Garden
description: Beginning life as a pond several hundred years ago, the sunken garden now features a stupa, clocktower, and greenspace with benches. Its defining feature is that it's about three stories below ground level and is ringed by a multi-level market.

name: Bhutnath temple
description: The temple was built by Raja Ajber Sen in 1527 AD and is dedicated to Lord Shiva

name: Triloknath temple
description: The temple was built by the queen of Raja Ajber Sen in 1520 AD. It has the three-faced Lord Shiva.

name: Gadda Gusaini
description: The valley is virgin and has not been explored by many adventure loving tourists. One finds nature at its best offering beautiful surroundings, green forests and pollution free environment. Madhopur Fort was also built by former rulers of Mandi district who had kept their arms and ammunition in it. Besides the fort was used as punishment to hardcore criminals in the state. One more fort named Tungasi was built in the valley and the remains of the fort are still visible.

name: Jhatingri
description: It is situated on Ghogar Dhar at an elevation of 2,200 m. It is 12 km from Joginder Nagar. It is easily accessible from Urla in Mandi Pathankot National Highway. There are beautiful deodar and blue pine forests. The spot infolds breath taking vistas of the valleys below.

name: Karsog Valley
description: Karsog (1,800 m) is Sub-Divisional head quarter of Mandi district at the height of 350 m. It is famous for Mamleshwar Mahadev, Kamksha Devi and Mahunag temples. It is full of scenic beauty and abundance of apple orchards. Mamleshwar hotel at Chindi (1,860 m) is recommended.

name: Gurudwara
description: There is a Gurudwara on the way to the bus station. They generally host everyone, asking 300₹ for a room. There is 24/7 langar.

name: Comfort Hotel
description: No comfort here, but cheap. Fan, satellite TV, private shower.

name: Hotel Sangam
description: Great view if you got the right room. AC and non-AC. Not great, but affordable.

name: Snow City Farms by Snow City Hotels
address: NH 21 Sauli Khad to Dhumadevi Road Village Duhak PO Majhwar Tehsil & District Mandi (H.P.)
description: Snow City Farms is the unit of Snow City Hotels (Rohit Thakur). This place surrounded with green forest and natural beauty. It also has a cycling range for mountain biking.

name: Bharkudi
description: A tourist place worth seeing: it is filled with fountains and caves and there is a temple of Lord Shiva. It is 25 km from Palampur on Andretta Road.

name: Baijnath Temple
description: About 16 km from here. It is a historic temple of Lord Shiva and it is there from the reign of pandavas, one will find it amazing. It has beautiful monuments which are worth seeing. It is said that Ravana built this temple to worship Lord Shiva. There is a Yagaya Kund where it is believed that Ravana performed Yagaya to please Lord Shiva.

name: Brijeshwari Temple
description: Another famous temple which is about 35 km from Palampur. It is situated in the heart of Kangra city.

name: Bundla Mata Mandir
description: A temple 4 km from the town on the Nuegal Cafe Road. It is a worthseeing place full of nature's blessings. Aima (Tikka Aima) is one of the central place with majority of Posh Palampurian's living over there. Aima is accomplished by beautiful tea gardens.

name: Chamunda Devi Temple
description: About 17 km from Palampur and is very popular destination for Indian tourists. It is believed that it is a place where Devi Chamunda killed two evils named Chand and Mund. The temple is very beautiful and it is along a river side which adds to its beauty. From the top of a hill it is an awesome view.

name: Jakhni Mata Temple chandpur
description: A temple at nature's paradise 5 km from the Bundla Mata temple and also 5 km from palampur via chandpur village.

name: Naam Art Gallery
description: At Sidhbari Dharamsala, which is about 32 km from Palampur .A German painter, Elisabeth Buschmann, who has made the Dharamsala area her home, has now opened an art gallery--NAAM-- at Sidhbari village on Dharamsala-Chamunda road to display her paintings.The abstract paintings of Elisabeth displayed in a portion of the gallery illustrate various shades of spirituality that crossed her mind while meditating. A section of the gallery displays paintings of Alfred W. Hallet.

name: Sobha Singh Art Gallery
description: A great place for art lovers. It is 12 km away from Palampur and well connected by bus or by train. Sardar Sobha Singh Ji was a world-famous painter. His paintings like Kangari Dulhan, Gaddan, are great.

name: Virni Mata temple
description: At the height of 2000-2500 m above sea level, where one can find unsurpassed creation of God.

name: Gopalpur Zoo
description: A zoo with a limited variety of animals. The main attractions are the Asiatic lion, leopard and Himalayan black bear.

name: The Solitude Camp
description: A peaceful place in the foothills of the Dhauladhar Mountains.

name: Great Himalayan National Park
description: A national park set among the great Himalayan mountains, this park is right on the border between two of the world's eight major bioregions, the Palearctic and the Indomalayan. The remarkable altitude differences in the park (1,400–6,000 m) results in diverse flora from subtropical forests to alpine and glacial flora. The national park is home to different species of goat, bear, leopard and pheasant.Rampur (50 km northwest of the park) is the closest city. The nearest airport is at Bhuntar in Kullu district. There are four entry areas to the park known as Tirthan, Sainj, Jiwanal and Parbati, all situated within a close distance of around 50 km.

name: Parvati Valley
description: An exciting and beautiful valley with the backpacker stronghold of Kasol, the spiritual center of Manikaran, several hot springs, lots of hiking trails around the Great Himalayan National Park, and the popular "weed" harvest in September.

name: Temples Nearby
description: There are many temples in and around Almora. One can visit Chitai Temple, 8 km from city, and a group of temples in Jageshwar (20 km from Almora).

name: Mahavatar Babaji Cave
address: Ratkhal, Near Kukuchina Bus Stand, Pandukholi Mountain Dwarahat
description: Mahavatar Babaji's Cave is the place where the immortal Babaji initiated Lahiri Mahasaya into Kriya Yoga in 1861 (as described in the spiritual classic Autobiography of a Yogi by Paramahansa Yogananda).

name: Nakshatra Kasar Observatory
description: One of India's oldest observatories with a number of telescopes and other astronomical equipment for wondrous stargazing. The guides present freely share their knowledge, making the experience informative and educational as well.

name: Himalaya Woollens
description: Local hand woven tweeds that you can also see being made.

name: Pizza Wok Cafe
description: The oldest pizza cafe in Almora which in addition to pizza, serves sandwiches, burgers and salads. Try the stuffed garlic bread. And don't let the "Wok" in the name confuse you. There are no Chinese or East-Asian inspired dishes on the menu here.

name: Hotel Bhagwati Palace
address: Near Taxi Stand Link Road Almora

name: Jungal House homestay
description: The Jungal House is home to Kishan and his wife Prema. They live here with their 2 sons Rakhshit and Vishal. They are a typical Kumaoni family, living in the central block of the house. They have built an extra room for guests. 4 rooms.

name: Tudor House Mukteshwar
description: Homestay with friendly staff. Outdoor activities and indoor games for entertainment.

name: Bhatta falls
description: On the way back to Dehradun from Mussoorie take the opportunity to see Bhatta Falls. 2-km trek, 3 km away from Mussoorie. Mussoorie Lake is also another site to relax that is located on the same route. Boating is available there.

name: Camty Fall
description: About 15 km from Mussoorie, this now over-built spot is a popular tourist destination. Catch a taxi or a bus from the Library stand.

name: Company Garden
description: It is a government initiative, a man made beautiful park with artificial falls and fun rides. From Gun Hill Point rickshaws are available. It costs 100/- fixed rate per person round trip.

name: Gun Hill Point
description: You can enjoy the trolley ride to Gun Hill to view the splendid view of all the city and ice capped Himalaya. Trolley charge is ₹55 round trip. Lots of photographic opportunities available as traditional dress being worn by populace is common. Up there, it is like a small fair with lots of stalls for games, snacks and nick-knacks.

name: Happy Valley
description: A couple kilometres from the Library end of the Mall, Happy Valley is a 5,000-strong Tibetan settlement. This is a beautiful spot for a short hike. Taxis and possibly bicycle rickshaws ply this route.

name: Himalayan Weavers
description: An interesting place on the way to Dhanaulti which uses natural dyes to produce hand-woven shawls, scarves and throws from wool, eri silk and pashmina. They have a shop 8 km from Mussoorie on the Mussoorie-Dhanaulti Road.

name: Jawahar Aquarium
description: Jawahar Aquarium has a very nice collection of fish. Entry ticket is only ₹15.

name: Jhari Pani Falls
description: It is 5 km away from the library bus stand. From Dehradun to Mussoorie, for Jharipani one has to take a right turn 11 km before Mussoorie. Motorable roads are nicely maintained by the government. To reach the falls from main road. It's a 2-km trek.

name: Lake Mist
description: About 5 km before Kempty Falls on the Mussoorie-Kempty road is a good picnic spot with accommodation and restaurant facilities; boating is also available. With the Kempty river flowing through it, Lake Mist has many small waterfalls made by the river.

name: Lal Tibba
description: A scenic, 5-km uphill walk from Picture Palace to the highest point in Mussoorie. Passes through Landour Bazaar.Old light house is the nice thing to see there. It's a long walk to Lal Tibba from Picture Palace, about 2 to 3 hours.

name: Tibetan Buddhist Temple
description: It is located on the Happy Valley road close to the IAS Academy. The temple can be visited between 7AM to 5PM. Mussoorie was the Dalai Lama's first place of refuge when he fled Tibet, before he was granted land in Dharamshala by then Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru.

name: The Mall road
description: The mall road is long stretch of road surrounded by shops, restaurants, and hotels.

name: Cambridge Book Depot
description: The oldest book shop in the area, the well-read and the owner of the shop is genial and helpful.

name: Landour Language School
description: The school offers classes in Hindi, Urdu, Sanskrit and the local dialect of Garhwali.

name: The Walks of Mussoorie
description: Mussoorie offer some walks around the town. On walk you can take from Library Point to Landhaur Market via camel's back road. It is still free from noise and offers beautiful views.

name: Branded Stores
description: A variety of branded store like, Reebok, Liberty, Koutons, Music World, PlanetM and Wingsfield have come up on the main mall road.

name: G. Dass & Co.
description: The oldest photography shop in Mussoorie. This shop offers facilities such as printing photographs.

name: Wooden Handicrafts
description: Hilly Cottage Industries (Ropeways Shopping Centre, The Mall Road, is one of the famous shops on The Mall Road. Here you can choose from a wide variety of wooden walking sticks, hand-carved jewellery boxes, magazine racks, wooden bowls & trays.

name: Omi Sweet Shop
description: Bal mithai and chocolate barfi. The shop is more than 150 years old and locally famous for Gulab Jamuns, Son Halwa, Balushai, Ghewar, Singori, Pan Gilori, variety of Mathries, etc. They also send Bal Mithai and Pure Chocolate Barfi by courier, all across India.

name: Clark's Restaurant
description: Kurli This multi-cuisine place has a bar and a bakery that are part of the menu.

name: Four Seasons
description: Great place to have Indian, Chinese and Continental food. It is most famous for its Chinese cuisine and is cherished by the regular tourists as well as the locals.

name: Green Vegetarian
description: An amazing biryani from locally grown basmati rice makes it a treat to dine here. The Chinese food comes as a close second favourite.

name: Kalsang Chinese & Thai Restaurant
address: near Cafe Coffee Day, nearer to BSNL office
description: A restaurant that provides authentic Tibetan, Chinese and Thai dishes. This restaurant is run by Tibetan family who is the youngest brother of six sibling.

name: Laxmi Mistan
description: An amazing candy shop joint which serves lovely paranthas.

name: Lovely Omelette Centre
description: Probably serves the best omelettes in Mussoorie. This 100-sq-ft outlet is a favourite with students and ex-student tourists.

name: Madras Cafe
description: Serves piping hot Dosas (spicy crisp vegetarian crepe).

name: Omi Sweet Shop
description: Oldest sweet shop of Uttarakhand. Serving quality sweets from last 151 years. The shop was established in 1860 during the British period. Gulab jamuns, pure chocolate barfi, kalakand, sonhalwa are among the favourites.

name: Raj Kamal
description: Nice place to dine specially north Indian food. It is located on the mall road near Uphaar. Very well behaved waiters.

name: Rice Bowl
description: A Chinese and Tibetan food restaurant run by a very friendly Tibetan family. The food is delicious and cheap.

name: Uphar Vegetarian,
address: Mall Road few feet away from Laxmi Mistan

name: Shera Da Dhaba
description: This multi-cuisine place has a bar and a bakery. Famous for their Pahadi food and cuisine.

name: Cafe Coffee Day
description: Not-quite-Western prices, this chain cafe will offer you a brief respite from the surrounding sea of chai.

name: Dominos
description: In the same building of Cafe Coffee Day.

name: Tavern Restaurant and Bar
address: The Mall, Picture Palace, Dehradun District
description: This is one of the very rare bars in Mussoorie which offers an experience of drinking with live music.

name: The Victorian Bar
address: The Clarides Nabha Residence, Airfield Barlowgunj
description: The bar has lots of variety of cocktails, mocktails and other alcohol.

name: Avalon Resorts
description: High-end, amazing views and lovely cottages. Friendly service. Pick up and drop from Mall road for a fee.

name: Broadway
description: Although Broadway is very close to the Mall and all its attractions, it is in a quiet spot (except for the call to prayer from the nearby masjid) overlooking the valley. It offers reasonable rates, and friendly staff.

name: Country Inn and Suites by Carlson
description: Part of the Country Inn and Suites chain, a little away from Mall Road. Going to Mall Road requires a trip over steep terrain, but the hotel provides pickup/dropoff so guests don't have to negotiate the terrain by themselves. Snow capped peaks might be visible from hotel compound on clear days.

name: Country Inn Mussoorie
description: Kincreg, Dehradun Credit cards: not accepted. Tariff: ₹1,150 (non air-conditioned double room), ₹1,650 (air-conditioned double room), ₹1,850 (suite).

name: Honeymoon Inn
description: The Mall, Tariff: ₹1,500 (double room) in off season.

name: Hotel Ashoka Continental
description: Situated in the heart of the City Hotel Ashoka offers a panoramic view of hills and valley, most enchanting view of sun kissing Shivalik Peaks. Tariff Ranges from ₹1350-2500. Tel: +91 11-42437263-66, Fax: +91 11-26133299,

name: Hotel Dwaper
description: Roof top parking with homely food and good budget rooms.

name: Hotel Emerald Heights
description: A nature-friendly hotel offering rooms and cottage.

name: H. Grand
description: It's an old hotel/building (built before 1908), the rooms are large, clean but basic. Room rents are low at ₹500 for double room.

name: Jaypee Residency Manor
description: On a hilltop. Signature dishes of [https://www.jaypeehotels.com/dining/jaypee-residency-manor-mussoorie/regency Regency restaurant]: Bhatti Da Murgh, Matar Wali Tikki, Bhuni Chaat, Dal Regency, Oven Roasted Fish. [https://www.jaypeehotels.com/dining/jaypee-residency-manor-mussoorie/cafe-manor Cafe Manor] at the Valley View tower (open 8AM-11PM) offers a mix of international flavours. They also have bars called [https://www.jaypeehotels.com/dining/jaypee-residency-manor-mussoorie/marshal-s-lounge Marshals Lounge] (open noon to 11PM).

name: Shiva Continental
description: Near the main mall road away from the daily commotion. Nice food, and good rooms.

name: Hotel LA Casa by Aashna Mussoorie
description: Very budget-friendly hotel.

name: Airtel
description: GSM Triband

name: Cellone
description: GSM Triband

name: Idea Cellular
description: GSM Triband has very good connectivity throughout Mussoorie

name: Vodafone
description: GSM Triband

name: Banaras Cyber Cafe
description: Next to Green Vegetarian restaurant, Kulri, desktops and laser printers.

name: FastTrack Cyber Cafe
description: Opp. Clarks Hotel, Mall Road

name: OM Cyber Cafe
description: Near Bata Company, Kulri, Has a nice fast connection, and also offers wireless, so you can also bring your own laptop. All systems have headsets

name: Sahney's Internet Cafe
description: Landour Bazaar near Gurudwara, Sahney's has a nice fast connection, and also offers wireless. All systems have headsets

name: Guano Hills
description: These hills in the Pangot village are excellent for walks through forests of thick oak, bamboo and deodar. Some rare birds such as the grey woodpecker and black-chinned babbler are found in the forests.

name: Gurney House
description: This is the former home of Jim Corbett. It has been converted into a museum and houses Corbett memorabilia.

name: Naina Devi Temple
description: One story tells us that this temple was constructed in the 15th century during the Kushan reign but another version states that it was built by Moti Ram Shah.

name: Naina Lake
description: Naini Lake is set amidst seven mountains that surround this stagnant water pool and high peaks that almost touch the sky.

name: Naina Devi Temple
description: The temple was destroyed during the Landslip of 1880, and was rebuilt. It is on the lake's northern shore.

name: Neem Karoli Baba Ashram & Temple, Kainchi
description: Neem Karoli Baba Ashram & Temple is a Hindu religious centre, and temple, dedicated to Shri Neem Karoli Baba, a Hindu saint and Guru in the Indian tradition. Many of his devotees visit this temple from all over the world.

name: St. John in the Wilderness
description: This charming church was named and founded by the Bishop of Calcutta.

name: Sariyatal Lake
description: Sariyatal is a lake in Nainital. The water can be extremely cold, but this is a nice area to spend some time. Close by is Sariyatal Park.

name: Snow View
description: Located at an altitude of 2270 m, Snow View offers spectacular views of the Naina Devi Peak. It can be reached by the Aerial Express Ropeway. Round trip: ₹300 for an adult and ₹200 for a child. One-way: ₹50. There is a place called Mountain Magic, which offers bumping cars and go-karting facilities.

name: Tiffin Top
description: Altitude: 2292 m. To get here you can drive up to Sherwood College and then continue on a short scenic walk.

name: Cave Garden
description: 2 km further up from Mallital (northern end of the lake) is a cave complex, developed and maintained by the local administration. This consists of a series of six caves (Tiger, Panther, Porcupine, Bats, Flying Fox and Apes) which get narrower as you progress. People with claustrophobia are advised not to explore the later ones and walk out from the exit available at the end of each cave.

name: Shiva
description: Famous for sweets and veggie fare.

name: Sher-e-Punjab
description: Punjabi cuisine.

name: Janardan Resort Pangot
description: Nice restaurant overlooking a beautiful valley. Food is simple & tasty, veg as well as non-veg is available.

name: Chandni chowk
description: North and South Indian food. Though it is a pure vegetarian restaurant, it is known for its excellent dishes.

name: Courtyard Bar
address: Shervani Hill Top Nainital, Shervani Lodge, Mallital

name: Spirit
address: Comfort Inn Saurabh Haldwani, Civil Lines, Nainital District, Haldwani

name: Ayar Jungle Camp
address: Near Holy Angels School, Ayarpatta, Mallital
description: Ayar Jungle camp gives off a relative sense of being untouched & serene. There are bamboo cottages, Log huts, Machaans and tents to choose from. This Eco camp serves a host of multicuisine dishes, and offers a range of adventurous activities.

name: Emerald Trail
description: Eco-friendly and pet-friendly homestay.

name: The Royal Homestay
description: The interior of this homestay is modern and can accommodate more than 6 guests, with 3 bedrooms, dining table for 6 and kitchen with balcony facing the mountains. Guests can see people doing adventure activities from the bedrooms, terrace and the kitchen balcony.

name: Hidden Valley Camp & Resort Pangot
description: Jungle camp and cottages with 360 degrees of lush green mountain view from all cottages and tents with attached washrooms. Enjoy waterfall trek, Kilbury jungle trek, Cheena/Nainia Peak, adventure activities and more. Pangot is famous for lush green dense forest where there are more than 200 species of birds alone and also wildlife, that can be spotted easily while travelling on road from Nainital-Pangot Road.

name: HimView Camp Mukteshwar
description: Campsite built inside a fruit orchard with an open view of snow-peaked Himalayas in front. Offering Swiss tents with attached washrooms, cot beds and open restaurant in the orchid.

name: Mudras Grove Resort
description: Mudras Grove Resort has cottages and a restaurant.

name: Hotel New Bharat
description: Reservations required.

name: Stay in Tents
description: It’s a tented site at a hiking trip of 2 km from Pangot Resort. One has to reach Pangot and then proceed on a hiking trail to Churaini. The trail has a waterfall as well as a small temple on the way & is perfect for adventure seekers and youth backpackers. The resort has 10 dome tents along with a common toilet.

name: Alka Hotel
description: The upper floor has direct views of the lake.

name: Fair light trails resort
description: A heritage bungalow located atop Nainital.

name: Janardan Resort Pangot
description: Economy rooms have 8 large airy rooms with French windows, 24x7 hot & cold water, attached toilets, room service on call, Queen sized beds & fireplace, Deluxe rooms have all the facilities of the economy rooms but with better bedding, extra toiletries & LCD TV. It has space for free parking also.

name: Nainital Willows Nature’s Sprout
address: MayVilla Compound, Birla School Road, Tallital
description: A resort with clean rooms and views of Naini Lake.

name: Abbotsford- Prasada Bhawan
description: Mallital.

name: Arif Castles
description: Has a 24-hour cafe named Verandah that serves excellent coffee and pastries.

name: Woodside Retreat
description: Pangot.

name: Shervani Hill Top
description: Hotel has been in existence since 1960 and operating as holidays resort since 1981. Shervani Hilltop, Nainital spread out over the lush green and peaceful mountain side a boutique resort having 4-star facilities.

name: Askot
description: It is the place which was built by Chand Rajas, here you can find good forts.

name: Walthi, Munsyari
description: It's in the mountains and a really nice place to see the sunset and sunrise. You can jog to this place in the morning or can take a walk. The view is panoramic from this place.

name: Chandhag
description: This is 7 km from the town and you can see the panoramic view of the city from this hilltop. A temple dedicated to 'Manu' is located here.

name: Dharchula
description: It's another town in Pithoragarh district which is very close to Nepal, you just need to cross a river and you will be in another nation.

name: Dhwaj
description: It is some 30-40 km from the city, shared taxis and call taxis are available at the stations. It is the pilgrimage for all in the city, once you reach Dhwaj by car you need to travel almost 10 km in a hill, and it will be nice trekking.

name: Didihat
description: It is the place where you can see the Himalayas very close to you.

name: The Hilltop Buddha Monastery
description: It is also in the city premises near the city stadium.

name: Jhulaghat
description: The town is 35 km on the banks of river Kali. This river which separates India and Nepal. A suspension bridge connects both the countries and you can got to see the stuff on the other side of the bridge, i.e., Nepal.

name: Local Temples
description: There are a number of local temples in the city which can be accessed easily, and most of them are in hill tops so it will be a good trekking.

name: Munsyari
description: It is the place famous for rajma (an Indian vegetarian dish), and close to the Himalayas. It's the base point for Milam Glacier trek.

name: Thalkedar Temple
description: It's a small trek to a hill top. The route and the view from the top is beyond compare.

name: Gangolihat
description: Gangolihat is one of the biggest Himalayan hill stations in the Pithoragarh district of Uttarakhand, India. It is a place where Adi Guru Shankaracharya worshipped Devi Haat Kalika to get the moksha from human body and is also the sub divisional headquarters of the Indian army.

name: Nainital
description: Nainital is a Himalayan resort town in the Kumaon region of India’s Uttarakhand state, at an elevation of roughly 2,000m. it’s set around Nainital Lake, a popular boating site with Naina Devi Hindu Temple on its north shore. A cable car runs to Snow View observation point (at 2,270m), with vistas over the town and mountains including Nanda Devi, Uttarakhand’s highest peak.

name: New Bar
address: Khari bazar near KMOU bus stand

name: Tourist Guest House
description: KMVN (Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam).

name: Bharat Mandir
description: One of the temples set up by 'Adiguru Shankaracharya' during the 12th century. This temple is a real tribute to Vishnu, the idol of which is carved from a sole piece of Saligram.

name: Gita Bhavan
description: Place of Guru Shri Ram Sukh Daasji (the great thinker of his time) and popular among the Hindu Brahmin community. Twice a year people gather at this ashram to read the Ramayana together.

name: Neelkanth Mahadev Mela
description: One of the most sacred temples in Rishikesh. Located on hill over Swarg Ashram at a height of 1,675 m. A religious fair is held during July–August when many disciples from different corners of India visit.

name: Parmarth Niketan Ashram
description: One of the few ashrams left in India where children get the Vedas education. A must-visit in the evening for the Pooja/Aarti, at 5PM in winter and 6PM in summer.

name: Swarg Ashram
address: Shri 108 Baba kali Kamli Wale Swami Atam Prakash Ji
description: Swargashram (Heavenly Abode), as the name connotes, is a beautiful place situated in picturesque surroundings at the foot of Himalayas on the left bank of the Ganges between Rishikesh and Laxman Jhula. It is the spiritual “ground zero” of Rishikesh, filled with a concentration of ashrams and temples. The areas is known for its healthy and satwik living environment. It is this spot where from ages of yore the famous yogis and rishis have been doing the Tapasya. Numerous mentions of this spot occur in the holy scripture Puranas.

name: Trayambakeshwar Temple
description: It is 13 stories high, with different deities throughout.

name: Triveni Ghat
description: This is a bathing ghat. Every morning and evening, thousands of visitors bathe here and enjoy the Maha Aarti being performed. It is very soothing to sit on the banks of the river and enjoy the cool breeze from the river. Here the water is much cleaner than downstream.

name: Patna Waterfalls
description: Reaching Patna Waterfalls requires a little bit of trekking (600 metres), but you will find scenic spots at the top. There are a few tea stalls along the way.

name: Indian Palmistry Institute
description: Centre for learning palmistry and astrology.

name: Ganga Astrology Centre
price: Palm reading ₹300; full chart horoscope ca ₹500
description: Personal horoscopes and palm reading from Dr. Gaurav Agrawal and the astrologer B.P. Uniyal. The horoscopes can be made on a distance, using your place and date of birth.

name: Soma Reiki centre
description: Run by soma a local reiki master which is in Gita Ashram.

name: Maayaa International Healing School
address: Near Dharam Raj Temple, Laxman Jhulla Road, Paurhi
description: Maayaa offers sound healing, reiki, chakra healing, numerology, Tarot reading, physic counselling, aromatherapy, Kundalini meditation, dowsing, chakra balancing. Also these residential courses: sound healing teacher training course, meditation teacher training course, aromatherapy course, chakra plus crystal intensive program and yoga & meditation retreats.

name: Chakra Ayurvedic Wellness
description: Panchakarma, Ayurveda, Physiotherapy, Yoga & Ayurveda retreat.

name: Divine School of Ayurveda
alt: Dr. Mukesh Sharma and Dr. Vibha Sharma
address: Laxman Jhula Road, Near Dharamraj Temple below Maestro Galleria, Pauri Garhwal
description: Panchakarma, sound healing, astrology or Jyotishshastra, Ayurveda nutrition, yoga & Ayurveda retreat.

name: Bhuwan Chandra Music School & Store
address: Ram Jhula, Swaargashram, near Ram Jhula Bridge
description: Run by a sitar player Bhuwan Chandra. Travelers can learn and buy sitar, tabla, harmonium, mantra chanting, and improve vocal skills.

name: Mukeshji's Jungle Vibes
description: Make Australian didgeridoos, African djmbes and other musical instruments under the guidance of Mukeshji, while he regales you with his hilarious stories and takes you along with him in his Himalayan journeys.

name: Pankaj Music School
description: Extremely professional artist Pankaj teaches sitar, harmonium, tabla and bansuri in different styles in a slow-paced, yet intensive way.

name: Yoga and Music Festival
description: Free concerts of live classical Indian music and free yoga classes with local top yoga teachers.

name: Ganga View Restaurant
description: Probably the best cooks in town, these guys will serve you any food you like. Be prepared to wait 40-90 minutes as the place is extremely popular.

name: German Bakery in Tapovan
description: Don't miss their super-popular spinach pie. Come at 10AM to get a piece.

name: Little Buddha
description: One of the best known cafes in town. Here you can get delicious Nepali, Indian, European, and Thai food for under ₹100 per dish. Three storeys, nice Ganga view.

name: Moon Dance Cafe
description: Italian, Mexican American, Indian, Tibetan, Nepali, Israeli cuisine with all food prepared with fresh water. Great choice of delicious meals. Be prepared to wait for at least 40 minutes.

name: Pundit G Ka Rajasthani Restaurant
description: Has a very good variety of North Indian food.

name: Red Night Restaurant
description: Open air, river-facing restaurant and terrace

name: Zorba Organic Restaurant & Cafe
description: Serves Indian, Italian, Chinese, cafe-style, Tibetan and Israeli food. Vegetarian-friendly with vegan options, to eat in or take out. Outdoor seating with view of the Ganges. No smoking, child-friendly.

name: Freedom Ganga Cafe
description: Offers strawberry smoothies, thick mango juice (ask for no ice), strawberry lassi, thick fresh pineapple juice. Drinks are served in 500 ml mugs.

name: Ananda Guesthouse
description: Clean and comfortable, new rooms with attached bath. Good value for the money and the owner is a great and helpful host.

name: Green Hotel
description: A large, popular place with a good restaurant.

name: Hotel Hill Top
price: Double bed-room ₹600-750. Four bed-room with TV ₹1,200
description: Rooms overlooking the river and the mountains.

name: Hotel Ishan
description: Decent rooms with Ganga views and balconies.

name: Hotel Narayana Kunj
description: They claim to have neat and clean rooms and good service.

name: Hotel Surya Palace
description: Opened 2010. Wifi. Rooms are big, clean and very comfortable.

name: Jaipur Inn
description: Nice rooms, some with a view and a good restaurant on the top floor that overlooks both the Laxman Jhula and the Ganges River.

name: Krishna Cottage
description: Room price of US$20 per night includes 3 meals & free wireless internet. Also offers short term yoga and ayurveda courses/retreats (including Yoga Alliance certified 200 hour yoga teacher training) and budget car and taxi rental services from Delhi airport to Rishikesh.

name: Laxmi Yellow Guest House
address: Near Anand Prakash Yoga Ashram, Badrinath Road Tapovan Laxman Jhoola
description: Guest house with clean and comfortable rooms with attached kitchen, common kitchen and attached bathroom with 24 hours hot water, mountain view, in-house salad lounge & cafe. In-house reiki and crystal macrame workshops available. In-house salon for haircut by professional stylist. Yoga lessons, river rafting and other adventure activities are also available on request. The host is very helpful and kind and stays in the same property. The same owner also owns Yash Paying Guest House, which charges ₹400-500 for rooms and also offers them for monthly rentals. Contact info for Yash: email: yashpalbhatt@yahoo.com, +91 9412146858, Mr.Yash, +91 9997887794

name: Live Free Hostel
address: Laxman Jhula, Distt. Tehri Garhwal, Tapovan
description: Hostel with a rooftop and several terraces. Dorm, single and double rooms with all new beds and bedsheats. Staff sometimes takes tourists out on small daytours outside of town. Has Wifi.

name: Lucky Hotel
description: 8-room hotel on the banks of the Ganges with a river view. A restaurant serving Indian and Chinese food is under the hotel.

name: Mount Valley Mama Cottage
description: The friendly hostess, Mama, makes wholesome breakfasts and scrumptious thali. Nice Ganga views and a good shower.

name: Patanjali Yoga Center
description: Iyengar Yoga lessons are available in a studio with modern equipment.

name: Raj Resort
description: Clean and comfortable AC/non-AC rooms with attached bathrooms, hot shower, balcony with mountain view, garden, car parking, restaurant. Yoga lessons, river rafting and other extras are also available.

name: Rishikesh Sadan, the Spiritual Retreat Guesthouse
address: Near RTO Checkpost, Aamkhala, Tapovan, Badrinath Highway
description: Clean and comfortable valley facing rooms near spring.

name: Sai Ganga Cottage
description: Family operated, beautiful rooms A/C and Non A/C available, water heater, delectable restaurant, cyber cafe, rafting and trekking packages, bus, air and train ticketing services available.

name: Sarika The sanctuary
description: Reported to be clean and comfortable.

name: Shiva Resort
description: Open rooms with balconies and garden. Also offers yoga lessons in the morning (7:00AM to 8:30AM ) & evening (5:30PM to 7:00PM), in-house pool, Internet cafe, Ayurvedic treatments and panchkarma centre.

name: Shiv Shakti Guesthouse
description: Clean and comfortable rooms with attached bathroom. Some rooms have Ganges views and free Wi-Fi. There is also a travel point at reception.

name: Tripti Hotel
description: Clean and comfortable. The owner is a great guy and helpful host.

name: Vashishth Guest House
description: Clean and safe place to stay with air conditioning, television, water heater, attached bathroom facilities.

name: Yoga Niketan Guest House
description: Yoga classes take place in their main ashram above - a five-minute uphill walk. Clean rooms on ground and first floors have private sit out with good view of the Ganges. Basic veg meals available on request or at the Ashram for ₹200 per day. Non Ac ₹500; AC ₹990.

name: Nirmal Ashram
description: Mayakund, Nirmal Ashram is famous for its service to humanity. Free food, medical treatment, education to poor people are a few of the services which Nirmal Ashram provides. Free food is served to everybody who comes to the ashram.

name: Sant Seva Ashram
description: Budget rooms on the banks with a great view from ₹250-700. Long stays allowed. Booking can be done only 1 or 2 days in advance. Homely restaurant attached.

name: Sri Ved Niketan Ashram
description: Spacious yoga hall of the International Vishwaguru Meditation and Yoga Institute and huge and serene lush green court yard offering hatha yoga, meditation, teacher training course 200 hours and 15 days intensive course of hatha yoga, etc.

name: Kriya Yoga Ashram
description: very calm environment inside with a costing of 700 rupee per person/day including food good enough for travel person they have arti and meditation hall as well which is good.

name: Hotel Ganga View
description: Situated on the outskirts of the city with a river view.

name: High Bank Peasant's Cottage
description: A small boutique family guest house, away from the hustle and bustle. Located peacefully on the edge of the reserve forest in the lower Himalayas overlooking the town.

name: Hotel Yog Tapovan
description: 14 rooms and Wifi.

name: Hotel Prasanna Inn
description: Near the river line, in some quiet and serene surroundings. Rooftop yoga.

name: Tapovan Resort
description: A newer hotel with good rooms and a garden. Also has a decent restaurant.

name: Vna Tapovan
description: A quiet hotel with an informative, helpful staff. Rafting, camping, trekking and bungee jumping can be arranged.

name: Ganga Beach Resort
description: Exquisite setting on the Ganges, surrounded by forested hills.

name: Hotel Ganga Kinare
description: On the banks of the Ganges, with a private ghat (bank), this boutique hotel overlooks Rajaji National Park. A couple of rolling lawns host morning yoga sessions and spiritual lectures. Various heads of states and celebrities have stayed here. The hotel houses a riverside cafe 'Rangoli' and a multi-cuisine dining lounge. Some years before it used to be the venue of international yoga week also.

name: Corbett Treat Resort
description: Cafe HoHo is the subsidiary of Corbett Treat Resort. Their speciality is local Kumaoni and traditional Indian food.

name: Jim's Jungle Retreat
description: Provides accommodation in 18 lodges and cottages with attached bathrooms, running hot and cold water. Also provides outdoor activities, jungle safaris, bonfires, bird watching, jungle tail, etc.

name: Nadiya Parao Resort
description: 4-star resort amidst the jungle 5 minutes’ drive from the Jhirna & Bijrani Safari Zones has 53 rooms and cottages.

name: Namah Resorts
description: Surrounded by lush greenery, on the bank of the River Kosi at Corbett National Park, close to the wildlife sanctuary.

name: Tiger Kingdom Resort
description: Beautiful balance of luxury and exclusivity amidst the pristine natural background of the Jim Corbett National Park.

name: Aranya the Kanan Resort
description: An eco-friendly resort in Corbett city. Equipped with air-conditioning and heating.

name: Aahana Resorts in Corbett National Park
description: Aahana Resorts offers spa, pool, restaurants, activity areas, meeting room, and safari facilities, free WiFi Internet (Lobby), outdoor pool, parking, bar, gymnasium/health club.

name: Camp tour of Corbett National Park
description: Entry to Dhikala tourism zone, Jeep safari, viewing wildlife, especially the tiger, elephant ride, fish-eating crocodile

name: Chilla Barrage
description: It's also known as Pashulok Bridge, which is built over the Ganges River. This dam generates electricity for Rajaji National Park and the entire Pauri Garhwal region."

name: Jhimil Jheel
description: This is a forest reserve with an impressive array of flora and fauna. You can also spot various wild animals here, such as tigers, deer, elephants, and leopards. Additionally, several migratory bird species can be seen here.

name: Nanda Devi National Park Interpretive Trek
address: Shepherds Lodge Devangan, Thuaa, V&P Lata, Chamoli
description: This trek is managed by the local community and starts from the village of Lata and culminates at Suraithota. The visitors camp at Kanook and Lata Kharak while at the village of Tolma homestay arrangements are made. The highest elevation gained during the trek is 4,200 m. Since the landscape is almost vertical, chances of AMS remains high. The trekkers camp midway at Camp Kanook, between Lata village and Lata Kharak, to acclimatise before attempting the high altitude. The Nanda Devi Trek is planned as an all immersive experience for travellers.

name: Shepherds Lodge Devangan
description: The lodge is an ideal base for trekkers planning to explore the bio-culture diversity and mesmerising landscape and wilderness of the park. The tariff includes dinner and breakfast. There is an equipment store for hiring trekking equipment.

name: Panch Kedar
description: This refers to five Hindu temples or holy places of the Shaivite sect dedicated to Shiva. The five temples are to be visited in strict order during a pilgrimage.

name: Darwaza-i-Rauza
description: The large gate that leads to the entrance of the Taj Mahal complex. The three entrances come together to enter the complex. Videography is allowed up to the red sandstone platform of the gate.

name: Tomb of Fatehpuri Begum
description: A tomb dedicated to Fatehpuri Begum, a consort of Shah Jahan. She was a patron of the arts who had built the Fatehpuri Mosque just outside the West Gate. Built in the 1650s, it is one of the less visited monuments in the Taj Mahal complex, overshadowed by the main mausoleum. It contains a single white dome and twenty-four arches, standing on an elevated platform. It is surrounded by the intricate jali walls of its adjacent mosque.

name: Tomb of Sirhindi Begum
description: A tomb dedicated to Sirhindi Begum, also known as Akbarabadi Mahal, the third wife of Shah Jahan. She gained significant favour during the later years of the emperor, becoming his most beloved consort after Mumtaz Mahal.

name: Hawd al-Kawthar
description: The raised marble water tank (hauz) at the centre of the garden, literally meaning and named after the "Tank of Abundance" promised to Muhammad in paradise where the faithful may quench their thirst upon arrival.

name: Naubat Khana
description: A two-storey drum house at the east, built of sandstone, and is capped with a white marble chhatris supported from 8 columns.

name: Taj Museum
description: A museum hosted in a structure identical to the eastern Naubat Khana.

name: Mausoleum
description: The focus of the Taj Mahal complex is the main mausoleum; a white cubic building with chamfered corners. It is topped by a large dome and several pillared, roofed chhatris. It comprises 4 floors; the lower chamber containing the tombs of Shah Jahan and Mumtaz Mahal, the main chamber containing identical cenotaphs of the tombs below in a much more elaborate chamber, an ambulatory storey and a roof terrace.

name: Mosque and Jawab
description: Two identical buildings on either side of the platform. The Jawab, meaning "answer", was originally used as a place for entertaining and accommodation for important visitors, and is also known as "Mehman Khana", literally "Guest House".

name: Yamuna River
description: One of the holy rivers of India, considered as a goddess in Hindu culture. A tributary of the Ganges which flows from Himalayas and further downstream, while passing through Delhi.

name: Hazrat Ahmad Shah Bukhari Rahmatullah Aleh Dargah
description: A hidden dargah inside the Taj Forest.

name: Kalakriti Cultural and Convention Centre
description: Art exhibits and Bollywood-style shows about the Taj Mahal.

name: Tomb of Kandhari Begum
description: A tomb dedicated to Kandhari Begum, also known as Qandahari Begum, the first wife of Shah Jahan.

name: Khan-i-Alam Bagh
description: A less-explored garden just west of the Taj Mahal complex.

name: Fatehpuri Masjid
description: Contains the tomb of Satti-un-Nisa.

name: Taj Nature Walk
price: Indian nationals ₹40 (up to 5 years free, 5 to 10 years ₹20), foreigners ₹100
description: A forest area of 11 hectares, this park has many landscaped mounds and watchtowers that provide a nice view of the Taj Mahal. There's a lake with many species of fish, birds and aquatic plants.

name: Taj Ganj
description: A chaotic bazaar in front of the Taj Mahal complex, a stark contrast from the complex's elegant, formal geometric layout. Originally known as "Mumtazabad", the bazaar was built as an integral part of the complex, initially to provide the construction workers with accommodation and facilities for their wellbeing. It eventually became a bustling town and the centre of Agra's economic activity where "different kinds of merchandise from every land, varieties of goods from every country, all sorts of luxuries of the time, and various kinds of necessities of civilisation and comfortable living brought from all parts of the world" were sold.

name: Taj East Gate
description: Handicrafts from different parts of Uttar Pradesh sold here.

name: Joney's Place
description: Perfect for early breakfast, when you want to wake up early to visit the Taj at 6AM. Offered are for example toast, coffee and cornflakes.

name: Treat Restaurant
description: Good Indian food

name: Yash Cafe
address: 3/137 Chawk Kaghzian, near Hotel Shanti Lodge

name: Berco's Tajganj Agra
description: Chinese cuisine.

name: Amar Vilas Bar
description: Beer for ₹200 and cocktails for ₹450. The terrace of Amar Vilas Bar provides a view of the Taj.

name: Downing Street Bar
description: High quality of beverages and pleasant ambience. Downing Street Bar offers dishes such as pizza and tandoori chicken from the same kitchen.

name: Mughal Bar
description: It's in the compound of Hotel Clarks Shiraz’s, Mughal Bar is an open-aired roof bar. It offers some continental delicacies along with Indian ones.

name: Shahjahan
address: South Gate, near police station Tajganj
description: Almost a fancy hotel and restaurant, with a café and a rooftop with great views of the Taj Mahal. Wi-Fi only downstairs in the reception. The staff are very helpful. Five minutes' walk from the Taj.

name: Friends Paying Guest House
address: p-6 , Taj Nagri Phase 1, near Shilpgram Rd
description: Family-run guest house 15-min walk east from the Taj. Food, decent Wi-Fi, TV in rooms. Cushion-furnished balcony common area for eating, drinking and lazing about.

name: Hotel Raj
description: Directly in front of the central entry of the Taj Mahal, simple but clean.

name: Hotel Sheela
description: Commission-free transport bookings, free incoming phone calls, 24 hour hot water. 22 rooms. Laundry facility.

name: India Inn
price: ₹300 for a double in off season
description: Comfortable enough.

name: Rhine Hostel
address: HIG - 2/10, Near Shilpgram Parking, Taj Nagri Phase 1, Taj East Gate Rd, Telipara
description: 6 rooms, 10 minute walking distance from Taj Mahal, rooftop, free stay in exchange of work available. Food, Wi-Fi, common area for eating, drinking and lazing about.

name: Saniya Palace
address: Chowk Kajziyan, South Gate, Taj Ganj
description: Good budget hotel with some air-con rooms. 24-hr room service. Friendly staff & fantastic views of the Taj Mahal from the roof top restaurant. ₹700

name: Shanti lodge
description: South Taj gate. From ₹400 economic room, non air-con. Hot water, TV. Restaurant on the roof top. Be careful with the bed sheets, not very clean. Cloak room available.

name: Harshit paying guest house
description: Five clean rooms, running hot water in the bathroom, fully air conditioned, LCD TV, Internet, home cooked food.

name: Hotel Mandakini Villas
address: Fatehabad Road, Purani Mandi, Taj Ganj
description: Offers air-conditioned rooms each with cable TV with 100 channels, broadband Internet connection, private bathroom. You might get a little bit warmer than cold water by requesting it from the reception a few times. It is not possible to sleep without earplugs in the first floor because of the noise coming from corridor and reception all night. Get a room on the higher floors.

name: Hotel Priya
address: Near Priya Restaurant, Near TDI Mall, Fatehabad Road
description: Offers air-con rooms each with cable TV with 100 channels, Internet connection, private bathroom. One of the best in this range.

name: Hotel Taj Resorts
description: Built in 2010, restaurant with rooftop seating and a beautiful pool, great view of the Taj (if not blocked by terrible pollution).

name: N.Homestay
price: Single air-con room [June 2012]: ₹1199 & Double air-con room [June 2012]: ₹1499
description: A family owned, operated guest house in a peaceful and quite colony away from the city traffic and pollution. Free parking, 24-hr free Wi-Fi, cable TV, all day water supply and accessible roof top.

name: Rajmahal hotel
description: 9 km from Agra Airport. You will also get a nice view of Taj Mahal, which is 3 km away.

name: Tajview
description: An IHCL SeleQtions hotel.

name: Courtyard by Marriott Agra
address: Taj Nagri, Phase II, Fatehabad Rd

name: ITC Mughal
price: Double room [June 2012]: from ₹4,845 to ₹100,000. Taxes not included
description: Formerly the Sheraton Mughal, this is one of Agra's top hotels, with views of the Taj from the roof viewing pavilion. Large pool. The hotel's age is starting to show, but the rooms are in fine shape. Popular with tour groups.

name: The Oberoi Amarvilas Agra
description: The best (and most expensive) hotel in Agra. It is consistently rated among the top 10 hotels in Asia.

name: Taj Agra
address: Taj East Gate Rd, Phase 1, Taj Nagari

name: The Trident Agra
description: Formerly the Trident Hilton, it's further away from the Taj than others, but is near the TDI Mall.

name: Agra Fort
description: It is similar in layout to the Red Fort in Delhi, but considerably better preserved, as much of Delhi Fort was razed by the British after the Mutiny. As much a palace as a defensive structure, it is also constructed mainly from red sandstone and much white marble in the palace section of the fort.

name: Diwan-i-Am
description: This building separates the outer court from the inner court and has a marble platform for the emperor's throne.

name: Diwan-i-Khas
description: Built completely of marble, this is where the emperor received special visitors.

name: Jahangiri Mahal
description: The principal zenana (palace for women belonging to the royal household) of the Fort. It was built for the Hindu wives of Akbar, especially his chief wife Mariam-uz-Zamani, popularly known as "Jodha Bai". There is a huge bowl called Hauz-i-Jahangiri that is carved out of a single piece of stone. This was used as a container for fragrant rose water.

name: Mina Masjid
description: A mosque built, entirely of white marble, by Shah Jahan for his personal use. It is enclosed and secured on all sides by high walls, and has a small open court in front of the three-arched prayer-chamber. There is no ornamentation and is simple.

name: Moti Masjid
description: A Friday mosque.

name: Musamman Burj
description: An octagonal tower built by Shah Jahan for his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal. It is said that there was a small marble palace built by Akbar at this site, which was later demolished by Jahangir to erect new buildings. The tower looks out over the River Yamuna, offering what is traditionally considered to be one of the most poignant views of the Taj Mahal. It is here that Shah Jahan along with his favorite daughter Jahanara Begum had spent his last few years as a captive of his son Aurangzeb. He laid here on his death bed while gazing at the Taj Mahal.

name: Shah Jahani Mahal
description: A palace between the white-marble Diwan-i-Khas and the redstone Jahangiri Mahal. It is the earliest attempt of emperor Shah Jahan to convert an existing redstone building in accordance with his taste.

name: Sheesh Mahal
description: A stunning palace adorned with intricate mirror work and glass mosaics. It served as a royal dressing room and exemplifies the exquisite craftsmanship of the Mughal era.

name: Jaswant Singh ki Chatri
description: Jaswant Singh ki Chatri is the only Hindu monument built in Agra during the Mughal rule. It is a memorial cenotaph dedicated to Rani Hada, wife of Amar Singh Rathore. Upon her husband's death, Rani Hada committed sati. Raja Jaswant Singh, the younger brother of Amar Singh, built the chatri in 1644-58 CE.

name: Mariam's Tomb
description: Constructed by Jahangir in memory of his mother Mariam Zammani. The grave is made of white marble. Though this building is in a ruined condition, yet it has in its vicinity, a Christian Mission School and a church. It is also said; Akbar himself made it in the memory of his Christian wife.

name: Roman Catholic Cemetery
description: Roman Catholic Cemetery in Agra predates the Taj Mahal. It dates back to the time of Akbar (ruled 1556 - 1605). The earliest grave dates back to 1611 and is of an Armenian named Khwaja Mortenepus. The star attraction of the cemetery is the tomb of William Hessing (1740 - 1803), a Dutch commander of Agra Fort under Maharaja Daulat Rao Scindia. The red sandstone tomb was constructed by his wife and is designed along the lines of the Taj Mahal, but not an exact copy. It is often referred to as the Red or Baby Taj. The Ellisa Memorial, Tomb of General Perron's children and many of the other tombs are built in Islamic style. Also, many of the Armenian graves have epitaphs in Persian.

name: Sikandra
description: The tomb of Akbar lies here in the centre of the large garden. Akbar started its construction himself but it was completed by his son Jahangir, who significantly modified the original plans, which accounts for the somewhat cluttered architectural lines of the tomb. Four red sandstone gates lead to the tomb complex: one is Muslim, one Hindu, one Christian, and one is Akbar's patent mixture.

name: Tomb of Firoz Khan Khwajasara
description: Firoz Khan Khwasara was the caretaker of Shah Jahan's harem. It is a sandstone tomb with four corner towers and intricate jali works.

name: Soami Bagh
description: The white marble samadhi of the Radha Soami religion. Construction started in 1904 and is not expected to be completed until sometime in the next century. Visitors can see pietra dura inlaid marblework actually being worked on. Soami Bagh is 2 km north of Agra and can be reached by bus or cycle.

name: Guru ka Tal
description: A historical gurudwara dedicated to the ninth Guru, that is Guru Tegh Bahadur. The gurudwara is at the place where Tegh Bahadur offered voluntary arrest to emperor Aurangzeb.

name: Akbar's Church
description: Akbar's Church dates back to 1598 and was built under the patronage of Emperor Akbar by Jesuit Fathers from Goa. Akbar's son, Jahangir, helped in the further expansion of the church. However, his son Shah Jahan demolished the church in 1635, only to rebuild it a year later. Again in 1758, the church was looted by the Persian invader Ahmed Shah Abdali. In 1769, the church was rebuilt. In 1835, the church went through further extension.

name: Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception
description: Constructed in 1848, it dominates the nearby Akbar's Church. It is built in Baroque style.

name: St John's Church
description: Oldest Protestant church of Agra.

name: Great Idgah
description: An eidgah where Muslims would come together during Friday prayers.

name: Jama Masjid
description: A large congregational mosque attributed to Princess Jahanara Begum, built in 1648 during the reign of her father, Shah Jahan. Notable for its unusual dome and absence of minarets.

name: Dayal Bagh Temple
description: Dayal Bagh Temple in Agra, the headquarters of the Radha Soami Satsang movement, is renowned for its ongoing construction, stunning white marble architecture, and intricate carvings. Founded in 1904, it serves as a spiritual and meditation centre, attracting devotees worldwide.

name: Mankameshwar Temple
description: Listen to the aarti as some claim it purifies your soul. It is the most visited temple by locals, and during festive seasons, it's so crowded, disrupting the traffic in the nearby areas.

name: Adlabs Multiplex
price: ₹150 for a Hindi Show & ₹450 for a show in English
description: Interactive cinema. Each viewer holds a wireless remote unit with push buttons and a small LCD screen, enabling them to participate in a trivia game about the theme of the film. The show is called India in Motion, a 25-minute show where the audience will pass through today's India in, or on, a variety of typical vehicles and see the historical events at sites of Mohenjo Daro, Indraprastha and the Taj Mahal, experiencing the bumpy elephant rides with the wind blowing through their hair, or the swaying boat with salty spray on their faces. Before the show there is an interactive quiz on various topics relating to India.

name: Eklavya Sports Stadium
description: The main stadium of Agra, hosting both cricket and football.

name: Keetham Lake
description: A picturesque lake off NH 44, and a Ramsar site. The pentagonal lake is home to over two dozen species of resident and migratory birds. The Agra Bear Rescue Facility near the lake is dedicated to rehabilitating previously captured "dancing bears".

name: Dayal Lodge
description: Established in the early 1960s, with 16 furnished air conditioned rooms. 24 hr made-to-order meals, in-house laundry facilities, local airport/railway station transfers.

name: Laurie's Hotel
description: An old colonial hotel from the British era, some say it hasn't been upgraded since, Laurie's retains some of the charm of travelling in India during the Raj. Rooms with very high ceilings (fans, no aircon) lead off from verandahs with nice lawns outside. A swimming pool is closed in the winter. One can get British era service with 'bed tea', excellent freshly made chicken curry and rice to order, and creaky plumbing. Some people will love it, others may hate it.

name: Fairfield by Marriott Agra
address: 119/8 & 120/8, Ashok Cosmos Mall, Wazirpura Road, Civil Lines, Sanjay Place

name: Holiday Inn Agra MG Road
address: 16/2/8, MG Rd, Sanjay Place, Civil Lines

name: Battis Khamba
alt: बत्तीस खंबा Battīs Khambā, literally "32 pillars"
description: An octagonal three-storey tower topped by a chhatri.

name: Gyarah Sidhi
alt: ग्यारह सीढ़ी Gyārah Sīṛhī, literally "eleven steps"
description: The 11-step structure is part of a medieval observatory dating back to the Mughal emperor Humayun.

name: Humayun Masjid
description: A former mosque in northern Agra, partly in shambles. As per one inscription, it was built in 937 AH (1530-31) during the rule of Humayun, although some claim that it was actually built in 1565 by Haji Begum, a wife of Akbar, in memory of her father. Regardless, the mosque is made of brick and limestone. Its façade bears five arches. A dome tops the central nave, and double-aisled wings on either side of it.

name: Aram Bagh
description: The first Mughal garden, built by the first Mughal emperor, Babur.

name: Mehtab Bagh
price: ₹50 for Indians, ₹300 for foreigners. The ADA Taj Mahal View Point costs ₹200
description: An octagonal pool is placed at the centre of the garden, which lets visitors see an amazing reflection of the Taj Mahal during moonlight, without the crowds of tourists. The garden was built in the 16th century by Emperor Babur, and it is also referred to as the "Moonlight Garden". Alternatively, there is the ADA Taj Mahal View Point to the right of the entrance: the view of the Taj is every bit as lovely (perhaps more so, since the barbed wire fence surrounding the gardens will be beneath you).

name: Tomb of Itimad-ud-Daulah
description: Empress Nur Jahan built the tomb of Itimad-ud-Daulah, sometimes called the Baby Taj, for her father, Ghias-ud-Din Beg, the Chief Minister of Emperor Jahangir. Small in comparison to many other Mughal-era tombs, it is sometimes described as a jewel box. Its garden layout and use of white marble, pietra dura, inlay designs and latticework presage many elements of the Taj.

name: Chauburji
description: This was the temporary burial place of Babur. Later, his mortal remains were transferred to Kabul. It has four corner towers and follows the prototype of the nearby Tomb of Itimad-ud-Daula, but lacks the marble finish. It lies in ruins and is seldom visited by tourists.

name: Chini Ka Rauza
description: A memorial dedicated to the Prime Minister of Shah Jahan, Allama Afzel Khal Mullah Shukrullah of Shiraz, notable for its dome of blue glazed tiles.

name: Devi Talab Mandir
description: A replica of Amritsar Golden Temple.

name: Nikku Park
description: Nice park for strolling.

name: Nakodar
description: The town was founded by the Hindu Kamboh. The Kamboh settlements lay to the west of present town and the sites are still marked by extensive ruins and two old tombs, now called the Black and Red Domes, from the colour of the material. The large and handsome tombs dating at least from the times of Jahangir, the fourth Moghul Emperor (1569 – 1627). One of them is said to be the burial place of the adviser of Emperor Shah Jahan, but it is not known who is buried in the other tomb.

name: Pushpa Gujral Science City
description: Almost all students in Punjab are taken on school trips to visit Science City.

name: Wonderland
description: One the best place for enjoyment for one day outing for the entire family with thrilling rides, water games and many more.

name: Bombay Jewellers
description: Gold and diamond jewellery.

name: Tanishq & World of Titan
description: Jewellery and watches. Sub-brand of Tata Group.

name: Viva Collage Shopping Mall
description: Jalandhar's largest shopping mall, featuring a five-screen multiplex.

name: The Great Kabab Factory
description: A wide selection of vegetarian and non-vegetarian kababs and curries

name: Headquarters
description: Mixed cuisine

name: Heat 7
description: Fast food restaurant. Indian, Punjabi, Chinese and other dishes

name: Lovely Sweets
description: Candy store

name: Pahwa Kulfi House
description: [https://www.facebook.com/pages/Pahwa-Kulfi-House-Model-Town-Market-Jalandhar/178470325639283]

name: South Indian Dosa
description: Mixed cuisine

name: Volga Restaurant
description: Mixed dosa and paneer dosa. The aloo tike is better from the street vendor just outside the restaurant.

name: Billa Kulfi corner
description: This is one of the famous kulfi corners known for kulfi and faluda rabri and affordable prices. "Milk badam" and "kesar milk" are also delicious there. Other locations: Adarsh Chopati & Model town

name: Haveli
description: One of the best places to eat typical Punjabi food. It hosts variety of snack stalls as well.

name: Rangla Punjab
description: Traditional Punjabi cuisine. The Punjabi village setting makes it one of the favorite places of everyone who visits this city. It models village houses, wells etc. It offers buffet in a typical Punjabi village home setting. The hospitality offered here reflects the open and loving hearts of Punjabi people. One can get tired of eating but the food will not stop coming. It also hosts a number of shops where you can buy the Punjabi jutis (slippers), clothes, bangles, etc. On weekends, cultural performances by singers and dancing groups is offered. Definitely a "must" visit place.

name: Vijay Dhaba
description: Traditional Punjabi food. It's one of the famous dhabas known for fresh food (like home-cooked) and affordable prices. "Shahi Paneer" and "Kheer" is definitely a must try.

name: Prithvi's Planet
description: A family recreation (1 fast food, 1 restaurant, pool table and six lane bowling alley) Mixed cuisines

name: Sagar Ratna
description: Very popular. South Indian food in a great ambiance but not many options

name: Grand Lily Resorts
description: A traditional hotel surrounded by well kept gardens. It's equipped with a fitness centre, a spa and a swimming pool. The huge banquet hall is often used as a reception venue for larger wedding parties.

name: Radisson Jalandhar
description: The only five-star hotel in the city

name: Sekhon Grand
description: Multi-cuisine restaur

name: Gurudwara Ber Sahib
description: It is here Guru Nanak Sahib entered the Bein rivulet and stayed three days in the water.

name: Jagatjit Palace
description: Once home of Maharaja Jagatjit Singh, it is the most impressive building in the city, inspired by European palaces. Built in 1906. Today it houses a school.

name: Mazar of Mir Nasir Ahmed
description: A pilgrimage site for Indian classical musicians.

name: Panch Mandir
description: A temple, home of five small temples.

name: Moorish Mosque
description: A replica of the Grand Mosque of Marrakech, commissioned by the last ruler of Kapurthala, Maharajah Jagatjit Singh to a French architect. Its construction was complete in 1930. The mosque is a National Monument of India.

name: Kanjli Wetlands
description: Man-made Wetland that subsumes the Kanjli Lake. It was created in 1870 by constructing the headworks across the perennial Bien River, a tributary of the Beas River to provide irrigation facilities to the hinterland. The rich biodiversity of the wetland comprising aquatic, mesophytic and terrestrial flora and fauna including some important species of plants and animals was recognized internationally by the Ramsar Convention in 2002 by designating the Kanjli Lake in the List of Wetlands of International Importance. A great place for birdwatching and boating.

name: Museum of Rural History of Punjab
Nehru Rose Garden
address: Government College Rd, New Prem Nagar, Civil Lines
description: A park with well-landscaped lawns and flowers, fountains, picnic area and a children's playground. Dog friendly.

name: Pavilion Mall
description: the biggest shopping mall in Ludhiana. The 7-screen multiplex has 1016 seats and is fitted with latest sound and projection system. It is the largest in Ludhiana.

name: Garner
description: It is very famous for all women cardigans, T-shirts and bawa suits at reasonable prices.

name: K.P.Knitter's Zorin and Miss Annie
description: It is famous for its woolen kurtis, leggings, bawa suits, etc.

name: Sant Ram Mangat Ram Jewellers Pvt.Ltd.
The Sarabha Nagar market
description: It is one of the most popular hangout places with many eating joints such as the Noodle Bar, Yo China, and Hot Breads.

name: Fountain chowk
description: is another open place to enjoy all sorts of spicy eateries: Stuffed naans, Cholley Bhuture, and Chaat, Tikki.

name: Aman chicken
description: One of the oldest chicken eateries in the town.

name: Bakes and beans
description: One of the most popular eatery joints.

name: Barista
description: Where you can sit, relax and have coffee with a great ambience.

name: Dhoda Sweets
description: A famous sweet shop.

name: Friends Dhaba
description: Small restaurant with ordinary ambiance but very popular with locals. It serves authentic Punjabi food from last 30 years. It's always overcrowded but service is quick

name: Jhandu Di Hatti
description: A famous poorie shop in Chaura Bazar.

name: Khushi Ram & Sons
description: One of the oldest eateries popular in the entire state. It has a branch on the NH95 which attracts many food lovers.

name: Bake Fresh
description: Provides delicious cakes and other bakery items.

name: Maharaja Regency
description: A 3-star hotel on main Ferozpur Road. Major malls are for a few minutes walk.

name: Hotel Taksonz
description: Often fully booked.

name: Hotel Park Plaza
description: The only five-star hotel in Ludhiana. It is part of the Radisson Hotel Group.

name: Gurudwara Charan Kanwal
description: A shrine dedicated to Guru Gobind Singh (1666 - 1708). The main building stands in a large garden that was watered during its heydays.

name: Fateh Burj
description: Fateh Burj is the tallest victory tower (minaret) in India, at 328 feet tall.

name: Gurudwara Amb Sahib
description: A historical shrine commemorating the visit of 7th Guru of Sikhs.

name: Lalan Wala Peer
description: An Old Dargah

name: Musical Fountain Floral Garden
description: Located in the Floral Sculpture Garden

name: Inderjit Singh Bindra Stadium
description: Built in 1993, for the time being this hosts Punjab Kings in the Indian Premier League, but they are expected to move to Maharaja Yadavindra Singh Stadium in Mullanpur, Chandigarh. The ground (capacity 45,000) has unusually low-set floodlights to avoid dazzling aircraft at nearby Chandigarh airport, but its main problem in that it's hemmed in by housing.

name: Nurpur Fort
description: Fortress built by the Pathania Rajputs, more than 900 years ago. It was damaged due to the great earthquake which struck this region early in 1905 AD. It is quite famous in North India, and the temple inside attracts tourists from all across India.

name: Shahpurkandi fort
description: The fort is one of the main attractions of Pathankot city. It was built in 1505 AD by a Rajput chief, by the name of Jaspal Singh Pathania. It was strategically located to have control over the Kangra and Nurpur region. The fort is in ruins, and is famous for its temples and the view it commands over the Ravi river.

name: Kathgarh Mandir
description: An important ancient Shiva temple 30 km from Pathankot towards Indora/Chanour (HP). During "Naag panchami", the gap between two shiva parvati holy stones reduces and during "shivrathri" the gap increases. There is no clue as to how that happens. But truly it' has a magic of its own. This temple is very historical temple. It is said that this temple was constructed at the time of Alexander The Great.

name: Makhan da dhaba
description: If you really love to eat spicy Punjabi food, then visit "Makhan da dhaba" near the railway line. It is very famous for its cheap and tasty food. It serves Dal Tarka, Channa Masala, Muttar Paneer and many more spicy dishes and any two people can eat good food for only ₹50. This may be among the cheapest and tastiest food in the area.

name: Moti Mahal Grand
description: Moti Mahal is the best restaurant in Pathankot with its lounge bar, terrace Moroccan open bar & restaurant & a party hall to cater parties up to 200 people, which is a branch of well known moti mahal restaurant of Delhi. Moti Mahal’s Tandoori Trail showcases great recipes, some inherited and some a result of experimentation by the author, which are as delicious today as they were 57 years ago. This is a collection of secret recipes offered to the lovers of good food and as a token of their loyalty towards Moti Mahal’s cuisine worldwide. Enjoy and savour each of them. Besides this treasure house of recipes, a picture gallery of unique photographs of Kundan Lal Gujral at several award ceremonies, as well as with various dignitaries including former president Zakir Hussain, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, Indira Gandhi and Kennedy.

name: Healthy Bites
description: A good fast food restaurant.

name: Honey Bun
description: It is a fast food restaurant and a bakery shop near Hotel Woodland. Its amazing ambience will surprise you. The prices are very reasonable. It is the best place in the town where you will get best value for money along with great eating experience.

name: Hotel Woodland
description: Dhangu Rd., in the heart of the city. With the finest restaurant, spacious and well equipped rooms it is the most obvious choice for most of the travellers. It is a two-star hotel, certified by the Hotel and Restaurant Association of Northern India.

name: Spice n Ice
description: Cuisine: Tandoori, Mughali, Indian, Chinese, continental.

name: Hotel Woodland, Fashion Street
description: A hot nightspot from the moment it opened, a dazzling venue decorated in a riotous collection of styles. It features a forest outlook and furniture design that looks like jungle safari. It is the perfect place for drinks, lively conversation, people-watching, and experiencing the undeniable excitement of the city.

name: Coral
description: One of hottest nightspots from the moment it opened. One of the oldest and best place to hang out. Especially in Summers. Prices as per the location are affordable.

name: Hotel Venice
