address: Paramara Road, Near Speciality Hospital, North Railway Station Area.

name: Thankam Tourist Home
address: St Benedict Road, Near the North Railway Station

name: K. K. International
description: good restaurant attached.

name: Hotel Excellency
description: Very near to South Railway station, this is a moderate business hotel. Very good interiors, a restaurant and nice staff.

name: Hotel Kavitha International
description: Clean hotel, very near MG Rd at the heart of city. 24 hr reception.

name: John’s Residency
price: ₹700 for a double room (also for one pax)
description: At the Ernakulam side, it's a very laid back place, where the check in is sometimes done by phone at the reception with the number to call. The fact that is on the Ernakulam side make it cheaper. It's not far from the train station (Ernakulam Jn.), the metro Maharaja College it's even closer, and the ferry jeti (to reach Fort Kochi) it's also at 5 minutes walk. They have double rooms and apparently one single room (which is always taken)

name: Banana Hut Hotel
description: Basic rooms, but cheap and kind hosts. Leaving your bag there during the day is possible and was safe.

name: AJ Residency
description: Near Kaloor bus stand at Kaloor Road and nearby Palarivattom Shopping district. It has the Rahamaniya tender Chicken Restaurant at ground floor.

name: Hotel Aiswarya
description: A good well maintained hotel with nice interiors and good hospitality in heart of the city.

name: Hotel Bijus
address: Cannon Shed Rd, Near Boat Jetty
description: Ideal hotel for budget tourist. A well maintained, clean and nice hotel.

name: Abad Plaza
description: One of the oldest hotels in town. There is also another hotel just behind which belongs to this chain. It has good restaurants, pools, gyms, spa, supermarket, bookshop and business facilities in centre of the city.

name: Avenue Centre Hotel
description: A good hotel in an upscale residential area with a multi-cuisine restaurant and swimming pools.

name: BTH
description: The oldest business hotel of the town, BTH is a popular option, especially among Indian families. It has good lawns, a large swimming pool and vegetarian restaurants.

name: Mermaid Hotel
description: Spacious rooms with river views.

name: Old Courtyard
description: An old Dutch bungalow, remodelled with modern interiors. Famous for lovely dinner parties.

name: Sealord Hotel
description: One of the first star rated hotels in Kochi and offers rooms at moderate rates. Has good restaurants and a pub.

name: Time Square Hotel
description: A business hotel.

name: Dreams
description: A premium property which is a sister concern of Times Hotel-New York, with all 5 star facilities.

name: The Gateway Hotel Marine Drive Ernakulam
description: Near the harbour with good sea views. Popular amongst business visitors and upscale tourists. It has very large pools, cafe, gardens and own ferry services. This is a 4-star property of the Taj Group.

name: Gokulam Park Inn International
description: A 4-star property in the business corner of Kochi. Has a good convention centre and a host of facilities.

name: Harbour View
description: Ideal business class hotel, with lot of premium features, in the main area of city.

name: Holiday Inn
address: NH Bypass, Vennala 33/1739 A, Chakkaraparambu Junction
description: 132 king bedrooms, 47 twin rooms; 18 deluxe rooms; 12 executive suites, 1 presidential suite and 2 specially able rooms. Tea/coffee makers, iron and iron board, separate work area; LCD, TVs, mini bar and safe. Restaurant, cafe, sports pub, pool bar, outdoor swimming pool, fitness centre, multilingual staff and business centre.

name: Adams Wood House
description: Four clean rooms with comfortable beds. The owner,and his family are very friendly and helpful. Free Wi-Fi, help with arranging trips inside and outside of town. Breakfast available.

name: Sherlys Casa Grande
description: Features a lake view.

name: Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences (AIMS)
description: One of the top 10 leading specialist hospitals in South Asia. AIMS is reputed for its cost effective complex treatments and latest medical care facilities. Reputed for its cost-effective surgeries, the hospital offers several specialised over-all general check-ups

name: Lakeshore Hospital
address: Near Maradu Bridge, NH Bypass, Maradu
description: One of the most high tech hospital in South India famous for its innovative, modern medical treatment. Has various specialised departments including cancer care treatment and bone/neuro treatment. The cardiac division has the latest facilities and highly qualified dcotors. There are 8 other specialist clinics. The hospital is well-equipped with all emergency services. Also offers comprehensive medical check-up services.

name: Medical Trust Hospital
description: One of the oldest Super Specialty hospital in heart of the city, this hospital is one of the most important referral hospital in Kerala. Famous for its organ transplant operations. Has the largest number of intensive care facilities in the state. It's a very crowded hospital but is well organised. This hospital is part of Rapid Medical Action Force and they have an accident care.

name: City Hospital
description: A good hospital, with accident care facilities. It is famous for its orthopedics and paediatrics department.

name: EMS Co-operative Library
description: A well maintained library where subscribers can register by presenting proof of identity(non-residents of Ernakulam will have to pay 50% extra on admission and annual fees). There are many subscription plans (₹50 as admission fees, plus annual membership fees starting from ₹100). This library also has a park near it, though it is not very well maintained.

name: Ernakulam Public Library
description: The Ernakulam Public Library is one of the oldest public library in India started in 1839. Books could be rented for 2 weeks for various rental options ranging from ₹60 for four books to ₹15 for single book. A refundable caution deposit is required ranging between ₹1,000-250 depending upon membership class. There is a free reading room with good collection of all national and international newspapers and magazines. Try here if you like read some of the treasured archives or original historical manuscripts.

name: Eloor Lending Library
description: A chain of private lending libraries. To become a member, you must pay a ₹1,000 deposit (which is refunded when you close your membership). A 14-day loan costs 10% of the price of the books you take.

name: Kochi Central Police Station
description: This is the main police station in Kochi.

name: Kochi Women Police Station
description: A female-staffed police station dedicated to assist female travellers.

name: Foreigners Registration Office-FRO
description: The city commissioner is the FRO, who has powers and authorization for any immigration issues. For any visa conversion, loss/theft of foreign passports, extension of visa, overstay of visa, immigration clearance, reporting a missing foreigners then report at this office.

name: Kerala Museum
description: A good, well maintained museum with a 40 minute light and sound show (English and Malayalam) about Kerala history. Depicts the history of Kerala through life-like wax statues. Adjacent are the Museum of Dolls with nearly 1,000 dolls from various countries, and M.N.F Art and Sculpture Gallery that has many good collections of paintings and sculptures. This museum has a small, well maintained garden.

name: Our Lady of Immaculate Conception Church
description: A parish church coming under the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Verapoly.

name: Kalamassery Mahaganapathy Temple
description: A temple dedicated to Ganapati and other deities, including Subramanian, the Navagrahas, Shiva, Parvati, Rama and so on. The temple has a simple construction with the original shrines of Ganapati and Subramanian (along with the Navagrahas) housed inside two concrete structures located side by side facing west. Between these two structures is located the stairs leading to the more recent elevated structure which houses the shrines of several other deities.

name: Thrikkakara Temple
description: A major centre for celebration of the Onam festival and the only temple in India devoted to the Hindu deity Vamana. Get here during Onam and you can catch ten days of festivities, peppered with performances of Kerala's traditional arts including songs, dances, dramas, musical instruments, apart from fireworks and elephant parades, and ending with an Onam feast. The makaram Ayyapan festival, Saraswati puja and other Hindu festivals are also celebrated here.

name: Lulu International Shopping Mall
description: A big shopping mall, consisting of more than 360 outlets including food courts, restaurants, family entertainment zones and a nine-screen multiplex, ice skating rink and bowling alley.

name: Four Points by Sheraton Kochi Infopark
Hill Palace Museum
price: Indians ₹20, foreigners ₹500 (including Deer Park and all attractions)
description: The erstwhile Kochi Maharaja's palace, now converted to a large museum with a small zoo. Has paintings and epigraphy from collections of Travancore and Cochin royal families. It is the largest archaeological palace in South India with more than 500 artifacts divided into 16 galleries. The highlight of the Palace is the display of multi-billion worth Cochin Royal Crown and Crown Jewels. The Crown Gallery is a high security zone with elaborate security checks. Photography and bags are prohibited. The Palace complex is huge with several buildings inside. There is a good Deer Park (10AM-4:30PM) which also has peacocks. A small fauna garden was set up in 2003. The palace has more than 100 different species of trees and plants of medical value. The palace has five large gardens and two large resting grounds of late Maharajas.

name: Chottanikkara Devi Temple
description: One of the 108 large Devi (Goddess) temples of India. The temple is famous for alternative treatments of various psychic disorders like split personality syndrome as well as for its annual Makam festival (mid Feb-mid March). It is believed to have 3 forms of the Goddess in 3 phases of day. Famous for its Navaratri festival.

name: Poornathrayeesa Temple
description: Devoted to Lord Vishnu, this was once the royal temple of Kochi Maharajas. This temple is famous for its panthizhuaari (milk dessert made out of rice flakes) distributed during afternoons and grand temple festivals twice in a year.

name: JT Pac Cultural Theatre
description: is one of the most modern and upscale performing arts complexes, which has regular concerts, drama festivals, dance programs and other arts and cultural activities. A 1000-seater theater, it also has a good gallery and latest visual-audio systems. Booking may be necessary to secure seats and the theater has strict dress code regulations.

name: Kalikotta
description: The official concert palace hall of the Kochi royal family who are patrons of more than a dozen cultural institutions and societies. Most performances are free. The mega Kathakali festival organised prior to Temple festival of Thripunithura Poornathresya Royal temple, is one of the largest Kathakali events here.

name: Nucleus Mall
description: The latest entrant to the Kochi's mall culture. A spacious suburban mall, ideal for shoppers to shop in hassle free area without worries of traffic and large crowds.

name: Crowne Plaza Kochi
description: Features two outdoor swimming pools, a spa, a salon, a 24-hour fitness centre, and multiple dining and event spaces. It also has a backwater pavilion of capable of accommodating up to 2000 guests.

name: Le Méridien Kochi
description: One of the most exclusive addresses in the city. It has a host of facilities, including a large convention centre. Near to riverside, it offers good boating facilities and has an indoor shopping complex selling luxury items.

name: Amaravati Stupa
description: The ruins of an ancient Buddhist site, probably built in phases between the third century BCE and about 250 CE. It has been considered one of the greatest monuments in Buddhist Asia, as well as the "jewel in the crown" of early Indian art. A lot of surviving sculptures from the site are now in different museums, including in Chennai, London and Amaravati itself.

name: Amareswara Temple
description: Serves Lord Amareswara, has a history of about 2,000 years.

name: Dhyana Buddha Statue
description: This tall statue of the Buddha in a meditative (Dhyana) position was completed in 2015 to celebrate the Buddhist heritage of the city in ancient times.

name: Lakshmi Narasimha Temple
description: One of the eight sacred places of Lord Vishnu in India. It is also known for being one of the eight mahakshetras Narasimha in India. The hill where the temple is on used to be an active volcano. It is at an altitude of above the sea level. Here at the temple, jaggery water is offered to the lord by the devotees. According to the ancient scriptures, the lord has been worshipped since Satya Yuga (The first of the four yugas). In the downhill, there is another temple dedicated to Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy. It is said that Yudhishthira (Dharmaraju, the eldest of the Pandavas) installed the main deity in this temple. The temple has a very tall tower with a beautiful sculpture, which has 11 stairs.

name: Prakasam Barrage
description: Built across the river Krishna connecting this city with Vijayawada, Prakasam Barrage has created a panoramic lake.

name: Sitanagaram
description: on the banks of river Krishna with a vast sandy beach for recreation and leisure. The famous Someswara Swamy temple is situated here. According to the legend, Lord Rama wept here for Sita when she was abducted by Ravana, hence the name Sitanagaram.

name: Undavalli Caves
description: These caves are said to have been carved in the 7th century AD. Buddhist monks used this two-storeyed cave structure as a rest house during the monsoon. A huge monolith of the Lord Anantha Padmanabha Swamy in reclining posture is a magnificent sight.

name: Pedavadlapudi
description: A sixth-century town, used to be famous for oranges. Now, it is very famous for curry leaves. Other crops like rice, cauliflower, bananas, flowers, and vegetables are the main crops. The village contains 75% Hindus, but there are also Muslims and followers of other religions.

name: Clock Tower
description: The Clock Tower is a historic structure at the centre of Anantapur town, built in memory of martyrs of the Indian freedom movement by the initiative of M. Ramachandra Naidu (then district judge) and other citizens. The height of the Clock Tower is which signifies the year 1947. The Tower's radius is which signifies the date 15th. The Tower has 8 faces which signifies August, the eighth month of the year.

name: Arts college
description: to see ancient architecture.

name: ISKCON Temple
address: Hare Krishna Land, Somuladoddi, National Highway No.7
description: 7 km from town. Built by ISKON in 2008.

name: Cheruvu Katta
description: This is holy place both for Hindus and Muslims. All the temples are located at one place (Shirdi Sai Baba, Ayyappa, Ganesh & Hanuman Temples)

name: Sarada Temple
description: It's a peaceful place and very famous.

name: BlooMoon Restaurant
description: An outdoor restaurant.

name: Bajjis
description: Famous restaurant in 1st road, near Police Training College

name: Biriyani
description: Spice touch

name: Dosa
description: Famous restaurant in I-Road Gurukrupa hotel, Sujatha Hotel, Indira Priyadarshini Hotel-near Clock Tower.

name: IDLY
description: Famous restaurant in Oldtown near to Krishna theatre, near Srikantam Circle.

name: LASSI
description: Famous restaurant near Medinova Hospital.

name: Oaligalu
description: In old town.

name: Poori
description: Opposite Emrald Restaurant..

name: Gongooras
description: At national highway towards Bangalore.

name: Spice Touch
description: near Hotel Sapthagiri Balla is also good.

name: Adi Murthi Tiffin Center
description: Famous for varieties of dosas.

name: Madhu Restaurant
description: Famous for North Indian dishes.

name: Komala Residency
address: Beside APSRTC Bus stand, Opp. Petrol Bunk

name: Amaravathi Lodge
description: at Raju Road.

name: Sampoorna Lodge
description: near Sreekantam Circle

name: Hotel Masineni Grand
description: 3 star Hotel in the central area of the city.

name: Jinnah Tower
description: Guntur's landmark tower, named after the founder of Pakistan. According to a legend, Liaquat Ali Khan, a representative of Jinnah, visited Guntur in the pre-Independence era. Khan was felicitated by Lal Jan, who is said to have built a tower to commemorate the leader of the Muslim League. It was erected on six pillars which open to a dome, typical of the then-Muslim architecture in the early 20th century. Originally unpainted, the tower was later painted in Indian tricolour in February 2022 by MLA Mohammad Musthafa.

name: Kondaveedu Fort
description: This historical fort was built during the reign of the Reddy kings in the 14th century CE. There are 21 structures in the fort. The ruins of the fort located on the hilltop offer unravelled mysteries to the tourist. A place of natural scenic beauty with natural wonders it is an ideal place for trekking. The Gopinatha temple and Kathulabave at the foot of the hillock, numerous temples, residential structures, pillared halls on the hill and the entrance gateways on the east and west sides are the attractions at Kondaveedu.

name: Uppalapadu Bird Sanctuary
description: The water tanks in the village are unique as they provide refuge to many species birds including endangered Spot-Billed Pelicans and Painted Storks. The bird population in these tanks used to be around 12,000, although lately only about 7,000 birds roost in this dwindling habitat through the year.

name: Viswa Nagar
description: This is the place of Sri Viswayogi Viswamji and the Universal Integration Pillar. It is an envisioned symbol of oneness of humanity. Also located here is the VIMS/Viswayogi Institute of Medical Sciences (Mother and Child Care Hospital).

name: Agasthyeswara Swamy Temple
description: The oldest temple in Guntur, dedicated to Shiva. As the legend goes, the sage Agastya built this temple during the Treta Yuga, centring around a naturally-occurring Swayambhu Lingam. Other than the legend, the temple has inscriptions in the ancient Naga script from 1100.

name: Manasa Sarovaram
description: Often called the "Central Park of Guntur".

name: The Chennai Shopping Mall
address: 6-19-18, Block No. 1, Lodge Center, Amaravathi Rd, Arundelpet
description: A good place to shop for clothing, especially saris, as well as jewellery.

name: Sri Venugopala Chenetha Vastralayam
address: Cloth Bazaar, Opp Gandhi statue, baskar deluxe road,Kothapet
description: Handloom sarees manufactured using traditional ways of hand-woven techniques. They manufacture their own sarees and sell them directly to the customers without any middlemen which makes the models cheaper than in the market.

name: Ananda Bhavan Hotel
description: Well-known for tasty and delicious vegetarian meals, and tiffins. Andhra style meals are famous.

name: Hotel Surya Mahabodhi
description: Famous for its delicacies. Especially the Vada Sambar variety they serve is a feast for your appetite. Also don't forget to taste Guntur Mirchi Bajji. You may get it elsewhere in AP also but the taste that you get in Guntur is absolutely matchless. Two more restaurants namely Nakshatra (a 3-star hotel, located at Lakshmipuram main road) and Grand Nagarjuna are very famous in Guntur.

name: Bismillah Biryani Point
description: This hotel serves authentic Guntur biryani. Its mutton biryani is special and its chicken biryani is also worthwhile. Also try side dishes of mutton and chicken.

name: Hotel Madras Bilal
description: Hotel Madras Bilal serves authentic Guntur mutton and chicken biryani.

name: Tonique Restaurant & Bar
description: Known for its cocktails. Has separate areas for smokers and non-smokers.

name: Embassy Hotel
description: Outfitted with 27 air-conditioned rooms.

name: Anjanaya Statue, Jagannatha Hill
description: Located in the outskirts of Kurnool (5 km).

name: Konda Reddy Fort
description: Remains of old Kurnool Fort.

name: Kotla Vijaya Bhaskar Reddy
description: Ghat on the banks of Hundri River in Kurnool Town, named after the former Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh state.

name: Orvakal Rock Garden
description: Small park with igneous rock formations and a cave museum. This site was used in the making of several Indian movies.

name: Shirdisai Baba Temple
description: The premises of the temple are very pleasant.

name: Tungabhadra River Banks
description: There are many temples along the banks of the Tungabhadra River. This river is heavily polluted. It flows through three states: Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Karnataka.

name: Sri Talpagiri Ranganadha Swamy Temple
description: The most famous temple on the southern bank of the River Pennar, the Galigopuram of the temple is 29 m high and has seven gold Kalasams. The most beautiful chamber of the temple is the Addalamantapam (mirror parlor), walled with high-class mirrors arranged at proper angles to reflect only the deity seated in an elevated ornate seat for the Lord in the centre.

name: Bara Shaheed Dargah
description: Located on the banks of the Swarnala Cheruvu lake. The shrine is dedicated to twelve martyrs (Sufi saints/warriors) who are believed to have sacrificed their lives in battle centuries ago. It stands as a profound symbol of communal harmony, drawing millions of devotees across all faiths, backgrounds, and nationalities.

name: Damerla Ramarao International Art Gallery
address: Between Godavari Railway Station and Gokavaram Bus Stand
description: Art gallery of a famous artist Damerla Ramarao now managed by State Government of Andhra Pradesh.

name: Rallabandi Subbarao Archaeological Museum
address: Gowthami Bund Road, Opposite Thyagaraya Kala Samithi

name: Vijayas Designers
address: 79-17-5/8, Raja Street, Near Tilak Road Sai Temple
description: Exclusive designerwear store for women. Prices vary. Mostly the collection is ethnic wear, hand crafted, bridal collection and party wear.

name: Nameless South Indian Breakfast Joint
description: Very busy place in the mornings. Deep inside the market. Only locals know. Nice way to explore the streets early in the morning. Local South Indian Breakfast.

name: Amma Homemade Tiffins Non veg
address: shop front and back, Sri Rajarajeshwari Plex, Sri Valli Plex, Jampet, Rajamahendravaram, Andhra Pradesh 533101
description: Non-vegetarian South Indian breakfast. Chicken, kheema, paya, and prawn curries with idly, dosa and parota. They do mutton biryani on Sundays.

name: Green Park Family Restaurant
description: Danavaipet, Rajahmundry.

name: Gangaraju Kova
description: Milk kova and putharekulu.

name: Rose milk center
description: Famous for its rose milk and kova.

name: Laxman Rao Bajjila Bandi
description: Water luring bajjis of different varieties of vegetables like potato, chilli, brinjal, tomato, capsicum and also famous for paper, boondi, and pakodi.

name: Satish
description: Bajjis, such as brinjal, mirchi, capsicum and some spicy stuff.

name: Anand Regency
description: 3-star hotel within the city. Vegetarian and multi-cuisine restaurants, a bar, WiFi and a gymnasium.

name: Hotel Shelton Rajamahendri
description: 3-star hotel in the commercial district.

name: River bay
description: Resort on the banks of the Godavari River. Primarily for leisure travellers. Restaurants, boat rides on the river, swimming pool, gymnasium and a small water park.

name: Tirupati Central
description: This is a major railway station in the South-Central Railways system. There are direct trains from nearby metro cities of Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad and others.

name: Chandragiri Fort
description: This fort was built in the 11th century. This site features stucco work and abundance natural light. The fort hosts a sound and light show twice a day in English and Telugu. There is a Hanuman Temple at the entrance of the fort.

name: Govindaraja Swamy Temple
description: This temple is a few blocks north from the Tirupati train station.

name: Kapila Theertham Falls
description: This is a holy waterfall with a temple dedicated to Venkateshwar near its base. To see the full glory of this waterfall, visit during the monsoon season when the falls are at their fullest. It can be a disappointing visit if there is not much water flowing over the falls.

name: Sri Venkateswara Zoological Park
description: Asia's second largest zoo, with an area of 5,500 acres. It is built on the concept of Hindu mythology and exhibits only animals that are mentioned in ancient epics.

name: Tiruchanur
description: Tiruchanur is the abode of Goddess Padmavathi Devi. It is 5 km from Tirupati.

name: Mukkoti
description: This is Sri Agastheeswarar Swamy (Shiva) Temple along with Goddess Aanandavalli. It's near Kaloor village which is around 12 km from Tirupati.

name: Sri Venkateshwara Museum
description: The museum features a collection of temple architecture and historical artifacts, such as ancient weaponry, pooja items and idols. It has a photo gallery that gives insight into the region's culture and traditions. It also has a meditation center.

name: Talakona waterfall
description: The highest waterfall in Andhra Pradesh, with a 270-feet (82-m) fall. Near the falls is the Lord Siddheswara Swamy Temple.

name: Venkateswara Temple
description: Millions of pilgrims from all over India and abroad visit the temple of Venkateswara throughout the year. It is regarded as one of the most ancient temples. One can avail free meals at the Tarigonda Vengamamba Annaprasadam complex near to temple. The simple meal consists of rice, sambhar (heavily dal/lentil vegetarian soup), chutney, rasam (light soup), and vegetable curry. The temple is one of the most sacred Hindu pilgrimage sites. Dedicated to Lord Venkateswara, an incarnation of Vishnu, the temple has rich history, spiritual significance, and magnificent Dravidian architecture.

name: Kanaka Durga Temple
description: This temple is on a hill (Indrakeeladri) overlooking the city and the River Krishna. One can either motor up the ghat road or take the steps on foot. Inscriptions of different dynasties are found in the temple. During the Dasara Festival, thousands of devotees come from the city and its environs throng to the temple after a holy dip in the River Krishna.

name: Gandhi Hill
description: The first Gandhi Memorial with seven stupas in the country was constructed on this hill at a height of 500 ft (150 m). The 52 ft (16 m) stupa was unveiled on 6 October 1968 by Dr. Zakir Hussain, the President of India. Gandhi Memorial Library, a Sound and Light Show on Mahatma Gandhi's life and a planetarium are the other attractions. A toy train journey will be a memorable experience at that height on the hill.

name: Bhavani Island
description: Bhavani Island is on Krishna River close to the city. AP Tourism is converting this 133-acre (54-hectare) island into a tourist spot and a river-front resort. The island offers some cottages to stay in and some adventure and fun sports. The journey to the island by boat is very pleasant.

name: Prakasam Barrage
description: Built across the river Krishna connecting this city with Amaravati, Prakasam Barrage has created a panoramic lake. Its three canals that run through the city give Vijayawada a Venetian look.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Park
description: Created by the Vijayawada Municipal Corporation with great care, this park is at the entrance of the city and features an impressive horticultural network. It also has a mini zoo and a musical water fountain.

name: Akkanna Madanna Caves
description: A group of 7th-century rock-cut caves dedicated to Shiva.

name: Mogalrajapuram Caves
description: Said to have been excavated in the 5th century, these caves are reputed to be the first of their kind in South India. The idols of Lord Nataraja, Vinayaka and Ardhanareeswara are carved here.

name: Bapu Museum
description: A place for archaeology lovers, Victoria Museum has a carefully preserved collection of ancient sculptures, paintings, idols, weapons, cutlery, and inscriptions.

name: Krishnaveni Mandapam
description: This is in front of Prakasam Barrage. It was constructed by Vijayawada Industrialists & Fertilizers Association. It consists of 4 rooms depicting the story of Krishna River and also statue of Krishnaveni. Krishna River on the bank consists of Bridge Museum, just beside the bus stand. Some more places to visit nearby are Swathantra Samarayodhula Samsthanam which too is beside Pushkar Ghat.

name: Gunadala Matha Shrine
description: In 1925, Rf. Arlati, the Rector of St. Joseph's Orphanage at Gunadala, installed a statue of Our Lady. Later, a church was built and consecrated in 1971 and is known as St. Mary's church. Since then, the Feast of Our Lady of Lourdes has become an annual event, attended by hundreds of people. The church is situated on a hillock on the eastern side of the city.

name: Hazarat Bal Mosque
description: A holy relic of the Prophet Mohammed is kept here and displayed once a year. A large number of non-Muslims join the celebrations, too.

name: Hinkar Thirtha
description: Hinkar Thirtha is a Jain temple. It is stated to be the biggest Jain temple in the region.

name: Sri Nagarala Sri Maha Lakshmi Ammavaru Temple
description: This temple is in the area of Chiitinagar. During the Dasara Festival, thousands of devotees arrive from the city. It is maintained by the Nagaralu Community.

name: Subramanya Swamy Temple
description: This temple is on a hill (Indrakeeladri) overlooking the city as well as the River Krishna. One can take to the steps on foot. During Skanda Shashti Festival, thousands of devotees come from the city. Some even come from as far away as Tamil Nadu. This Temple is maintained by the Iddipilli Family.

name: Besant Road
description: The busiest business area in Vijayawada. Near this road is a dense concentration of cinemas, shops and restaurants.

name: PVP Square Mall
description: This mall is one of the larger malls and houses many international brands. It is more akin to western style malls. There is a food court and cinema.

name: Mahatma Gandhi Road
description: This stretch of road that lays between Eluru Road and Frontage Road has a large cluster of shops both sides. There are several cinemas and large malls in this area.

name: The Chocolate Room
description: The Chocolate Room places an emphasis on a hip, modern atmosphere. Service can be slow, but this place is geared more towards those who are seeking a place to "chill" and be seen, not those who are on a lunch business meeting.

name: Hotel Anjaneya Vilas
description: This location serves authentic Andhra food in the Kaleswara Rao Market. There can be long lines but the food is often worth it. The thalis are priced around ₹30. Only vegetarian food is served.

name: Minerva Coffee Shop
description: The Minerva Coffee Shop offers purely vegetarian food.

name: Seven Days Café
address: #60-9-1/a Pinnamaneni Poly Clinic Road Siddhartha Nagar, 6th Lane
description: There are three locations in Vijayawada: one on Prakasam Road (this one also goes by Sarada foods), not far from Karl Marx Road; one on Museum Road; and the other on Pinnamaneni Polyclinic Road, close to 6th Lane. Serves coffee, cake, and pizza.

name: Silver Spoon Restaurant
description: A multi-cuisine restaurant both affordable and very hygienic. A 4-course meal for 2 cost less than $10 or ₹400.

name: Sweet Magic
description: A candy and cake maker with attached restaurant. This is a decent place to purchase traditional Indian sweets. The staff can sometimes be a bit dismissive. The restaurant part is well decorated and clean. The food is nothing special but the quality is consistent.

name: Tycoons Bar and Restaurant
address: No. 40-8-19A, Near Dr. Ravi Hospital, Mogalarajpuram, Shanti Nagar, Labbipet

name: Rusted Spoon
address: Jasti Venkata Ratnam St, Opposite Manor Food Plaza, Moghalrajpuram, Sidhartha Nagar, Labbipet
description: This is more like a fine-dining restaurant. It is a multi-cuisine restaurant that specializes in fusion cuisines. The ambience is upscale and clean. Try their makhani pizza, bhatti ka murgh and nalli biryani.

name: Café Coffee Day
description: No bathrooms for customers.

name: The Gateway Hotel
description: A Taj-group hotel.

name: Innotel Hotel
address: Beside Ramavarappadu Ring, Eluru Road, Gunadala

name: Dolphin's Nose Lighthouse
description: A lighthouse providing an aerial view of the port and the city.

name: Kailasagiri
description: The ride to this hill offers a spectacular view of the sea. There is a park atop the hill, with a beautiful view of the city, the sea and Eastern Ghats merging into the sea. Sagar Nagar Beach and Rushikonda Beach are on the right and left-hand sides. There is a colossal statue of the couple Shiva and Parvati. One can take a ropeway directly facing the sea and the city. On the hilltop, there is a beautiful toy train offering a tour of nature. Several viewpoints give a pleasant look at nature, especially in the evening, when the city is lit up. This is less commercial than other hill stations and there is less hassle from tourist guides. There are several points from which the beautiful rocky beach down beneath can be seen. This provides spectacular views of sunrise, sunset and the pristine waters. Many movies were shot here. Hillocks in the park, which are about in elevation, give a beautiful view of the sea, beach road and the beach park. The hilltop includes a children's play area, a doll museum and a couple of eating areas. It has several viewpoints offering wonderful views of the city on one side and winding beaches adjoining green hills on the other side.

name: Shilparamam Jathara
description: A crafts village showcasing and preserving the old, including woodwork, jewellery, clothes and local crafts of rural India. There are 36 stalls where you can buy assorted handicrafts and artwork. There is also an entire village where you can find realistic-looking sculptures of villagers carrying out their traditional crafts.

name: Hawa Mahal
description: A summer residential palace of the royal family of Jeypore, and one of the most iconic historical buildings of the city. The palace is made of stone with twin octagonal projections on either side. The wooden windows are framed by segmented arched openings and the high Madras roofing within the halls are extensively employed by Burma teak to ensure cool comfort during the scorching hot summers of the coast. The main structure has semi-circular arched verandas and the rectangular wooden windows in the central porch with ventilators leading into the palace. The building has sixteen rooms and a massive hall that hosted dinners and parties for guests.

name: INS Kursura Museum
address: RK Beach Rd, Kirlampudi Layout, Chinna Waltair, Pandurangapuram
description: A museum in a decommissioned submarine of the Indian Navy. This is the first of its kind in South Asia. This submarine is one of the earliest submarines procured from Russia. The experience of working in the submarine is explained. The museum is manned by retired naval people. There is a fee to take a camera or video camera inside.

name: Matsya Darshini
description: It has marine and freshwater fish. The exit gate of the aquarium resembles the open mouth of a huge white tipped shark. 'Kala Shrusti', a handicrafts shop, is atop the aquarium.

name: TU-142 Aircraft Museum
description: The first military aviation museum in India. It exhibits a decommissioned Russian Tupolev Tu-142 anti-submarine aircraft of the Indian Navy, the heaviest, fastest and highest-flying turboprop. It is possible to see the inside of the aircraft, and real engines are displayed.

name: Victory at Sea Memorial
description: This is a remembrance of the Victory at Sea in the 1971 Indo-Pakistan war. It is on the Beach Road, opposite the Submarine Museum. There is a fighter plane, a tank and few replicas of missiles kept as exhibits. There is no entry fee and it can be viewed from the road.

name: Visakha Museum
description: It houses the historical treasures and artefacts of Northern Andhra. Collections available for viewing in the museum include ancient armoury, crockery, coins, silk costumes, jewellery, stuffed animals, portraits, manuscripts, letters, diaries, scrapbooks, periodicals and maps.

name: Ross Hill Church
description: A house built by Monsieur Ross in 1864, later converted into a Mother Mary's Church. The pathway to the shrine is strewn with Catholic icons.

name: Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Temple
hours: 📵 Mobile phones and other electronics not allowed
description: This is an architectural splendour, although some of the sculptures were defaced during the Islamic invasions. The temple inscriptions date the earliest donors to the 10th-11th centuries. The exact date of construction is unknown. It is 15 km from the city and is dedicated to the Narasimha avatar of Lord Vishnu, which is his half-man, half-lion avatar. The temple bears reference to the Chola and Chalukya styles of architecture.

name: Thotlakonda
description: A collection of Buddhist monuments at the hilltop. It consists of a Maha Stupa, along with other votive stupas. It has a beautiful beach nearby.

name: Ramakrishna Beach
description: The most popular beach of Visakhapatnam where you can find the locals hanging out during the hot summers, and relatively less hot winters. On weekends and holidays, one can see that the entire beach comes alive, but not in a Western sense where people take a plunge in the water or surf. You can see people dressed in their best clothes, just sitting on the benches, or walking along. Take an evening stroll at RK Beach; it offers good pedestrian tracks, beautiful parks, museums, beaches and some wonderful open-air restaurants.

name: Rushikonda Beach
description: 11 km away from the city, this has become a popular tourist spot that even the locals frequent. A lot safer to wade into than the R.K. Beach, cradled among hills, this used to be an excellent beach away from the madding crowds. AP Tourism Development Corporation has a beach resort (Punnami) on the hillside overlooking the beach.

name: Yarada Beach
description: It is perceived as a private beach but actually it is not. Tourists can visit the beach directly or through the village. Yarada is the village behind the dolphin's nose. To go to this beach, a bus facility is available from Scindia junction. Also you can hire a cab to go there. The view of the beach and Vizag city from the top of the Dolphin's nose is memorable. The drive from Scindia to the top of the dolphin nose, dolphin nose to Yarada is really enjoyable.

name: Indira Gandhi Zoological Park
description: The zoo is home to native mammals like elephants, one-horned rhinos, tigers, lions, leopards, striped hyenas, dholes, sloth bears, gaurs, sambar deer and rhesus macaques, as well as exotic mammals like hippos, giraffes, zebras and chimpanzees. It also has birds including ostriches, rosy pelicans, grey herons, Indian peafowl and black swans. Furthermore, there are reptiles like crocodiles and gavials.

name: Kambalakonda Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A gorgeous nature preserve that many people in Vizag itself seem to be unaware of. Kambalakonda is uncrowded and peaceful and within 20-25 minutes drive from the city centre. A nominal entrance fee of ₹10 is charged per adult. The greenery, the hiking trail and the fantastic view of the ocean from the rather flimsy viewing tower give a welcome break from the hustle and bustle of the city.

name: Lumbini Park
description: Not to be confused with the one in Central Hyderabad.

name: Tenneti Park
description: A coastal park in the city, known for its scenery and recreational amenities. It is named after Tenneti Viswanadham, a freedom fighter and social reformer. Overlooking the Bay of Bengal, the park has views of the sea with the surrounding coastline and the cityscape. Its beauty and luxuriant carpet grass intertwined with concrete pathways make it ideal for romantic couples. Additionally, Tenneti Park is a destination for outdoor activities such as picnics, family outings, and photography, attracting both locals and tourists alike.

name: Jagadamba Centre
description: Most of the famous shopping centres and malls can be found here. Named after the Jagadamba movie theatre, one of the best movie auditoriums of the country when it was constructed and even today..

name: Joyalukkas Jewellery
address: Sampath Vinayaka Temple Rd, Near Sampath Vinayaka Temple, CBM Compound, Asilmetta

name: CMR Central
description: You can find Subway, KFC, and Pizza Hut here. Also a lot of shopping is possible, if you have money here, at Reliance Trends and Reliance Digital. Also one could see a movie if one has time at INOX.

name: Visakhapatnam Central
description: Most happening place is Visakhapatnam Central, where you will get all branded apparels, fashion jewelries, life style merchandise like watches, shades and color cosmetics. It is typical of malls which you can find anywhere in metro cities. Very expensive too.

name: Blue Sea Fine Dining
address: Pakkis Complex, Opposite ICICI Bank Road, Dwarakanagar 2nd Lane, Dwaraka Nagar

name: Eleven
description: This is one of the best new restaurants opened for Fine Dining. Food is value for money and tasty. They probably serve the best food in Vizag.

name: Flying Spaghetti Monster
description: The 'Flying Spaghetti Monster' a.k.a. FSM is Vizag's first authentic Italian restaurant. Great place with amazing Italian fare. Be sure not to miss out the Chocolate bomb.

name: Hotel Jabilly Beach Inn
description: All rooms face the sea, pure Bengali food is available.

name: Nihuusravee Home Foods
description: Traditional home food.

name: Vihar
description: Best hangout place with friends, only concern is it was too far from the city. Even though, worth visiting "Offshores" at Vihar. There's an Awesome beach view from the middle of the hill.

name: Beach View Guest House
address: RK Beach main road, besides Novotel Hotel (Varun Beach)
description: All rooms face the beach. Wi-Fi available.

name: Fortune Inn Sree Kanya
address: 34 & 35, Dwarakanagar, Diamond Park, Sree Kanya Rd

name: Hotel Daspalla
description: Complementary breakfast, free WiFi, four restaurants and wheelchair accessible.

name: Hotel Saraswathi Orchid
address: #30-15-193,Opp: Dolphin Hotel Garden Gate, Main Road, Dabagardens

name: Welcomhotel by ITC Hotels, Devee Grand Bay
QualityInn Ramachandra Hotel
description: 3-Star Hotel

name: Bhadrachala Rama Temple
description: Is the main temple complex and the abode of Lord Sri Ram – it also has smaller temples of other gods and goddesses. Temples of Lord Shiva, Panchamukha Anjaneyala and Narasimha are quite close by. The temple is kept open from 4AM in the morning for Suprabatha Seva, rests till 8AM and reopens to stay till 1PM. The temple usually remains closed during the noon hours, and reopens in the evening at 4PM. The temple will be closed in the night after the last pujas (Pavalimpu Seva) are performed by 9PM.

name: Sai Bhaktha Nivas
description: You can have accommodation provided by the temple with 7 rooms, with a kalyana mandapam attached to it

name: Elgandal Fort
description: Elgandal Fort is a historic hilltop fortress situated on the banks of the Manair River in the Elgandal village near Karimnagar. It serves as an architectural testament to the Deccan region's multi-dynastic past, having changed hands across five different empires over several centuries

name: BB Zarda Co
description: It has a very famous history been there since Nizams. It was established in 1935 by Bhoga Mallaiah.

name: Garshakurthy Village
description: Garshakurthy is famous for Nizam's Khila. Temples: Sri Venkateswara temple, Markandeya temple, Hanuman temple. Parvati Lake is famous for boating and is a joyful place for friends.

name: My village
description: My village restaurant is very good with moderate prices

name: Khammam Fort
description: This fort was built by Kakatiya rulers and was managed and extended by Nizam. It offers a nice view of Khammam town. There are steps constructed to facilitate climbing.

name: Narasimha Swamy Temple
description: This temple of the "Narasimha Swami" deity is quite famous and also the reason for the name of "Khammam". On a hill top, it offers nice views especially in the evenings. The hill top is accessible by car.

name: Danavaigudem Park
description: Danavaigudem Park is a picnic spot on the banks of Munneru river. You can check out the drinking water supply plant here, and you could also have a nice walk crossing the river on the dam, depending on the flow conditions.

name: Tank Bund
description: An evening at Tankbund near sequel resorts is a good pastime.This place is also used as walkers park in the morning.

name: Aziz Galli
description: Aziz galli is quite famous among young women for getting their dresses tailor made. This shopping street also allows you to buy small accessories for women. It also includes a whole sale market for fancy items.

name: Gandhi Chowk
description: The centre for jewellery market.

name: Kaman Bazaar
description: Famous for shopping clothes, bangles and footwear.

name: Kaspa Bazaar
description: General stores and fruit market.

name: Wyra road
description: This road has brand outlets of Pepe, Reebok, Adidas and Reliance Trendz.

name: Krishna Bar and Restaurant
description: Locally famous joint for people who booze. A lot of delicious snacks are served with drinks. Their Chicken Biryani costs ₹140.

name: Vishnu Residency
description: Well maintained place.

name: Nizamabad Fort
description: Built in 10th century by the Rashtrakuta dynasty.

name: Bhadrakali Temple
description: One of the oldest temples for Goddess Bhadrakali, believed to be built in 625 AD by King Pulakeshin II of Chalukya dynasty.

name: Rayaparthy Shiva Temple
description: Built in the 18th century.

name: Siddeshwara Temple
description: Built in the 3rd century.

name: Thousand Pillar Temple
description: Renovated in 2004.

name: City Grand Hotel
description: Offers well-furnished and comfortable air-conditioned rooms.

name: Hima Residency
description: Located near to National Institute Of Technology.

name: Hotel Landmark Residency
description: A 3 star hotel in Warangal, one of the few upscale hotels around, which in addition to the 3 in-house restaurants, also carries 2 banquet halls for official meetings and parties. Its features include king-size beds, flat screen TVs, elegant interiors, centralized AC's, exemplary service.

name: Kaulas Fort
description: A historic fort constructed by the Rashtrakutas in the 9th century. It later came under the rule of Chalukyas of Badami, the Kakatiyas, Musunuri Nayaks, the Bahmani Sultanate, Qutub Shahis, Mughals, Marathas and the Nizams. It has historically served as a strategic outpost contested by many kingdoms.

name: Jain Derasar
description: This temple is very calm and quiet temple. Allepey has a very small Jain population.

name: Karumadikkuttan
description: This is a 9th century black granite statue of the Buddha, locally known as Karumadi Kuttan. This statue is protected by the Archeological survey of India.

name: Marari-beach
description: A good destination for a day trip, it is about 16 km north of Alappuzha town. This area also has the Mahadeva temple and Arthunkal church. You can get here by local bus from the KSTC bus stand, get off at Maraikulam Junction (journey time: 20 min), and then walk 4 km or (better) get an autorickshaw to the beach itself.

name: St. Mary's Church
description: Alleppey has a high percentage of Christians. St. Mary’s Church (Champakulam) is believed to be one of the seven churches established by St. Thomas.

name: Sreekrishna Swamy Temple
description: This temple was built in the 15th century. Of interest here is an extremely distinctive Paal-Payasam (a sweet milk dessert made out of rice, with jaggery, in milk). Its recipe is a well guarded secret. It's believed the same cooks cannot reproduce the same taste using same ingredients, anywhere, because of a special blessing given by the Lord to his favorite kitchen. Definitely try some if you are somewhere near this temple. This payasam is distributed everyday, exactly at 12:00 Noon. Only those who have a prior booking are allowed to partake. You can get one from the stall just outside the temple.

name: Alleppey Beach
description: A fairly large, flat and clean beach. An old pier, which was at one point used for trade and had three railway lines, still stands. Stroll along the beach promenade, have a drink and some food in the "Indian Coffee House" and an ice cream or peanuts from one of the stalls. Locals enjoy playing frisbee and volleyball. Camel and pony rides are available. However, swimming is not recommended unless you are a strong and experienced swimmer. The water is very deep and the current can be very strong. These currents are stronger during and after the monsoon season. Sun tanning might not be a good idea considering that the locals are quite conservative.

name: Krishnendu Ayurveda Wellness Center
description: Ayurveda centre. It is run by a traditional family of ayurvedic doctors. The hospital and spa are constructed in Kerala traditional architecture style but contains a modern facility. There is a landscaped herbal garden that you can stroll in. You can also visit their herbal medicine manufacturing plant to see how these traditional medicines are prepared.

name: Nehru Trophy Snake Boat Races
description: - Alappuzha is known for its Snake Boat races. Held on the second Saturday of August, the competition is named after Jawaharlal Nehru who inaugurated the event in 1952. These boats carry approximately one hundred persons. Boats are available for rent for spectators during the event.

name: Village visits by ferry
description: Try Kainakkary, a short distance from Viluakkuthara.

name: Indian Arts & Crafts
description: Charming shop which has a good choice of jewels, chals and other Indian souvenirs. Nice and reliable staff.

name: Biju
description: The houseboats are used as grain barges alongside the backwaters. At some time, the houseboats were used as living quarters by the royalty. Converted to accommodate tourists, the houseboats have become floating cottages having a sleeping area, with western-style toilets, a dining area and a sit out on the deck. Most tourists spend the night on a houseboat. Food is cooked on board by the accompanying staff – mostly having a flavour of Kerala. The houseboats are of various patterns and can be hired as per the size of the family or visiting group.. houseboats are motorised but generally proceed at a slow speed for smooth travel. All houseboats have a generator and most bedrooms are air-conditioned.

name: Cafe Paradiso
description: Italian coffee, masala tea.

name: Chakara Restaurant
address: Alappuzha Bypass Rd, Sea View Ward, 2
description: The restaurant at Raheem Residency is the most expensive place in town but the meals are worth the price. The menu is creative and combines elements of traditional Keralan and European cuisine. Wine is available.

name: Dreamers
description: This restaurant is located on the beach, a little south of Harbour restaurant. It offers well-priced Indian food, with some European dishes. The staff are helpful and are often very willing to get you drinks not listed on the menu if you request. There is a fantastic bamboo raised terrace, get a table there for view and atmosphere to accompany your meal. Their website is terrifying, the restaurant is not.

name: Himalaya Bakery
description: Great baked items such as puff pastries with vegetarian or non-vegetarian filling, tasty samosas and also sweets. There is also a little cafe attached, that serves coffee and chai. Their banana and walnut cake (to take away) is particularly delicious!

name: Hotel Brothers
description: Their specialties are the hopopers and eggy onion curry.

name: Indian Coffee House
description: There are two main Indian Coffee Houses in Alleppey: one in the centre and one at Alleppey beach. They have the same menu (the same as the rest of Kerala in fact) and serve cheap, tasty south Indian food, ice cream and, of course, their signature coffee.

name: Kreamkorner
description: This place has two locations: Mullackal Road and Cullan Road. The atmosphere and decor have an "art house" feel to it. There's a multicultural menu with tandoori choices, and the cold coffee with ice-cream beats a frappuchino any day.

name: Premier Bakery
description: Established in the year 1962, serves all type of baked food. Well known for our home made fruit salad with ice cream, variety coconut cookies.

name: Ramada hotel
description: High quality food, Indian and continental options, in an elegant ambiance. Service is optimal. Price is slightly higher than in other places, but remains reasonable.

name: Raja Teashop
description: Famous for parottas, beef, pazhampori. Very good views of the backwaters.

name: Cafe Paradiso
description: Nice location with shady benches directly at the northern side of the main canal (about where the boat parking zone ends). They offer real coffee (not instant), juices, lassi and snacks. Iced coffee with explicitly safe ice is also available.

name: Aqua valley water & ice cubes
description: Water purification and ice cubes.

name: Abad Turtle Beach Resort
description: Abad turtle beach resort is spread across an area of 13 acres of land. The beach resort is located at mararikulam, a fishing village about 7 miles (11.6 km) from the heart of Alappuzha. The resort overlooks the white sandy marari beach and has a rivulet flowing on one side.

name: Arcadia Regency
description: As of April 2009, it is a decent and hygienic city hotel.

name: The Dreamheaven
address: Near Nehru Trophy Finishing Point, thathampally P.O.
description: Clean budget guesthouse with big rooms, located in a good location. Staff is helpful and smiley.

name: Harbour Restaurant
description: An attractive, laid-back beer and wine restaurant with a good selection of multi-cuisine dishes. Go for the Kerala Fish curry! Great! The fish is caught locally. Lovely to have a chilled glass of wine near the beach - the only place that offers it in this beach area. Mural on one wall by a local artist depicting beautiful snapshot scenes from the area.

name: Hotel Royale Park, a three star category hotel
description: Located in the heart of Alappuzha Town, it is opposite to Seemati Theater and Vireyya Theater. The hotel having 35 rooms, you can have A/C, Non A/c, Deluxe Rooms, there are Marvelous Restaurants, Coffee Shops, Executive Bar. Foods are just tongue melting, you can arrange board meetings, and business meetings for more than 100 people.

name: Kerala Houseboats
description: Located at Punammada jetty, offers one- and two- bedroom houseboats for cruising between Alleppey and Kumarakom.

name: Lemon Tree Vembanad Lake Resort
description: The resort offers 27 luxury rooms and suites; and a premium two bedroom air-conditioned house boat with an upper deck jacuzzi (The Cruising Villa) anchored at the resort’s private jetty.

name: Mandala Beach House & Cottages
description: Mandala is a little house situated on the Alleppey beach. The staff is friendly and makes you feel that you are a part of our family. They offer BBQs & bonfires on the beach, and can organize trips on backwaters. The rooms are not very cozy, but it's clean and the mattresses are soft. There are two cottages and one of them has an excellent view of the beach.

name: Saj Home
description: Chungam. Independent cottages. Cottage is well furnished with a/c and nice vast greenary around with water front on Punnamada lake.

name: Palmy Residency
description: Rooms are relatively spacious, very clean and well maintained. The staff are very friendly, and can also arrange backwater barge trips which come highly recommended, both for their comfort and relative inexpensiveness.

name: Panoramic Sea Resort
description: Panoramic Sea resort is opposite the beach. Here you can also have Panchkarma Ayurveda treatment.

name: Punnamada Lake Resort
description: A beautiful resort on the bank of Punnamada Kayal [Lake], with its own house boats.

name: Venice of East Houseboats
description: Houseboat stays and other water cruise services that make journeys into the backwater villages (kuttanad) throughout the year.

name: Zostel Alleppey
address: Alleppey Beach Road, Sea View Ward, Padinjare Kurisadi, Kanjiramchira
description: Laidback backpackers' hostel by India's backpacker hostel chain Zostel. Hammocks in their rooftop area with sea breeze. All guests must be of at least 18 years of age to be able to check-in at Zostel. Zostel do not recommend families to stay with them.

name: Chembra Peak
description: Standing tall at 2100 m, the Chembra Peak is the highest peak in Wayanad, and a favorite trekking spot. It is part of the Western Ghats. The trek to the top can take up to 2 hours. The heart-shaped lake on the peak forms one of the attractions for the mountain trek here. To do the trek, you need to pay an entrance fee from the entry guard house near Meppadi. Typically, start the trek in the morning as you are not allowed to start the trek after noon. If you are not game for a hectic 2-hour trek, you can still do a flat trek till a nearby viewpoint and visitors center for a nominal fee. The Chembra Peak area has a variety of orchids and other flowering plants, and plenty of bird species, making the trek an enjoyable experience. Good toilets are available near the guard house. The road leading to the entrance was in bad condition as of October 2017.

name: Vavul Mala
description: Vavul Mala is a peak in the Western Ghats in the Vellarimala range. It towers to a height of 2,339m. The peak is accessible via an 11 km-long trek. The trek route passes through multi-tiered forest canopies that often completely hide the sky.

name: Lakkidi View Point
description: Lakkidi View Point is a highly popular roadside vantage area known as the "Gateway to Wayanad," perched at an elevation of 700 metres above sea level at the crest of the Thamarassery Ghat Pass. It provides a spectacular bird’s-eye view of the winding, serpentine highway featuring nine sharp hairpin bends cuts through lush green valleys and steep mountain cliffs.

name: Attamala View Point
price: ₹300 for glass bridge and ₹50 for view point
description: Attamala View Point, often called the "Gavi of Wayanad" or Love Valley, is a breathtaking viewpoint known for its misty 360-degree panoramic views of deep valleys, rolling hills, and sprawling tea plantations. This spot is highly famous for hosting India's First Digital Glass Bridge.

name: Karappuzha Dam
description: Very scenic.

name: Pookode Lake
description: Pookode is a scenic lake spread over 13 acres and surrounded by greenery, with boating facilities. The Panamaram river originates from this lake. Blue lotus, lillies and many fresh water fish species can be sighted along the way. A rare species of fish named Pethia Pookodensis is said to be exclusively found here. A calm walk around the lake can also be done. Be safe while walking, as there are leeches along the way, so preferably wear shoes and take salt with you. There are good snack and souvenir stalls near the entrance. Monkeys can be a nuisance near the entrance, so be careful.

name: Soochippara Falls
description: Spectacular three tiered waterfalls in Vellarimala, surrounded by dense equatorial forest vegetation. Soochipara means 'Needle-like rock'. The 15-20 min drive from Meppadi offers scenic views of some of the best tea estates in Wayanad. The waterfalls are 200 m (656 ft) and offer a cliff face that is ideal for rock climbing. The waterfalls are a bit crowded at times. 32 lady volunteers of the VSS control the visitors. After the entrance, a walkway leads to a beautiful viewpoint. From here, approximately 200 steps lead down to the falls. The trek takes approximately 30 minutes, and sometimes requires negotiating boulder steps. The view of the falls is worth the trek. There is generally a guard posted near the falls. The climb back can be hectic. Soochippara falls is appreciably a plastic-free zone, so the entry guards will ask you to store your plastic bags at the guardhouse and reclaim it when you return. Plenty of eating and souvenir-shopping options are available near the entrance.

name: Thusharagiri Falls
description: The name literally translates to "mist-capped peaks", the name perfectly captures the ethereal silvery mist formed by water splashing down the rocky slopes. The waterfall originates from the Chalippuzha River, which is formed by two mountain streams, and divides into three beautiful cascading tiers

name: Puliyarmala Jain Temple
description: A very famous Jain temple dedicated to Anantnath Swami. It is a large temple complex, built in Dravidan-Hoysala style. Tipu Sultan used this temple as an ammunitions storage and stationed a large battery of arms and ammunitions inside this temple, which resulted in naming the city as Sultan Battery. A must see for tourists, with large number of Jain statues and sculptures and many relics in ruins.

name: Regional Agricultural Research Station
description: RARS conducts agricultural research on paddy, tropical fruits, spices and vegetables. It has a horticulture division which houses many rare ornamental plants and flowers. RARS was successful in developing 13 varieties of paddy. The area is well-developed for taking calm walks amidst the bridges, paddy fields and statues. A moon garden is located near the entrance. A fruit garden is under construction, and a children's play area is available. A mini birds park in RARS houses surprisingly rare, exotic and colorful varieties of birds, mainly fowl.

name: International Meditation Society of Wayanad
description: A small Buddhist Theravada Hall for Buddhist prayers and Meditation along with lectures about Buddhist Philosophy. Ideal for Buddhist tourists to have a meditation and Yoga sessions here.

name: Kalpetta Walk. 1
description: Start from Zodiac Hotel, head north, pass civil station and reach SKM highschool. Return through the bypass, Goodalayi road and go upto Meppadi road. Come back by Janamaithri Park side. (4 km)

name: Boating at Pookode Lake.
description: Boating can be done on Pookode lake for a nominal fee

name: Kalpetta Walk. 2
description: Start from Kalpetta Bus Station, head south towards on Calicut road, turn left at Jana Maithree Park toward Meppadi. Walk in the scenic road for three km and come back in the same route.

name: Learn Horseriding
description: The Veteriniary University at Pookode teaches horseriding to the public. Fee ₹5,000. Course duration 24 days (one hour every day).

name: Myladippara Trekking Centre
description: Myladippara is a cliff to the east of Civil Station, adjacent to the new NH bypass road. Trek to the Myladippara offers a charming experience. Beware of inconspicuously hidden leeches along the way.

name: Cheengeri Hills
description: Local bus services are available for transportation between Ambalavayal and Cheengeri.Kaduvakuzhi view point is very scenic.

name: Zara Botique
description: No parking facility

name: 1980s Nostalgia
description: A lot of parking space.

name: Indian Coffee House
description: Udupi style vegetarian. No parking facility

name: Kalpana Restaurant
description: No parking.

name: New Hotel
description: No parking. They are calling it 'new' since 1957.

name: Oottupura Restaurant
description: Lunch with Payasam noon to 3PM.

name: Swamy's Udupi Restaurant
description: Vegetarian restaurant, no parking facility.

name: WMO Qatar Restaurant
description: Best Beef Manthi in Kalpetta. They get the best cuts of tender beef and cook it in steam before frying it.

name: Uchayoon Cafe
description: Look for the cafe on the left side on Bathery Road. Mr. Vinodh and his familyl is running this cafe for 60 years. Only hot food is served. Vadukappuli Pickle is available. Uses onlyl home made spice powders.

name: Bungalow Cafe
address: New Bus Stand Building, front side

name: Green Gates Hotel
description: A three star hotel on a hillock. The in-house facilities include a games parlor with pool table, table-tennis, carrom, chess, darts, a state of the art fitness center, an Ayurvedic spa, children's play area, a garden and a swimming pool. The service at the hotel is good.

name: Harithagiri Village
description: Hotel and Ayurvedic spa.

name: Planet Green Plantation Resort
address: Manjilam Kolli Road, Chuzhali, Via KSRTC bus Depot
description: Inside a coffee plantation, surrounded by acres of tea estates. Rooms face Chembra Peak and green hills. The resort is built in estate house style on pillars in a sloping hill. There are two blocks consisting of five rooms each with separate entry.

name: Banasura Lake View Cottage
description: Free breakfast and dinner.

name: Wayanad Silverwoods Resort
description: Perched on a hillock on the banks of the Banasura Sagar Dam, set on 16 acres and provides a view of the Banasura Sagar with the Banasura Mountains as the backdrop. The resort has 34 cottages and 21 rooms with recreational facilities including a fitness centre, club house, Ayurvedic spa, infinity pool and kids' play area. The resort also has a convention centre, travel desk, parking, Wi-Fi and concierge and provides airport transfers.

name: High Speed Internet
address: Opposite Catholic Syrian Bank, Old Bus Station

name: Arakkal Palace & Museum
description: Samples of pre-colonial art and architecture, Moplah Bay is nearby.

name: St. Angelo's Fort
description: Built in 1505 by the Portuguese. Very good garden and view to the sea. Short footpath into the sea near Malsyafed office.

name: Valapattanam
description: Riverside village.

name: Science Park
description: The science park is a small facility containing displays of scientific and technological topics meant for school students.

name: Azhikkal beach
description: 2-km long footpath into the sea, fishing village. Beautiful garden and beach at Chalil village. Spectacular beach at Meenkunnu.

name: Drive in Beach, Muzhappilangad
description: 4-km-long beach with strong sand, the longest drive-in-beach in India. The village has about 24,000 people (2011). Another beach is available at Edakkad.

name: Southern Beaches
description: Spectacular and private beaches are available at Thayyil, Kizhunna and Thottada. Adi-Kadalayi beach is a very peaceful place. Popular with European visitors. Locals are absent. Direct buses are available from State Bank area.

name: Payyambalam Beach
description: Very crowded place and popular with the locals. There is no esplanade, but there is a pretty little park. You can sit inside the park and watch the sunset. The park is less crowded because there is an entrance ticket. There is a very big statue of a sleeping woman made of grass inside the park. There is a perfectly formed cliff near the beach where you can walk and take photographs and this area is less crowded in spite of being more beautiful than the actual beach. The lighthouse museum has old types of lamps used by lighthouses around the world on display.

name: Muthappan Temple
description: A temple which is unique in the whole of India, where there is no idol to worship, rather a ritualistic art-form (Muttappan Theyam) to worship. The temple is built in concept of Eternal Unity and Universal worship, and does have many legends. The Muttappan is believed to be a form of Lord Shiva, in a non-Brahmincal form, thus making it a general mass figure. Here regular performances of Theyyam are considered sacred and many unique customs are followed. Free food for visitors.

name: Mohyidheen Juma Masjid, Ayikara
description: A 300 year old mosque built under the patronage of Arakkal Royal Dynasty

name: Birdwatching
description: At Munderi Bird Sanctuary, near Varam. Many exotic birds can be spotted at Madayippara near Pashayangadi, 24 km.

name: City Esplanade @ Caltex
description: Start walking from Caltex junction. Proceed to the collectorate and turn right to old bus stand. You will pass the police parade ground, exhibition ground and the oval stadium complex building. After the Stadium complex, you can turn left twice and walk in front of the policemen's houses and again turn left to reach Caltex junction. The total distance to walk is 5 km.

name: Climbing a Hill
description: You can start from Thazhe Chovva bus stop and go beyond Chovva Railway Station up the hill. There are paved roads all around the hill, up the hill and down the hill. If you don't like such a steep climb, you can also access the hill from Marakkar Kandy village on the beach side. Please note that the locals here do not know that trekking is a hobby. They might stare at strangers but never attempts to interfere. But they are very helpful if you approach them speaking English.

name: Hill Walk
description: The hills and grounds around Sri Narayana College, Thottada are an ideal place for peaceful walking because there is very little traffic and open spaces are more in this region. You can access Kizhunna beach and Ezhara beach from here. The famous Muzhappilangad drive-in beach is another 3 km from here.

name: Island Walk
description: All coconut and areca nut. Beautiful bridge wide enough for a small car. Two more islands called AKG Island and Polthuruthy are nearby.

name: Rajayoga Meditation @ Brahmakumaris
description: Meditation centre. Free Sattvic food, meditation practice and lecture sessions. Beautifully furnished meditation hall upstairs.

name: Ride in the local ferry
description: Frequent passenger ferries are available from Azhikkode to Parassinikkadavu, Mattool and Valapattanam.

name: Trekking @ Pythalmala
description: Naduvil village. 1,450 m above sea level. Limited facilities are available on the mountain track. Look for leeches and wild elephants.

name: Water Theme Park
description: Vismaya at Parassinikkadavu

name: Tejaswini River
description: White water rafting.

name: Muttayappam
description: Well, some people consider eating the Muttayappam an experience in itself. Muttayappam is a kind of rice preparation in oil without adding any 'mutta' or egg into it. Only the shape resembles a huge fried egg. It goes well with chicken curry. It is not available in standard restaurants and you have to ask at roadside stalls. They have a tendency to disappear in minutes. This preparation originated in Taliparamba town, some 20 km from Kannur. This snack with a very plain taste can become quite addictive.

name: Sheen Bakery
description: Very reputed confectionery. Very soft and sweet bread is their specialty. But the shop is a little bit crowded and their service is not so poor. Their little branch inside Mele Chovva petrol station is not very crowded.

name: Stadium Complex
description: An oval shaped buildling near the old bus station. Excellent place to buy clothes and gifts. There are no restaurants here but you can find fine ice cream parlours.

name: Thavakkara Busstand Building
description: Many shops and bakeries in four levels. Several teashops, one vegetarian restaurant on the third level and one upmarket restaurant in a separate building. Paid parking facility. Very good place to walk around, sit and relax as this bus station is built in a spacious design. The reason for the quality of this bus station is that it is run by a private company. All other bus stations in Kerala are dirty and crowded because they are built and managed by the government agencies.

name: Lunch Packets from Karthik
description: Well packed lunch packets with prawn fry and chicken included. They pack everything on banana leaves with aluminium foils on the outside.

name: Kabeerkka Biriyani Packets
description: Lagoon Tender Beef Biriyani.

name: Acquaris Vegetarian
description: No parking facility.

name: Bharath Vegetarian
description: The best place for Masala Dosai, a fermented crepe made from rice batter, black lentils, potato and onions. ₹35

name: Grass Hopper Vegetarian
description: Paid parking facility.

name: Golden Dish Restaurant
description: With a peaceful attic section. No parking facility.

name: India House Vegetarian
description: No parking facility.

name: Indian Coffee House
description: No parking facility.

name: Komalavilasam Vegetarian
description: No parking facility.

name: Omar's Inn
address: North side of the Railway Station
description: Little cosy restaurant. No parking facility.

name: Thiruvathira Vegetarian
description: Crowded eatery. No parking facility.

name: Brownies Coffee shop
description: Favourite hangout of couples.

name: Dakshin Vegetarian
description: Good dosai and idlis.

name: Ranjith Restaurant
description: Lunch ₹50, fish fry ₹60, Kada eggs ₹60.

name: Odhens Restaurant
description: Famous for lunch with fish fry

name: Kailas Restaurant
description: Old style Kerala lunch cooked on firewood. Ginger pickles are also available.

name: Pulari Restaurant
description: Biriyani Parcels on banana leaves. Big portions are given.

name: Chiffonets
description: Exclusive Chinese & Tandoori dishes.

name: Cool Land Restaurant
description: No parking facility.

name: M.V.K. Restaurant
description: Good biriyani. No parking facility.

name: Othens Restaurant
description: Lunch only with exotic fish fry.

name: Paris Restaurant
description: Famous for biriyani, samoosa and banana filling.

name: Sagar Restaurant
description: No parking facility.

name: Silver Waves
description: For seafood.

name: Taj Restaurant
description: Hotel Taj. No parking facility.

name: Wheat House Vintage Restaurant
description: Beautiful period building with many private rooms for the diners.

name: Cabane Bambou
address: Near Govt. Guest House, Mill Road, Burnacherry
description: Seats on two floors.

name: Mascsot Beach Restaurant
description: Good outdoor seats by the sea.

name: Royal Omars International
description: South of the Railway Station. You will get chappathis cut into portions that can go into forks.

name: KTDC Loom Land
description: Chattichor Lunch.

name: Appoos Icecream
description: Air conditioned.
