description: A fort Which was built by Shivaji Maharaj near Ganesh Ghat at Kalyan, on the Ulhas river bank. Built in Under the Marathas reign (1760-72), a new gate about 70m to the south of the Ganesh gate was opened near the mansion of Ramji Mahadeo Biwalkar. Also here is the 'Eidga' Mosque.

name: Kala Talav
description: A famous & hostorical lake.

name: Lonad Caves & ancient Sun Temple
description: Caves as old as the ones at Ajanta and Ellora, on a hill near Lonad village. The Sun Temple is in the village.

name: Hotel Relish
description: Hotel Relish is a family restaurant and bar serving Indian, Chinese, Punjabi & Mughlai dishes.

name: Gurudev Hotel
description: AC/non AC

name: Kokan King Family Garden Restaurant & Bar
description: Konkan King also has a resort and water park to chill out with your family and friends. When it's the season, you can enjoy boating with a mini-train for your children, bird sanctuary and lots of amusement games. Specialists in Chicken Handi and fresh seafood. Grab some vadapavs late in the night till the early morning just outside the eastern side of the railway station.

name: Metro Junction Mall
description: Fast foody. 3rd level of mall is reserved for food court.

name: Prasad Hotel
description: 3½ star rated with high brand infrastructure and hospitality, service. Prasad hotel is near Katemanivli. Kolhapuri bhaji is most tasty food served here.

name: Relax Garden NX
description: This is one of the best hotels in town for dinner. 4 km away from the station.

name: Our Lady of Bethlehem Church
description: Built in 1613 this is one of the oldest churches of North Konkan.

name: Velankanni Church
description: Built-in 1544, ten years after the Bombay-Bassein coastal tracts were ceded by the Sultan of Cambay, Bahadur Shah, to Portugal by the Treaty of Bassein. The present structure is not old.

name: Dongri Fort
description: A fort in a dilapidated condition and is declared 'endangered'.

name: Ghodbunder Fort
description: Medieval fort built by the Portuguese between the 16th and 18th centuries. It was later occupied by the Maratha Empire and then served as the district headquarters of the East India Company. The word Ghodbunder literally means 'horse port' and the place was used for horse-trading between the Portuguese and Arabs. The fort is a protected monument under the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).

name: Uttan Beach
description: Mainly known for its fishing activities. It is not very clean. An early morning visit can provide an insight into the life of the local fishing community.

name: Keshav Srushti
description: A nature retreat of about , and a unified campus run by the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). The retreat is developed in the memory of the RSS founder Dr. Keshav Baliram Hegdewar. Several environmental orientation activities are conducted in the campus, with over 3,100 species of trees like teak, palm, ain, kinjal, crjun, casuarina, jamun, palas, Bamboo, Wad, Ashoka, silver oak, babhul, acacia, kadamb, shankasur, umbar etc.

name: Atal Setu
description: India's longest sea bridge, also known as Mumbai Trans-Harbour Link (MTHL). Named after former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, the bridge connects Sewri in Mumbai to Nhava Sheva in Navi Mumbai, across the Mumbai Harbour.

name: Durga mata temple
description: It has been rebuilt using Bansipahadpur marble. Architectural work design by Sompura. Carving work was done by famous Rajasthani temple workers. On the foundations, pure black stone is used, and for garbhagrah and kalas, pure sandstone. The temple's entrance is made by one of the famous garud design praveshdwar. The total height is 55 feet.

name: Mango Garden
description: Mango Garden, a must-visit place for couples and children. It is a small garden for almost all age group people.

name: Mini seashore, Juhu Chowpatty
description: Boating, toy train and lot of fun, bhel puri, pani puri, gola etc.

name: Parsik Hill
description: A very cool place on hilltop. People prefer to come here for morning and evening walk. Youngsters come here to have fun and just chill out. It is closed most of the times in the rainy season because of the landslide. A must to visit this place in evening hours if you are around. It is best to visit this place when the monsoon just starts. During this time there is an enchanting dew and also a slow waterfall often called the Pandavakhada waterfall.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Maidan
description: Lots of temples for doing Pooja and meditiation, and a good trek.

name: Rain Tree Marg
description: Has beautiful views of Navi Mumbai

name: Sarovar Vihar Garden
description: Like a second marine drive, provides a beautiful view of the sea, a drive from Vashi via the Palm Beach Road ends at Belapur

name: Seven Wonders
description: Park for all ages, it has the Seven Wonder statues. It is a huge park with joy rides. Water pool and fountains to view. Fruit shape huts to seat and take photos. Cool hang out with kids.

name: Pandavkada Falls
description: Monsoon tourist attraction for people from far and wide. Authorities are strict in not allowing people to visit this place in monsoon on account of accidental deaths in the waterfall.

name: Utsav Chowk
description: One of the most famous landmarks in the area and it stands out for its eye catching architecture which is a humble reflection of the Roman and Greek architecture.

name: Belapur Fort ruins
description: The fort was built by the Siddis of Janjira. It was later conquered by the Portuguese, and then Marathas. In the early 19th century, the fort was captured by the British. The deliberate damage wrought led to a decline in the strategic importance of the fort.

name: Dronagiri Fort
description: The ruins of the fortification are seen on the fort. There is a church Nossa Senhora da Penha in good condition, but without any idol or inscription. The church is in the inner fortification. The main gate to the fort is situated on the south of the church 50 m away. The arch of the gate is broken, yet the guards rooms are in good condition. The Ganapati carved on the key stone is placed in one of the guard room. From the main gate a path way leads south to the Village Karanja. In between a Vetal mandir in ruined state is located. The pathway starting from the back of the Vetal mandie leads to large water tank in good condition situated among the forest. The fort is accessible in all seasons. The trek to the fort is simple and safe. Being close to Uran and Karanja, the fort was strategic importance since old times. The entire hill is densely covered with forest.

name: Central Park
description: The project of Central Park is to make a public park with Navi Mumbai's ethos reflected into the future. It is under construction but is open to public. The large amphitheatre has hosted many public shows. An ISKCON temple is attached to this park. To the west of this park is Pandav Kada waterfall and CIDCO developed golf course.

name: DY Patil Stadium
description: The cricket stadium in the Navi Mumbai area hosts several international cricket matches and domestic championships such as the Mumbai T20 league and Times Cricket Shield. Wankhede matches in the Indian Premier League as well as Womens Premier League have been played at the stadium. The stadium also hosts international cricket tournaments and concerts.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Joggers Park
description: A hot-spot for joggers of all ages

name: Sagar Vihar
description: A cool place to chill out with friends; a must to visit during evening hours.

name: Inorbit Mall
description: Wide variety of brands under a single shed, wonderful place to hangout with family while shopping. variety of food here in food court. pub and bar at 3rd floor... must visit place. Try kareem's here in ground floor for varieties of chicken, mutton, fish and other non-veg items.

name: Little World Mall
description: Littleworld, Kharghar’s largest mall has it all. It is the new destination for everything that’s hip and happening be it; Fashion, lifestyle, entertainment and events. This mall has a carpet area of more than 90 thousand sq ft. It is a first-class place to hang out with loads of eye-catching discounts and variety of branded outfits. It has amenities like valet parking for around 300 cars, centralized A/C, automatic lifts, and smoke detectors for safety, stunning elevators, and power back up. It has exclusive shops of garments, jewelry, restaurants of delicious food and drinks and even a multiplex where you can enjoy latest blockbusters.

name: Sector 17 Vashi and Sector 9 Juhu Nagar
description: About a small drive from Vashi Station, these sectors on the way you get into Vashi are one of the most happening spots of Navi Mumbai. Sector 9 Juhu Nagar is a local market for all your home needs. While Sector 17 Vashi is a mini electronics marketplace and commercial place.

name: Bhagat Tarachand
description: Pure veg restaurant.

name: Flavours
description: Intercontinental cuisine. You can sit at the counter and enjoy your drinks (including the Bartender's Special).

name: Hot Cross Cafe
description: A very relaxing coffee shop where they serve a variety of hukka (sheesha) at a very minimal rate. One of the best places in Navi Mumbai for hukka and mouth watering and fresh pastries.

name: Hotel Ruchi
description: Possibly the best Keralite food you can find in the city. The restaurant itself is pretty small and unnoticeable but if you notice it, don't miss it. Try the Kerala Parotha with Chicken Masala and the idiyaappam and appams for breakfast

name: Jaslok
description: All sorts of snacks and sweets. Pani Puri, Vada Pav and Rasmalai, Jamun are the delicious items.

name: Nanumal Bhojraj
description: Damn good restaurant for Sindhi and Punjabi food.

name: Navaratna
description: One of the oldest restaurants in Vashi. It serves great food in the traditional Udipi style.

name: Sri Krishna
description: Good vegetarian food. Great watermelon juice! Home delivery available. Try the gadbad ice cream.

name: Tunga
description: Good place to eat. Excellent ghee chapaties.

name: Vasundhara
description: Pure veg restaurant.

name: Viscious circle
description: Mouth watering kebabs and non veg dishes, good ambience, drinks and a large projector screen.

name: Gupta's
description: Great range of toast sandwiches And pizzas.

name: Snack Attack
description: A cool place for snacks with a very different look and a very artistic architect. Wide ranges of snacks, and small cups of Oreo juice are also offered.

name: Celebrations
description: Business deluxe hotel with multi-cuisine restaurant, tycoon bar, and modern amenities.

name: Health Juice Center
description: It is on Vashi to Koper Khairne road. Nice variety of juice. Try once "Boom juice".

name: Ice'n'Spice
description: The Biggest lounge bar cum restaurant of Navi Mumbai.

name: Oven Hot
description: Lovely chicken and veg snacks, superb pastries, delicious frankies. They make any sort of birthday cakes you desire, any shape, any cartoon character. Ask them and you have it. They somehow make 1/2 kg cakes within 15 minutes. They make different kinds of breads and sliced breads and egg/eggless cakes (200 g each packaged ones. walnut brownie, fruit and nut, mawa, tutty-fruity, choco walnut, etc.) All in all, an awesome place for a small party.

name: Rain Forest
description: Great ambience, good music. It is literally a dark forest inside with huge trees. Expensive.

name: Rockville restaurant, hotel and bar
description: It's a good restaurant/hotel/bar in CBD Belapur.

name: Spices
description: Best non veg in KK.

name: Centr point
description: Pocket friendly and quiet decent.

name: Days Inn
address: L-1, Sector 19, Palm Beach Marg, Vashi

name: Hotel Apex
price: Single (Non AC), ₹700; Double (Non AC), ₹1100; Double (AC), ₹1300; Double (AC, Executive), ₹1700; Special (3 bedroom, AC), ₹2000
address: 15A Laxman Commercial Complex Opposite Mafco Market, Sector 18 Vashi

name: Hotel Three Star
address: Crystal Plaza, Plot No.18/27, Sector-7, Hiranandani, Kharghar
description: A good mid range hotel

name: Hotel Vishwa Sai
description: Has air-conditioning

name: K-Stars Hotels
description: A mid-segment business hotel at Belapur, Navi Mumbai (Maharashtra) just off Pune highway.

name: Royal Orchid Central Grazia
address: Plot # 67, L-3, Sector 19, Palm Beach Rd

name: Visava Amusement Park
description: Resort.

name: Bhavangad Fort
description: A fort built in 1737 by Chimaji Appa to check the atrocities by the Portuguese in Bassein (present-day Vasai-Virar). This fort played a prominent role in the conquest of Fort Bassein by the Maratha Army. Unfortunately, it is now in shambles and few remains of the bastion, fort walls, and the water cistern are seen on the fort. There is a temple of Bhavangadeshwar temple on the highest point of the fort. It takes about an hour to walk around the parapet wall and visit all the places of the fort.

name: Dativare Fort
description: The Fort is on a small hillock and at the commanding point for guarding the trade route along the Vaitarna River. Very little is known of the fort's history, other than that it was probably built by the Portuguese. The trekking path starts from the hillock north of the Dativare village. Now there is a very safe and wide road up to the fort. It takes about half an hour to reach the entrance gate of the fort.

name: Kaldurg Fort
description: The fort is at a height of at least 475 meters above sea level, giving views of the Arabian Sea and Palghar to the west, as well as views of the Surya River to the east. This rectangular shape of a fort can easily be located from a distance. There is no specific historic sign available except the fort structure. The fort is divided into the upper part and lower part due to a rectangular rock. There are a few steps that separate these two parts. It is a popular destination among hikers. The trek starts at Waghoba Khind temple on Palghar–Manor Road.

name: Kelve Fort
description: An island fort at the mouth of Danda Creek. The Portuguese built the boat-shaped fort to keep an eye on approaching ships. The fort is rectangular in shape. The entrance gate is east facing immediately followed by another gate at a right angle. There are four triangular bastions triangular on the four corners of the fort. During low tide, it is passable on foot but during high tide, local country boats provide access to the fort. The fort has never been more or less intact but overgrown with vegetation. It is better to visit the fort during low tide.

name: Kelwa Beach
description: Although not a very famous tourist attraction, the beach is overcrowded with local tourists during weekends, which indicates its growing popularity. Many restaurants and snack joints have come up near the beach to cater to the growing number of tourists.

name: Tandulwadi Fort
description: Tandulwadi is not a fully built-up fort, but a series of structures spread over the top of the mountain. The fort dates back 800 years and was primarily used as a watch tower over the surrounding plains. At a height of , it has views of the surrounding towns of Saphale, the Zanzorli Lake and the confluence of the Surya and Vaitarna rivers. Tandulwadi has a moderately difficult gradient and it takes about a half hour to reach the main plateau from Tandulwadi village which is situated at the base of the fort. To reach the highest point it takes another one hour. Upon reaching the main plateau, one can find several rock-cut water cisterns. There are no bastions, walls or houses on the fort. There is no evidence of fortification except for a small stone wall on the southern side. A small water pond is situated in the centre.

name: Kalwa Naka
description: A historical landmark and historically a meetup place, still used as a meetup spot today.

name: Masunda Lake
description: The lake is home to a small island with a Shiv temple on it and also a Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Statue behind it. It is one of the biggest lakes and ideal places to visit in Thane at night. This lake is situated just beside the famous drama theatre Gadkari Rangayatan. The lake also offers recreational activities like boating. Also, it offers people shops to buy fish (fish tanks) for home decoration. There are many restaurants and food stalls facing Talavpali Lake.

name: Shri Kopineshwar Mandir
description: It is one of the oldest temples in Thane. It was reconstructed by Chimajji Appa around 1750 AD.

name: St. John the Baptist Church
description: This church is over 400 years old. St. John the Baptist Church is adjacent to St. John the Baptist High School and Junior College.

name: Upvan Lake
description: It is known for hosting the Sanskruti Arts Festival. Here one can also view thousands of Ganpati idols which are brought here for immersion on the final day of Ganeshotsav.

name: Dadoji Kondadev Stadium
description: A sports stadium used mostly for training. Its main ground has been built for cricket with an in-built six-lane running track for athletes. The complex also includes 5 badminton courts, a gym, a table tennis hall, 2 squash courts, a billiards room, a rummy room, a hall, a bar room, and a canteen.

name: Suraj Water Park
price: Adult ₹800; child according to height: from 3'5" to 4'5" ₹650, below 3'5" free
description: An excellent water recreation paradise which appeals to people belonging to all age groups. Spread over 11 acres. Suraj Water Park is definitely an ultimate and out-of-the-world source of entertainment.

name: Tikuji-Ni-Wadi
price: ₹250 for entry and most rides, including in the water park (₹275 on weekends.)
description: A popular destination for picnicking families, known for its watersports, go-karting and other rides you'd find at amusement parks. The go-karting track isn't very good though. Additionally, there is a Shiva temple and marriage halls as a part of the resort. The lunch is fabulous, though fully vegetarian. You will also need to buy lunch for ₹180 as you can't carry any edible stuff in from outside.

description: Shopping mall

Hotel is especially for Chinese, Indian & Punjabi dishes. There is different kitchen for Veg & Non Veg Food, & main attraction of children i.e. huge Fish Tank.

description: Pan-Asian fine dining.

name: Hotel Sharanam

name: Hotel Tip top plaza
description: Has one decent restaurant and many banquet halls with adequate conference facilities.

address: Pokhran Rd No. 1, Opp Sighania School
description: Has a restaurant.

name: United-21
description: Four-star hotel with Wi-Fi connection and electronic safe facilities. Rooms for physically challenged persons are also available.

name: Vihang's Inn
description: Just over a year old, this hotel serves 32 rooms.

name: Hotel Alka Residency
description: Hotel Alka has a multi-cuisine restaurant.

name: Birla Mandir
description: One of the most beautiful temples, dating back centuries and a must visit, which is maintained by the Birla Group.

name: Swami Shanti Prakash Ashram
description: A Sindhi religious and spiritual center known for its architecture and carvings.

name: Arnala Fort
description: A fort on an island off Vasai-Virar. The main entrance of the fort faces approximately north. The solid stone doorway is adorned with pictures of tigers and elephants. There is a large octagonal fresh water reservoir inside the fort. Within its walls, are also the temples of Ambakeshwar, Bhavani and Shiva as well as dargahs (tombs) of Shah Ali and Hajji Ali.

name: Hedavde Mahalaxmi Temple
description: Very powerful Hindu temple founded by great astrologer, Param Pujya Dadasaheb Hate of Vasai.

name: Tungareshwar Temple
description: A Shiva temple in a strangely beautiful garden. In the dome, a trident (triśul) stands impressively against the horizon. The temple room was small but beautifully decorated in Minimalistic works of colourful glass. On one corner of the room there's a small temple of Devi. In the centre, there is the main Shivalinga with a Hug serpent in brass coiled around it. A brass post hangs above and water trickling down from it drop by drop over the linga. The temple also has some symbols of sacred geometry and the temple is designed as per Vastu Shastra.

name: Tungareshwar Wildlife Sanctuary
description: A migration corridor between Sanjay Gandhi National Park and Tansa Wildlife Sanctuary. It rises to about above sea level, making it a very popular destination for trekkers. Many bird walks, nature trails by wildlife professionals from around Mumbai and Vasai-Virar are conducted here. The terrain is a mix of rocky surface and flatland intermittently. Trekkers must make sure you carry along medical kit, and really good amount of water with you. Highly recommended to wear full sleeves clothes to avoid any bites, wounds, tans. Carrying a cap and sunglasses is a must to protect you from the harsh heat, as this route has less shade. There are two ways you can reach the summit of the Tungareshwar WLS, one being from Vasai Road West which starts from the main gate itself, the other one can be trekked from the region of Vajreshwari.

name: Vasai Fort
alt: Bassein Fort; Portuguese: Fortaleza de São Sebastião de Baçaim; Marathi: वसईचा किल्ला Vasaīcā Killā
description: Portuguese mariners exploring the north Konkan Coast discovered the Arab Sultanate of Khambhat or Cambay, built or renovated or expanded the fort in the early 1400s and attacked it in a failed effort to seize it. The ramparts overlook what is alternatively called Vasai Creek and Bhayander Creek and are almost complete, though overgrown by vegetation. Several watchtowers still stand, with safe staircases leading up. The Portuguese buildings inside the fort are in ruins, although there are enough standing walls to give a good idea of the floor plans of these structures. Some have well-preserved façades. In particular, many of the arches have weathered the years remarkably well. They are usually decorated with carved stones, some weathered beyond recognition, others still displaying sharp chisel marks. Three chapels inside the fort are still recognisable. They have façades typical of 17th-century Portuguese churches. The southernmost of these has a well-preserved barrel-vaulted ceiling. It is a great place to observe butterflies, birds, plants and reptiles.

name: Blu Spice
address: Shop No: 11, C-Wing, Jayraj Nagar CHS, 100 Feet Road, Off: Ambadi Road, Vasai (W)
description: A multi-cuisine family restaurant serving Indian, Chinese and Continental pastas and salads. It also serves non-alcoholic beverages, mocktails and speciality coffees.

name: Hotel Rainbow
address: Lawrence Trade Centre, Near K.T. Vision Theatre, Vasai road (W)

name: Vajreshwari Temple
description: A temple dedicated to goddess Vajreshwari, which is said to be an incarnation of Parvati or Adi Maya. There are around twenty-one hot water springs (Sanskrit: kunda) in a five-kilometer radius of the temple. According to legend, the hot water is the blood of demons and giants who were slain by the goddess Vajreshwari. Yu should have a holy bath in the springs while visiting the temple.

name: Kolaba Fort
description: A fort about 1km from the shore into the sea, reachable by foot at low tide (but not during the monsoon season). You can go on the island and roam around for free, but the entrance to the fort is by ticket only.

name: Revdanda Fort
description: A historical monument built on the Revdanda beach. Ideal place for pre-wedding shoots. The main entrance is from the southern side.

name: Kihim Beach
description: A beautiful coastal village and a weekend getaway for Mumbaikars. The climate of Kihim is very calm and unpolluted. There is parasailing on Kihim Beach but it is seasonal.

name: Mandwa Beach
description: A beach popularised by a Bollywood series. It has direct ferry services to and from Mumbai.

name: Fulora
description: The restaurant specialises in seafood although they also provide all kinds of vegetarian and non-vegetarian food.

name: Arte Cottage
description: Near Kihim beach

name: MTDC Holiday Home
description: There is a formerly MTDC run, but now privatized resort that offers fully furnished tents. Not available during the monsoons.

name: Prakriti Resort
description: Hillside near Kashid Beach. Offering Single rooms as well as 2,3,4 bedroom villas on the hillslope. Some villas offer good views of the Arabian Sea. Resort has a swimming pool with a couple of indoor games like table tennis, and a pool.

name: Golden Swan Resort
description: Near Murud Beach.

description: This hotel has good rooms facing the sea, also a nice restaurant and the food quality are good.

description: Economical resort in Kihim.

description: Good resort.

name: Bhumi Cottage
description: Bhumi Cottage is a 7 room property offering a large swimming pool, gazebo, and spacious rooms.

name: Bheema Devi Peeth
description: Bheema Devi Peeth is the latest addition in the tourist spot around Goregaon. It has spectacular stone temple of Goddess Bhima with beautiful surrounding of 42 acres (16 ha). You will have breathtaking view of Goregaon periphery.To reach the temple drive down to Purar Phata, take Ambet road, when you reach at the top of Ambet ghat, turn right towards Khamgaon/Shirke tamhane road, after 2 km drive on right is the temple complex.

name: Dr B A Technological University
description: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University is the only one of its kind in the State. The University is located at Lonere, the place in the ranges of Western Ghat, at the foot of Raigad fort, the place from where Chhatrapati Shivaji administered his major activities. It is autonomous in nature and Unitary in its character. It was established in 1989 by the Government of Maharashtra. Although relatively young, the university is making its mark in the field of research and technological services through its dedicated faculty and disciplined students.

name: Kaal River
description: Enjoy the beautiful view of Kaal river.

name: The Mallikarjun Temple
description: Temple of Mallikarjun or Siddhesvar is said to have been built about 800 years ago. The shrine is said to be self-originated or Svayambhu. Situated on the top of the hill, bounding the village to the north, it is 413 (125m) feet in height. The Ganapati temple has a building which though unimposing is only of its kind in India, for the fact that the shrine has its upper half of the body of a male and the lower half that of a female. Existence of sricakra marks another distinguishing feature of this temple. To visit this temple you will have to climb 400 steps on the northern side hill of Goregaon. You will also enjoy the panoromic view of the town and Kal River from this hill top.

name: Panhalghar Fort
description: Panhalghar fort is one of the fort from King Shivaji era. You will have to climb the fort. The water tanks are still visible on the top of the fort.

name: The Vithoba Temple
description: The temple of Vithoba is 200 years old and has fine specimens of sculpture and carving on the pillars.

name: Bus stop Roadside counters
description: Try tasty Wadapav, Dabeli, Panipuri and ice cream at dirt cheap rate.

name: Hotel Sanman
description: Favourate joint of local and travellers for nonveg food, beer and liquor. Try fish fry of kingfish.

name: Pansare Home made food [ pure veg mess]
description: Make sure to contact them before your visit, so that they can serve you on time.

name: Santosh Shelar Hotel

description: A cold drink hawker on Goregaon Shriwardhan Road.

address: 4/277, I.B Patel Road, Behind H.P Petrol Pump

name: Irshalgad
description: A not-so-large fort, reachable by treks ranging from easy to moderate. It takes 2 hours to ascend and 1.5 hours to descend. From Chouk, Nanivali, the starting point of this trek, is a comfortable 2.3 kilometres walk. From Nanivali, you should follow a wide well-defined path till Irshalwadi. The path climbs a steep ridge and then tapers to an easy ascend to Irshalwadi. From Irshalwadi, head towards a temple dedicated to a local deity and access the Irshalgad plateau via a west–east axis. The trek is child-friendly till the pinnacle base. Nevertheless, there have been numerous fatalities while climbing the pinnacle.

name: Morbe Dam
description: A large dam on the Dhavari River. It is the main water source for Navi Mumbai. Some signboards around the dam are worth noticing, especially if you have a good knowledge of Marathi.

name: Devrai Farm House
description: Comfortable homestay with a bungalow for large groups and cottages for small groups.

name: Malhar Villa
address: Borli, Ramwadi Bus Stop, Taluka Murud
description: Spacious villa with swimming pool, veranda, sit–out area and home–cooked food.

name: Bhor Ghat
description: A mountain pass between Khopoli and Khandala on the crest of the Western Ghats.

name: Imagicaa
price: Online tickets: theme park from ₹1000, water park from ₹700, snow park from ₹400; tickets are more expensive at the park; combination tickets and holiday packages are available
description: India's largest theme park. It is split into six zones: Viva Europa, Americana, Jambo Africa, Asiana, Arabia and India. The park has three roller coasters: Nitro, Deep Space, and Gold Rush. It also hosts the Aquamagica water park and a snow park with tobogganing and snow rides. There are also some rides specifically for children, including a log flume ride, a mini Ferris wheel, a mini drop ride, and a mini carousel. The park holds a special parade and carnival to celebrate Christmas.

name: PAPCO Mill complex
description: It has a Parashurama temple and Fire temple or Agni Mandir which was built in 1971.

name: Forganic Farm
description: Farmstay with lake and river trails, stream trail, jungle walk and open amphitheatre.

name: Ellow Stay By Mohan Farms
description: Cottage-style rooms with a swimming pool.

name: Raigad Fort
description: Samadhi (tomb) of the great Maratha warrior, Shivaji Maharaj, who brought the Hindu revolution to Islamic India.

name: Gandharpale Caves
description: A group of 30 Buddhist caves.

name: Dune-Barr-House
description: This is a heritage bungalow, opened in the 19th century and patronised by expats and the well-heeled Mumbai crowd. It is generally full on weekends. It is well away from the crowded centre of Matheran town, and not far from where the road turns from wide dusty horse-path to quiet footpaths.

name: Lord's Central
price: ₹ 4500 - ₹ 6000 standard rate depending on the room (discounted low season). The charges include three meals.
description: Is of the expensive options May not be the most luxurious around, but it's a charming place whose owners bend over backwards to make you feel at home. It has a well placed pool, small library, bar, dining room and a giant chess board.

name: Sea Shell Resort
description: Swimming pool and sea view rooms. If you want to book a sea view room by priority then you have to tell them at the time of reservation. The rooms are very clean and neat. The room service is really good. Air-conditioned restaurant with breakfast, lunch and dinner facility.

name: Atal Setu
description: India's longest sea bridge, also known as Mumbai Trans-Harbour Link (MTHL). Named after former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, the bridge connects Sewri in Mumbai to Nhava Sheva in Navi Mumbai, across the Mumbai Harbour.

name: Durga mata temple
description: It has been rebuilt using Bansipahadpur marble. Architectural work design by Sompura. Carving work was done by famous Rajasthani temple workers. On the foundations, pure black stone is used, and for garbhagrah and kalas, pure sandstone. The temple's entrance is made by one of the famous garud design praveshdwar. The total height is 55 feet.

name: Mango Garden
description: Mango Garden, a must-visit place for couples and children. It is a small garden for almost all age group people.

name: Mini seashore, Juhu Chowpatty
description: Boating, toy train and lot of fun, bhel puri, pani puri, gola etc.

name: Parsik Hill
description: A very cool place on hilltop. People prefer to come here for morning and evening walk. Youngsters come here to have fun and just chill out. It is closed most of the times in the rainy season because of the landslide. A must to visit this place in evening hours if you are around. It is best to visit this place when the monsoon just starts. During this time there is an enchanting dew and also a slow waterfall often called the Pandavakhada waterfall.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Maidan
description: Lots of temples for doing Pooja and meditiation, and a good trek.

name: Rain Tree Marg
description: Has beautiful views of Navi Mumbai

name: Sarovar Vihar Garden
description: Like a second marine drive, provides a beautiful view of the sea, a drive from Vashi via the Palm Beach Road ends at Belapur

name: Seven Wonders
description: Park for all ages, it has the Seven Wonder statues. It is a huge park with joy rides. Water pool and fountains to view. Fruit shape huts to seat and take photos. Cool hang out with kids.

name: Pandavkada Falls
description: Monsoon tourist attraction for people from far and wide. Authorities are strict in not allowing people to visit this place in monsoon on account of accidental deaths in the waterfall.

name: Utsav Chowk
description: One of the most famous landmarks in the area and it stands out for its eye catching architecture which is a humble reflection of the Roman and Greek architecture.

name: Belapur Fort ruins
description: The fort was built by the Siddis of Janjira. It was later conquered by the Portuguese, and then Marathas. In the early 19th century, the fort was captured by the British. The deliberate damage wrought led to a decline in the strategic importance of the fort.

name: Dronagiri Fort
description: The ruins of the fortification are seen on the fort. There is a church Nossa Senhora da Penha in good condition, but without any idol or inscription. The church is in the inner fortification. The main gate to the fort is situated on the south of the church 50 m away. The arch of the gate is broken, yet the guards rooms are in good condition. The Ganapati carved on the key stone is placed in one of the guard room. From the main gate a path way leads south to the Village Karanja. In between a Vetal mandir in ruined state is located. The pathway starting from the back of the Vetal mandie leads to large water tank in good condition situated among the forest. The fort is accessible in all seasons. The trek to the fort is simple and safe. Being close to Uran and Karanja, the fort was strategic importance since old times. The entire hill is densely covered with forest.

name: Central Park
description: The project of Central Park is to make a public park with Navi Mumbai's ethos reflected into the future. It is under construction but is open to public. The large amphitheatre has hosted many public shows. An ISKCON temple is attached to this park. To the west of this park is Pandav Kada waterfall and CIDCO developed golf course.

name: DY Patil Stadium
description: The cricket stadium in the Navi Mumbai area hosts several international cricket matches and domestic championships such as the Mumbai T20 league and Times Cricket Shield. Wankhede matches in the Indian Premier League as well as Womens Premier League have been played at the stadium. The stadium also hosts international cricket tournaments and concerts.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Joggers Park
description: A hot-spot for joggers of all ages

name: Sagar Vihar
description: A cool place to chill out with friends; a must to visit during evening hours.

name: Inorbit Mall
description: Wide variety of brands under a single shed, wonderful place to hangout with family while shopping. variety of food here in food court. pub and bar at 3rd floor... must visit place. Try kareem's here in ground floor for varieties of chicken, mutton, fish and other non-veg items.

name: Little World Mall
description: Littleworld, Kharghar’s largest mall has it all. It is the new destination for everything that’s hip and happening be it; Fashion, lifestyle, entertainment and events. This mall has a carpet area of more than 90 thousand sq ft. It is a first-class place to hang out with loads of eye-catching discounts and variety of branded outfits. It has amenities like valet parking for around 300 cars, centralized A/C, automatic lifts, and smoke detectors for safety, stunning elevators, and power back up. It has exclusive shops of garments, jewelry, restaurants of delicious food and drinks and even a multiplex where you can enjoy latest blockbusters.

name: Sector 17 Vashi and Sector 9 Juhu Nagar
description: About a small drive from Vashi Station, these sectors on the way you get into Vashi are one of the most happening spots of Navi Mumbai. Sector 9 Juhu Nagar is a local market for all your home needs. While Sector 17 Vashi is a mini electronics marketplace and commercial place.

description: Pure veg restaurant.

description: Intercontinental cuisine. You can sit at the counter and enjoy your drinks (including the Bartender's Special).

name: Hot Cross Cafe
description: A very relaxing coffee shop where they serve a variety of hukka (sheesha) at a very minimal rate. One of the best places in Navi Mumbai for hukka and mouth watering and fresh pastries.

name: Hotel Ruchi

name: Jaslok

name: Viscious circle

description: Great range of toast sandwiches And pizzas.

name: Snack Attack
description: A cool place for snacks with a very different look and a very artistic architect. Wide ranges of snacks, and small cups of Oreo juice are also offered.

name: Celebrations
description: Business deluxe hotel with multi-cuisine restaurant, tycoon bar, and modern amenities.

name: Health Juice Center
description: It is on Vashi to Koper Khairne road. Nice variety of juice. Try once "Boom juice".

name: Ice'n'Spice
description: The Biggest lounge bar cum restaurant of Navi Mumbai.

name: Oven Hot
description: Lovely chicken and veg snacks, superb pastries, delicious frankies. They make any sort of birthday cakes you desire, any shape, any cartoon character. Ask them and you have it. They somehow make 1/2 kg cakes within 15 minutes. They make different kinds of breads and sliced breads and egg/eggless cakes (200 g each packaged ones. walnut brownie, fruit and nut, mawa, tutty-fruity, choco walnut, etc.) All in all, an awesome place for a small party.

description: Has air-conditioning

name: K-Stars Hotels
description: A mid-segment business hotel at Belapur, Navi Mumbai (Maharashtra) just off Pune highway.

name: Royal Orchid Central Grazia
address: Plot # 67, L-3, Sector 19, Palm Beach Rd

name: Visava Amusement Park
description: Resort.

name: Dhavir Temple
description: Dhavir Maharaj is the prime deity of Roha. Every year the town celebrates Navaratri Festival by having a 10 day Festival at the Dhavir Temple which ends on the 10th day - "Dasra" during Navaratri. On the following day of Dasra, Palkhi of Dhavir Maharaj is taken through the town where it visits each and every house for the Aarti.

name: Avchitgad Fort
description: The fort is believed to have been built during the Shilahar dynasty and was reconstructed by the great Maratha king Shivaji.

name: River View Adventures
description: River rafting in the Kundalika River.

name: Subhan Beach Resort
description: Subhan beach resort is on the Shrivardhan beach

name: Karnala Fort
description: Apart from being a place of interest to the naturalist, Karnala is redolent of martial history. Karnala Fort, or the 'Funnel Hill' as it is called, stands 475 metres high. Its command of the high road between Bhorghat and the rivers of Panvel and Apta must have from the earliest time made Karnala a place of strategic importance. Two gateways — one at the foot and the other at the top of the rock-hewn steps — lead to a dual gateway with a chamber in between. There are two inscriptions in the fort, one in Marathi and the other in Persian. The fort has a chequered history of having passed through the hands of Muslim, Portuguese and Maratha rulers.

name: Karnala Pinnacle
description: Offers refuge to endangered birds like the peregrine falcon, king vulture and the crested serpent eagle. The four-horned antelope, wild boar, common langur, African monkeys and the muntjak or barking deer are amongst the commonly seen wildlife, while the leopard is spotted rarely.

name: Ade
description: Visit the ancient temple of Shree Parshuram. You can also take a stroll on the clean and calm beach.the speciality if this beach you can observe in nature, as it's surrounded by nesting habitats of seagulls, it's a mesmerizing afternoon to watch this birds flocking all together, it's a wonderful experience to bliss into nature.like it's a white carpet of the birds(seagul) spread on the beach of Ade, but still unexplored.

name: Anjarle
description: A few kilometres away from Dapoli is the beach of Anjarle. Ganapati of Hill (Kadyawarcha) In Aanjarle village on the seashore the temple built on huge mountain is known as 'Ganapati of Kadyawar'. After crossing the Jog river creek, there is Aanjarle village. In earlier times there were two temples in the sea, one Temple of Aanjarleshwar & other of Ganapati. They got drowned in the sea, later on Ganapati temple was built on a high mountain. The temple must be of Madhavrao Peshve period. There are 250 steps to it. There is a lake in front of it. It has a big hall & a stone staircase. There is water fountain in the hall, There is a dome, are & many pillars in the temple. The place is cool & pleasant in Dapoli Taluka with seashore & forest.

name: Asud
description: Ancient Keshavraj and Vyaghreshwar temples in the midst of scenic hills.

name: Harnai Beach
description: South of old Harnai fort, the palm-fringed beach of Murud is famous for its clean white sands and crystal clear safe waters. Visit the Goa Killa or Harnai fort which is built in different levels. Don't miss the fish auction in the evenings.

name: Karde
description: Has a pristine beach and few resorts.

name: Kelshi
description: Further north from Anjarle, near the border of Raigad district, is another small town known as Kelshi. This village is frequented by pilgrims who come to the Mahalaxmi Temple here, built during the rule of the Peshwa dynasty. Other than the Mahalaxmi Temple, there are other temples here dedicated to Rasha Krishna, Beleshwar and Ganesha, to name a few. Just outside of the village is a lovely beach, which stretches for 2½ km and the sunset is said to be spectacular from this beach.

name: Khem Padmavati
address: Satere Tarf Haweli,Post agar Vaigani, Dapoli
description: Khem Padmavati Devi Temple famous in Dabhol Panchkrochi. From Dapoli Satere Tarf Haweli S.T. facility is available.

name: Ladghar
description: The beach here called Tamas Teertha has a religious background and many people come here to bathe in the sea water. The sunset here is unforgettable.

name: Murud
description: Dhondo Keshav karve who started the movement for the women came from this village. There is an ancient temple of Goddess Durgadevi which is on a wooden pillar. There are 28 carved wooden pillars in it. In front of the temple there is 'Appasaheb Smarak'. Also, these is a statue of Maharshi Karve. The Ganapati in lake is also a peculiar feature of Murud. During the summer, when there is less water in the lake, the devotees can visit the Ganapati idol. Accommodation facilities are available in the hotels.

name: Panhalekaji
description: Ancient, rock-cut caves believed to be more than a thousand years old are a treat to architecture lovers. Hindu and Buddhist sculptures cover the walls. There are around 29 caves here which are located on the banks of the “Kotjai” river.

name: Suvarnadurg
description: Suvarnadurg the island fortress off the coast of Harnai was a fort built by Shivaji to counter the Siddi. This fort was later used by Shivaji to counter the Europeans and was a base for the Maratha navy's ship building facility. The town of Harishareshwar, known for its tranquil and picturesque beach is also landmarked by the Kalbhairav Shiva Temple. If you are adventurous enough take a small boat to the North side of the bay, you can see where the Peshwas or Prime Ministers of the Maratha Kingdom resided. Also see the Peshwa Smarak and visit the Bankot Fort at Bagmandala, approximately 4 km away.

name: Unhavare
description: Situated amidst a picturesque valley, you can bathe in these natural hot springs. The water has medicinal value and can cure some skin diseases. Bathing in this water makes you hungry so make sure you have all your resources of snacks and food with you.

name: Sunset especially at Tamasteertha beach at Ladghar
Visit local home and be a part of their daily life
Aryawarta
description: Independent bungalows from 2 bedrooms to 6 bedrooms, well maintained, clean and have all basic amenities. Their package includes all meals of the day (vegetarian, but they will provide non-veg on demand). Very good quality food.

name: Captain House
description: Restaurant & lodge.

name: Kisan Bhavan
description: Guest house of Konkan Krishi Vidyapeet.

name: Hotel Jagdish Residency
address: At Post Gimhavane, Next to BP petrol pump
description: 14 air-conditioned rooms categorized as Deluxe, Executive & Maharaja suite. Banquet hall for hosting conferences & events.

name: Hotel Jayant Padmaja
description: Veg restaurant & lodge.

name: Hotel Vrundawan
description: Restaurant & lodge.

name: Silver Sand Resort
address: Karve Pakhadi, Post Murud, District Ratnagiri

name: Naad Beach Resort
description: 12 cottages 8 m from the beach.

name: Sea Face Beach Resort
description: A sea facing resort right next to the beach on the way to Karde from Murud.

name: Hotel Sagar Sawali
description: Serves very tasty seafood.

name: Gaaj
description: Run by the family of Mr. Bal.

name: Saagar Saad Resort
description: Clean resort right in front of the beach.

name: Hotel Mayuresh and Suyash Lodge
description: Serves very good seafood.

name: Vijaydurg Fort
description: The oldest fort on the Sindhudurg coast, was constructed during the regime of Raja Bhoja II of the Shilahar dynasty (construction period 1193-1205). It covers an area of surrounded on three sides by the Arabian Sea.

name: Arnav Resort Ganpatipule
description: A beach resort which is purely vegetarian

name: Atharva Residency
description: A set of 5 bunglows in Malgund near Ganpatipule

name: Maharashtra Tourism Development Corp
description: Self-contained rooms (84 blocks). Konkani House Deluxe A/C / Non-A/C (12 blocks).

name: Shri Swayambhu
description: A MTDC approved Ganapatipule resort - A homestay lodge. Unlike a regular Ganapatipule hotel or Ganaptipule resort Shree swayambhu lodge offers a homely feel at the same time the privacy to enjoy a fun filled vacation in Ganapatipule

name: Blue Ocean Resort & Spa by Apodis
address: S. No. 127, Malgund, Near Ganpatipule, Ratnagiri district
description: A resort by the shores of Ganpatipule, with private garden/beach facing villas and direct access to the beach.

name: Baug beach
description: Baug beach is a secluded stretch of Guhagar beach on its northern end which was opened up owing to a road being built to the beach. Before the road was built there was no access to the beach and the stretch of beach was totally deserted. There is a confluence of a small river with the sea at Baug Beach.

name: Hotel Annapurna
description: One of the best hotels for veg and non-veg meals.

name: Hotel Rajgad
description: Right next to the beach.

name: Parag Sawant
description: First & the oldest lodge in Guhagar touching to Vyadeshwar Temple in the main Bazarpeth.

name: Kismat Residency Beach Resort
description: 8 double rooms, neat and clean hotel.

name: Shantai by the Lake
description: Lakeside resort with swimming pool.

name: Gananayak Homestay
description: 100 m from the Devbag Beach and five minutes drive away from the Karli River Sangam. This resort has three A/C rooms and also serves traditional Malvani food.

name: Manorama Niwas
description: A small resort with three cottage rooms right on the Tarkarli Beach.

name: Saagar sangam
description: It is developed on a 30,000 square foot plot on the Karli River and enjoys about 110ft of river front. The Arabian Sea is across the road. The confluence of the river and the sea, which has prompted the name, is about 3 km away.

name: Hotel Sagar Kinara, Malvan
description: Hotel Sagar Kinara is equipped with all essential amenities, deluxe, super deluxe rooms, multi cuisine restaurant and bar.

name: Bhagvati Bundar
description: An old harbour, no longer in use as such but, instead, as a good white sand beach. A good beach with black sand is Mandvi Bundar.

name: Bhatyachi Khadi- Khadi
description: An area where river meets to sea. The village near this place is Bhatye, so known as Bhatyachi Khadi. The place is beautiful with a view of river & sea both. There is good casuarina cultivation on the sea shore. Also there is regional research centre for coconut & spices just near the casuarina plantation.

name: Ganapatipule
description: A clean seashore and Ganpati temple, about 30 km North from Ratnagiri. This temple is reconstructed in Rajasthani stones and look.

name: Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak Smarak
description: The monument and the home of a man who set off the 'Swadeshi Movement' and spearheaded the fight against the British Raj

name: Patit Pawan Mandir
description: The temple built by Swatantryaveer Savarkar for patit class of people.

name: Ratnadurga Fort
description: A fort covered by sea on 3 sides, with a temple of Goddess Bhagwati inside.

name: Thibaw Palace
description: The last Burmese king Thibaw was imprisoned in this palace by the British, built in Pagoda style. The Government has given up part of this palace for a Polytechnic.

name: Tilak's birthplace
description: The great Indian freedom fighter Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak's birthplace.

name: Best Western Blue Ocean Resort & Spa
description: Resort on the beach.

name: Hotel Prabha
description: It has a restaurant also. Good rooms and good service.

name: Hotel Prasad
description: It is a safe place in the center of the city.

name: Kohinoor Samudra Beach Resort
description: Free Wi-Fi and parking. Rooms are fully air-conditioned with some having beach views. Complimentary breakfast.

name: Cherilyn Monta Resort
address: Plot No. 305 (B), Gorulewadi, Ozer Junction, Oni, Tal. - Rajapur
description: Spacious rooms, villas and various activities.

name: Dio Regaalo Theme Resort
description: Dio Regaalo Theme Resort offers 15 rooms, each with a unique theme. The resort also has a swimming pool and a ship-themed restaurant.

name: Laling Fort
description: Laling is an ancient place and the fort was built up 14th century in the regime of first Faruki king, but the fort is in broken condition in these days. Also, there are two temples of 'Hemadpanthi' styles and are also in very much frayed condition.

name: Ekvira Temple
description: This temple belongs to Ekvira mata, which is as Shaktipeeth famous in whole Maharashtra. It is 5 minutes away from the bus station.

name: Shiva_tirtha
description: It was built by Anil Anna Gote who is the MLA of Dhule. There is a garden along with a massive monument of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. People go there in the evening to hang out.

name: Misal pao
description: It is available in cheap rates and famous for the breakfast of Dhule people.

name: Sugarcane juice
description: It is a cheaper and healthier drink and available in whole town.

name: Dhamma Giri Meditation Centre
description: Founded by S.N.Goenka, Dhammagiri is a meditation centre offers courses in Vipasana (insight meditation) a technique taught by the Buddha in India, 2,500 years ago. The large Golden Pagoda, the central theme of Dhammagiri, serves as a landmark for Igatpuri. The centre attracts lots of people from various parts of India as well as abroad.

name: Bhatsa River Valley
description: It is situated at the end of the Thal Ghat, just before entering Igatpuri from Mumbai. The valley lies in the basin of the majestic Bhatsa River.

name: Arthur Lake
description: A few km from Igatpuri, lies a huge and placid Arthur Lake, set like a huge jewel amidst the dense greenery. The lake is formed by the waters of the Pravara River in the Bhandardara region.

name: Kalsubai Peak
description: It is the highest peak in the Sahyadri ranges.

name: Amruteshwar Temple
description: Built in 11th century AD, it is dedicated to Lord Shiva. Constructed in a distinct Hemadpanti style, the temple is surrounded by lush green fields and Mount Kalsubai the highest mountain in Maharashtra. From here a further excursion leads to the Ratangad Fort. One can access this temple by road or an 8 km boat ride on Arthur Lake.

name: Ghatandevi Temple
description: Just ahead of Igatpuri, after crossing the Camel Valley, comes across a small road, which leads to the Ghatandevi temple. According to the locals belief, Ghatandevi is the Protector of Ghats. The mountains of Durrar Utvad, Trimak and Harihar forms a spectacular backdrop. Behind the temple lies the Tringalwadi Fort.

name: Girisagar Waterfall
description: This majestic waterfall near the beautiful Bhavali dam greets you to enjoy its timeless beauty amidst the fog and lush green forests. There are a ton of top attractions in close proximity of the falls and a viewpoint just above provides a great view of the Sahyadris. The waterfall is 17 km from Igatpuri train station, inside Jamunda Hills.

name: Igatpuri Cemetery
description: It lies on a hillock, north of the town. Soldiers died while fighting the great war in India are buried here.

name: Tringalwadi Fort
description: It is situated at an altitude of 3,000 feet above the sea level. Since it is located very high, the fort offers views of the locality, including Kulang and Kalsubai mountain ranges. The fort attracts trekkers also. The top of the fort is shaped like a Turban. A temple dedicated to lord Hanuman is nearby. An architectural marvel, the fort can be accessed through a narrow pathway, down to the Tringalwadi Lake. Just a few km away from Tringalwadi Lake is Talegaon Lake formed by the small Talegaon Dam.

name: Camel Valley
description: A few metres away from Bhatsa river valley, on the right is the camel valley. On the other side of the valley is a waterfall formed by the rain waters and one have to walk over and look down to find a slope that falls over 1, 000 ft. The waterfall is the chief attraction of this place.

name: The Five Waterfalls
description: A little further from Ghatandevi, the rough road leading to the railway line begins. Across the railway line, while climbing down, falling one below the other, are five waterfalls that form which are main attraction for tourists in Igatpuri.

name: Nature's Dreamland Holiday Homes
description: A nice resort that offers tent cottages, wooden cottages and a 3 bedroom villa. It has a swimming pool and a restaurant.

name: Aryan Park
description: Boating, You can see rabbit, ostrich, sunflower garden.

name: Gandhi Research Foundation
price: Museum Entry fee for Indian students ₹50, Indian adults ₹100, Foreigners and NRIs ₹200 include Fruit Drink
description: A museum and research institution dedicated to the life and achievements of Mahatma Gandhi.

name: Sarangkheda Chetak Festival
description: A horse trading fair and horse festivals where horse buyers and sellers come from all over the country to trade. Other activities include horse riding, watching races, looking at paintings and children's rides.

name: Hatkanangale (Station code: HTK)
description: 8 km away, the most convenient option.

name: Central Bus Stand Ichalkaranji
description: The central bus terminus of Ichalkaranji.

name: Industrial areas and textile clusters
description: Ichalkaranji’s identity is deeply tied to its textile industry, and many visitors come specifically to observe the city’s power loom clusters and cooperative mills. While most factories are not formal tourist attractions, some owners may allow guided visits if arranged in advance. The buzzing sound of looms and the dense network of workshops offer a unique glimpse into one of India’s most productive textile hubs.

name: Shri Siddheshwar Temple
description: Dedicated to Lord Shiva, known for its peaceful atmosphere and traditional architecture. It’s a popular spot for morning and evening visits, especially during festivals like Mahashivaratri.

name: Shri Datta Mandir
description: Dedicated to Lord Dattatreya, an important spiritual centre for locals. The temple complex becomes especially lively during Datta Jayanti.

name: Shahu Stadium
description: A local sports ground that hosts athletic events, kabaddi matches, and community gatherings.

name: Mahabaleshwar Bus Station
description: Mahabaleshwar is easily accessible from Pune and Mumbai. You can take a tourist bus (Volvo) from Mumbai, departing from Dadar East, Sion or Vashi. The ride will take you 6 hours and will cost around ₹1500. An ordinary AC bus will cost ₹200. The Volvo bus from Pune is operated by private companies (Neeta and Konduskar), and they charge approx ₹400 each way. The Govt. Express bus from Swargate starting 5:45AM and every hour with a price of ₹120 per individual. Private cab tours to Mahabaleshwar from Pune and Mumbai are operated by Vasa Cabs.

name: Arthur's Seat
description: One of the most popular spots. This is at the end of the road, that is a dead end. There is no parking available, and during peak season it may be impossible to get a spot on the sides of the road. You can park at Savitri point, just 300 m away, and walk to Arthur's seat point, with several other points along the way. Castle Rock point is also nearby. There are lot of eateries at the entrance. There is also a Sulabh toilet but don't expect cleanliness, lights and doors inside. There are no toilets available at other points on the way and you may be hours away from the next one.

name: Savitri Point
description: Just ahead (before) of the Arthur's Seat. After the renovation, it has good stairways that give beautiful views of the valley below. There is a small parking area.

name: Elphinston Point
description: On the way to Arthur's Seat. This point also provides beautiful views of the valleys. There is a big parking area at this point.

name: Elephant's head Point
description: From the viewpoint an overhanging cliff in the shape of an elephant trunk is visible. Apart from the strange rock formation there are great views of the surrounding cliffs

name: Kate's Point
description: Named after Kate, daughter of John Malcolm, Governor of Bombay (1 November 1827 – 1 December 1830). Located at an altitude of 1473 meters, Kate Point offers a birds-eye view of the Dhoom Lake and the meandering Krishna River

name: Lodwick Point
description: Named after Peter Lodwick, a British officer who first climbed the hill in April 1824. To mark his accomplishment, his son erected a 25 feet column, which stands to this day. Here also the views are great with unobstructed views of the nearby Pratapgad Fort.

name: Wilson Point
description: Standing at 1439 m, it is Mahabaleshwar's highest point. It is named after Leslie Wilson, the governor of Bombay Presidency (10 Dec 1923 - 8 Dec 1928). There are a couple of bastion-shaped viewpoints. It is a popular viewpoint offering great views, especially during sunrise.

name: Mahabaleshwar Temple Complex
description: The temple complex in old Mahabaleshwar houses three temples. They are Mahabaleshwar Temple, Atibaleshwar Temple and Panchaganga Temple. The temples date back centuries before the colonial period and are topped with pyramidal spires. The entire complex is heavily encroached with makeshift stalls selling items of worship. Photography is restricted in the interiors of the first three temples.

name: Krishna Temple
description: The Krishna Temple is located a few yards away from the temple complex. It is also an active temple but there are no encroachment. It marks the source of the Krishna River. Sadly, the temple is in ruins, but it does have a commendable appearance. The temple complex offers a grand view of the valley below, complete with the adjoining towering cliffs.

name: Lingmala Falls
description: The falls consists of two parts - the upper longer part and the shorter lower part. A half an hour trek is required to reach the view point of the falls.

name: Pratapgad
description: The fort was the site of the Battle of Pratapgad fought between the Marathas and the Sultanate of Bijapur in 1659. The fort stands on a hill top and offers great views. The fort has two gates, complete with towering walls and bastions. The fort is divided into two parts - lower and upper. The lower fort houses the main entrance, while the upper fort contains temples, a statue of Shivaji (installed in 1957) and several buildings.( frameless|20px|link=https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/UNESCO_World_Heritage_List UNESCO, part of Maratha Military Landscape)

name: Venna Lake
description: One of the major tourist attractions of Mahabaleshwar. The lake is surrounded by trees and offers opportunities for the visitor such as boating or horse back riding. Many local eateries and hotels can be found in the area.

name: Boating
price: Rowing boat: self-rowing at ₹ 400 for half an hour, ₹ 800 for one hour for the boat that can take about 8 adults. If you need a rower to do the rowing for you, ₹200 for half an hour. Accepts only cash, no card or UPI payment.
description: Visit lake Venna for a ride on paddle or rowing boat. You may ride boat on your own or, alternatively, you can hire one. It is a beautiful and scenic lake. The paddle boats are stopped during the monsoon season (June to September), so you have to do with the rowing boat.

name: Horse Riding
description: Horse rides are available in the Veena Lake region

name: Tapola
description: About 50 km from Mahabaleshwar. Tourists can enjoy boating. There are many scenic view points and strawberry farms on the way.

name: Trekking
description: There are many many trekking trails around the hills of Mahabaleshwar. Ask your hotel for the nearest trekking trail

name: Watch the sunrise and sunset
description: Go to Wilson Point or Kate's Point to watch beautiful sunrises, and to Bombay Point or Elphinstone Point to see glowing sunsets.

name: Honey
description: There are a variety of local brands of honey available in the bazaar.

name: Leather Footwear
description: One can buy the famous Kolhapuri slippers, shoes and sandals in the bazaar.

name: Mapro Foods
description: These products are made from natural friuts and herbs and are not available outside Maharashtra.

name: Hotel Center Point
description: Located in main market. Though prices are on slightly higher end, provides food with good taste.

name: Mapro Garden
description: Mapro garden restaurant offers a decent menu. Most of the tourist vehicles stop here, on their way to Mahabaleshwar. This place has clean restrooms and large dining area. Refresh yourself here because all of the other Mahabaleshwar public points hardly have any restrooms, let alone clean ones. The self service counters are prompt in serving your orders. Pizza, soups, sandwich, ice creams are some of the good offerings. They also have a retail outlet for Mapro products offering a large variety of crush, jams and candies.

name: Strawberries
description: Buy the 'sweet charlie' variety of strawberries from the main Mahabaleshwar Market. Alternatively, you can also venture out into interior parts to handpick your berries from the strawberry farms.

name: Beer
description: Generally restaurants here do not serve liquor, except beer, but a few places close to the State Bus Stand, like Hotel Shreyas have it on menu. You can buy all the liquor you want from Imperial Stores.

name: Milk Shakes
description: The most popular drink, available at most restaurants, is strawberry milk shake. You can add a blob of strawberry ice-cream for some added flavour

name: Strawberry and other local wines
description: Strawberry Wine is another sought-after souvenir of the region. A 750 ml bottle of Strawberry Wine costs about ₹600. Also available are mulberry, raspberry, chocolate, mango (alphanso), kiwi, peach, pineapple and plum wine.

name: Citrus Chambers Mahabaleshwar hotel
description: Nice views

name: The Dina Hotel
description: A family-run heritage hotel with well-furnished rooms with en-suite bathrooms & TV. Enjoy views of the lake on the balcony as you sip your tea. Veg & non-veg dining.

name: Durwankur Cottage
address: Ganesh Housing Society, Off Mahabaleshwar Market, - 412 806
description: Cottage, clean and comfortable.

name: Frederick Hotel
description: Quiet, with a wonderful valley view, spacious rooms, and good food.

name: Hotel Girivihar
description: Serves good Maharashtrian food. Clean and comfortable place to stay. Friendly staff.

name: Hotel Rajesh
description: Centrally located pure vegetarian hotel with 70 centrally air conditioned rooms and 20 non-air-conditioned rooms. Parking, pool with waterfall, gym, children's play park with mini train.

name: Hotel Templeview
description: Surrounded by the jungle, gives a true feeling of wilderness. Rooms are just about okay. Food is fine. Some parts of resort building are about 125 years old. The cottages have three large rooms and a large bathroom & dressing area with respect to the price paid. The food and service are good.

name: Ramsukh
description: Nice 3-star place.

name: Khushi River Side Resort & Spa
description: It has a scenic swimming pool, a spa, and rooms boasting river views.

name: Hotel Gautam
description: India's first ecotel hotel.

name: Ravine Hotel
description: The only 3-star hotel in Panchgani.

name: Sherwood Hotel
address: Blue Valley Ride, Off Satara Road, - 412 806. Tel: 02168 - 270070 / 77 / 99
description: Excellent hotel - superb location and Parsi food right in the middle of the jungle - best views in the hill station, but high end tariff.

name: Surya Retreat
description: Rooms pointing to valley, great view, open swimming pool.

name: Valley View
description: Includes gym, indoor swimming pool, garden with view of valley, and good 3-star service.

name: Table Land
description: Located at an elevation of 4,500 ft, it is the second-largest plateau in Asia. It can be reached by car and car parking is available. It spans a vast area and features several eateries offering a diverse range of snacks. There is also a kids' zone featuring toy trains and merry-go-rounds. There are also options for horse rides and horse carriage rides. The strategic location of the plate offers breathtaking views of the surrounding and offers great views during sunrise and sunset.

name: Sydney Point
description: A popular viewpoint in Panchgani, offering unobstructed views of the Dhoom Lake and the Krishna River valley. nearby hill cities of Wai and Mandhardeo. There are views of the Kamalgad Fort. Te nearby region is a hub of adventure activity, including paragliding. Paragliders can be seen flying above the hills and the lakes. It is named after Thomas Sydney Beckwith, commander of the Bombay Army. The viewpoint is beautifully landscaped with meandering pathways. There are a couple of pavilions for visitors to sit. There is also a hanging bridge. There are benches equipped with solar-powered benches, where visitors can charge their mobile phones.

name: Parsi Point
description: Named after the Parsi community, the Parsi Point was once a place used by the nearby Parsi community for meeting and socializing. Today it is a strategic location that offers great views of the surrounding lush green hills, towering cliffs and the Dhom lake. The place houses several food stalls selling delicious snacks. Also, there are several activities to keep the kids busy.

name: Devil's Kitchen
description: The place has a mythological connection with the Pandavas of Mahabharata.It is believed that the place served as a kitchen for the Pandavas during their exile.

name: Velocity Entertainmentz
price: Free Entry. Go-kart: ₹350-650 and other rides: ₹150-500
description: The largest amusement park in Panchgani with one of India's professional mountain go-kart track and more than 12 rides and games for all ages. There is also pure vegetarian restaurant, ATM, shops, and petrol pump within the place.

name: Mapro Garden
description: Mapro is a leading brand in the food processing industry. They started with the humble strawberry jam. Over the years, it grew in leaps and bounds and led to the formation of Mapro, known for its jams, syrups, spreads and fruit chews. The Mapro Garden is a garden that unfolds the story of the evolution of Mapro. It has large stores selling a variety of processed food products. The area also has an open space for several kids’ activities. There is a cafe and an ice-cream stall.

name: Devrai Art Village
description: Devrai Art Village in Panchgani is the birth place of stone Dokra. The ancient metal art of casting brass following the lost wax process has been given a new art form by fusing stones with metal. Not only stone Devrai Art Gallery has blended dokra with other metals, stones, wood and even paintings. At Devrai Art Gallery the age-old art goes through constant evolution of new designs and new processes while staying rooted in our tradition.

name: Just Chill Beer and Wine
description: Strawberry Wine is another sought-after souvenir of the region. A 750 ml bottle of Strawberry Wine costs about ₹600. Also available are mulberry, raspberry, chocolate, mango (alphanso), kiwi, peach, pineapple and plum wine.

name: Prospect Hotel
description: Panchgani's oldest and highest located hotel. Prospect has modern and comfortable rooms, beautiful gardens, food, and friendly staff and owners.

name: Sai Palace
description: A comfortable resort a 5-minute walk from Panchgani bus stand.

name: Wonder Woods
description: A heritage resort.

name: Belscot
description: A bungalow.

name: Umbrella Inn
description: A mid-sized resort.

name: Eco camp
description: Eco-camp that has a fine view of the Krishna Valley. Tents and rooms can be rented out.

name: Basilica Resort
address: Toll Booth, S No 392, Wai-Panchgani Rd, Dhandeghar
description: Resort with on-site leisure options, including indoor games and light outdoor sports.

name: Ajinkyatara
description: Ajinkyatara is a (prominent) fort on one of the seven mountains surrounding Satara.

name: Char Bhinti
description: A memorial in Satara honoring Rango Bapuji Gupte. This memorial is located on a hill offering a view of the city on one side and Ajinkyatara Fort on the other.

name: Kaas Plateau
description: A UNESCO World Heritage (Biodiversity) site famous for wildflowers.

name: Natraj Mandir
description: A replica of the original in Tamil Nadu built in the 1980s. This temple for Sri Nataraja has several towers and four gateways as well as several shrines (temples) within the complex.

name: Pateshwar
description: About 10 km from Satara city in the village Degav, the place of God Mahadev. Place is surrounded by around 300,000 pindis (sacred stones or tree stumps).

name: Sajjan Gadh
description: This is 18 km from the city. Not only is it a fort and the final resting place of Sant Ramdas; it is a pilgrimage site

name: Thoseghar Waterfalls
description: Approximately 20 km from the city, this is a popular attraction with a picnic area and a platform for viewing the falls.

name: Yavteshwar
description: The place where big hill areas are located and also Aajinkya Tara fort, Thoseghar Waterfall and a wind energy-making hill which is famous nationally. The Yavteshwar Mahadev Temple, a Shiva temple, is more than 800 years old.

name: Hotel Maharaja Regency
address: Hotel Maharaja Regency, 174, Shivaji Circle, Powai Naka, Shivaji Circle, Karanje Turf Satara

name: Ganagapur
description: Dattatraya devastan, Sangam

name: Shivleni Caves
description: Rock-cut cave monuments which date back to the era of King Udayaditya (reigned c. 1060–1087). Total excavations were hewn out of rock, cut and carved deep inside the hill. The caves include sculptures of Hindu deities like Shiva, Saptamatrukas and Ganesha.

name: Kankaleshwar Temple
description: Yadava meets Bauhaus – a somewhat daring synthesis of old temple building fabric (probably from the Yadava dynasty from the 13th century) and a functional factory style. The temple has a large inner dome. Muslim zealots cut off the heads of all the outer figurines. Inside, the portals to the three sanctuaries are interesting. In order to get to the temple, Kneipp wading is required when the water level in the temple pond is higher, not an easy exercise given the moss-covered stones. But you can hold on to the railing.

name: Khandoba Temple
description: 1.5 km from Mansur Shah Dargah is the unusual original Khandoba Temple. It has two towers decorated with stucco and it is somewhat reminiscent of the palaces in Rajasthan.

name: Khazana Fountain
description: This site is not well known. The fountain dates from 1583. However, the visit is only worthwhile for hardcore archeology fans, because nothing spectacular opens up for the inexperienced visitor.

name: Shahinshah Wali Dargah
description: A tomb of an important Muslim personality. She is always visited by believers. The Daragh is not particularly interesting architecturally, but exudes a nice atmosphere. It can be reached by walking 750 m east of Kankaleshwar Temple or by taking a car.

name: Mansur Shah Dargah
description: Here are some covered tombs in a beautiful garden, one of which is made of intricately worked marble. This degree is that of the 18th century Sufi Mansur Shah. The tombs stand on the east side of the river about 1.5 km north of Kankaleshwar Temple.

name: Kalinka Devi Mandir
description: Kalinka Devi Mandir is known for its great history. During the Kalinka Devi pilgrimage, people come from far and wide to seek the blessings of the Goddess kalinka devi and his four sister deities. Many devotees visit the temple of Goddess Kalinka every year, especially from the Kasar community, as Goddess Kalinka is the deity of the Kasar community. Digras is 47 km from Parli Vaijnat railway station. Bus services are provided by State Road Transport Corporation.

name: Parli Vaijnath
description: Parli Vaijnath has one of 12 jyotirlingas all over the world, one of which is at Vaidyanath Jyotirlinga.

name: Chand Minar
description: Inspired by Delhi's Qutb Minar, the Chand Minar is considered to be among the finest specimens of the Islamic architecture in India. It was erected in 1445 by a Bahmani slave and commemorated to Bahmani Sultan Alauddin Ahmad Shah for his victory against the Vijayanagara Empire in 1443.

name: Daulatabad Fort
description: It houses a stupendous 12th-century fortress well placed atop a charming hill. This invincible fortress boasts of a sturdy wall and an intricate series of ramparts. Don't miss the climb to the very top through the bat cave.

name: Dharashiv Caves
description: A nexus of seven Shramanic caves on the Balaghat range. It is believed to be built around 5th-7th century, and there has been debates over whether those caves are Buddhist or Jain creations. Regardless, there are seven caves, and the 1st cave is harnessed by 20 pillars of scaffolding. Cave No. 2 is among major caves and modelled on the plan of the Vakataka caves at Ajanta. It has a central hall with 14 cells for the residence of the Bhikkhus and garbhagriha with a statue of the Buddha in lotus position. The 3rd cave resembles with 1st, while later caves are Jain caves.

Digras is 47 km from Parli Vaijnat railway station. Bus services are provided by State Road Transport Corporation.

description: Parli Vaijnath has one of 12 jyotirlingas all over the world, one of which is at Vaidyanath Jyotirlinga.

name: Kharosa Caves
description: Twelve caves featuring sculptures of a Jain tirthankara, Narasimha, Shiva-Parvati, Kartikeya and Ravana.

name: Gajanan maharaj temple
description: The Gajanan Maharaj Temple were built to honour Shri Sant Gajanan Maharaj, a late 19th– and early 20th-century Indian holy man known to many people in Maharashtra, India. His birthdate is unknown; he lived most of his life at Shegaon.

name: Girda
hours: Girda sun rise time varies 20 minutes from IST
description: 'Kali Bhint/Black Wall', a geographical structure. 'Sita nhani' a place where Pandavas hid during adnyatvas. A place and temple. Beautiful natural scene and waterfall

name: Shree Balaji Temple
description: Shree Balaji Temple at Buldhana, stands as an exact replica of the Shree Balaji temple at Tirupati. thumb|Shivaji and Jijamata

name: Sindhkhed Raja village
description: There are several monuments in this small township, which owe their existence to Rajmata Jijabai and her father Lakhuji Jadhav. These monuments like Kalkat, Rang Mahal, Tomb of Lakhuji Jadhav, Place of Lakhuji Jadhav, ancient temple of Neekjantheshwar and Rameshwar have great heritage and architectural value. thumb|Lonar Crater Aug 2011

name: Lonar lake
address: On the outskirts of Loanar town in Buldhana District,
description: The lake was first mentioned in ancient scriptures such as the Skanda Purana, the Padma Puran and the Aaina-i-Akbari. The first European to visit the lake was British officer, J.E. Alexander in 1823. Buldhana district in Maharashtra, where the lake is located, was once part of Ashoka's empire and then of Satavahana's. The Chalukyas and Rashtrakutas also ruled this area. During the period of the Mughals, Yadavas, Nizam and the British, trade prospered in this area. Several temples found on the periphery of the Lake are known as Yadava temples and also as Hemadpanti temples (named after Hemadri Ramgaya). This depression was formed many many years ago. Some 50,000 years ago, there was a huge meteor, which fell on the earth from space. The impact of the fall was so tremendously huge that a huge bowl shaped crater was carved in the earth. This was 7 km in circumference and 1.8 km in diameter. This is supposed to be the largest and oldest meteoric crater in the entire world. The nearest rival here is the Canyon Diabolo of Arizona in the United States. You can also see peafowls that have made the crater their home. You will also find lots of migratory birds.

name: Nandura Hanuman statue
description: This is famous for the temple of Lord Hanuman. The Temple is supposed to be having world’s biggest Hanuman idol. It is around 105 ft (30m) tall.

name: ARD CineMall
description: ARD CineMall is a first multiplex in Below 1 Lac population town in India. The multiplex is UFO digital projection technology which first in Buldhana, with total Dolby digital surround sound systems.

name: ARD MART
description: Ample parking space.

name: Quality house
address: Super market, Bhagavan Mahavir Marg, Buldhana.
description: It is one of the good grocery shops in Buldhana.

name: Heera Guest House
address: New DP Road, Siddhartha Nagar, Chikhli
description: Internet access, laundry facilities, parking, 24-hour front desk, secretarial services, room service, 24-hour power supply

name: Civil Hospital
price: Free check up.(nominal fee if required)
address: District TB Centre Buldhana, Civil Hospital Compound
description: Free emergency medical service with quality care.

name: Ramala Talav Garden
description: A newly developed place for all ages, especially for kids.

name: Sri Mahakali Temple
description: Goddess Kali attracts devotees from different parts of State.

name: Anandwan
description: This is the place where Baba Amte made a home for the patients of leprosy.

name: Ballarpur
