description: The venue for many fairs during festivals and regular evening concerts and other programmes.

name: Kerala Folklore Museum
description: A theatre with regular evening performances, a state-of-the-art museum and cultural gallery.

name: Pareekshith Thampuran Durbar Hall Art Gallery
description: Contains oil paintings, old coins, sculptures, Mughal paintings plus models of temples and traditional Kerala buildings. It was the official Durbar Hall of Kochi Maharajas, now converted into a large fine arts gallery. It is named after last Maharaja of Kochi, who was an oil painter. A small studio nearby promotes young artists.

name: Malayattoor Mount
description: A major Christian pilgrimage centre believed to be the place where St Thomas performed his first miracle in AD 52. Today, it is famous for its annual Holy week-Easter pilgrimage.

name: St. Antony's Shrine
description: At this shrine that belongs to Archdiocese of Verapoly people of different faith and culture flock together day and night seeking blessings.

name: St. George's Syro-Malabar Forane Church
description: A popular church, also amongst non-Christians. Famous for its poison cure treatments.

name: St. Mary's Syro-Malabar Cathedral Basilica
description: The cathedral is dedicated to "Our Lady of Ports". The cathedral was built in the early twentieth century under the direction of Mar Louis Pazheparambil. It is also a prominent Marian pilgrim centre in India.

name: Kanjiramattom Mosque
address: Kanjiramattom Thalappara Rd, Millungal Junction, Kanjiramattom
description: Major Muslim pilgrimage centre and venue of the Kudikkuthu Festival. Famous for the annual Urs festival. Imams of this mosque are famous for being leading scholars who were advisors to Kochi Rajas. This mosque is an example of antique beauty of mazhars and dargahs. This was recognised by Kochi Maharajas as official along with temples. The annual Chandanakudam in January attracts many pilgrims. During the festival, pilgrims carry pots smeared with sandalwood paste in a procession to the mosque, with caparisoned elephants and percussion musics – both found in temples – form essential parts of the Chandanakudam festival.

name: Ernakulam Shiva Temple
description: Has three temples within its complex.

name: Gurdwara Sri Guru Singh Sabha
description: It is the lone Sikh Gurudwara of Kerala, established by the Punjabi community of Kochi in 1955. Special rites and Guru ka Langar rituals are held every Saturday and Sunday.

name: Managalavanam
description: A thick 80-acre mangrove forest in the heart of Kochi and declared a flora sanctuary. More than 30 unique flora are found here and it is also a major bird sanctuary, where migratory birds feed and rest when they escape the cold northern winters.

name: Marine Drive Walkway
description: A two-km-long promenade and no car is allowed to ply there. The backwaters are on one side and a busy shopping district is on the other side of the walk. The walkway starts from , goes through two scenic bridges and ends at Rajendra Maidan. The total distance is less than a kilometre. Stroll along this calm stretch without motorised traffic and enjoy an ice cream or fruit juice. A few malls stand along the way. Chill off the heat while you walk with a Sharjah shake or ice-cream, or one of the local delicacies. There is a children's park in the middle and two hanging bridges.

name: Changampuzha Park
description: A spacious place established in 1977, ideal for picnics and group discussions.

name: Subhash Bose Park
description: One of the largest parks in Kochi.

name: Kerala Fine-Arts complex
description: This is one of the oldest centres, with regular cultural performances. Many require prior booking, as they are organised by prestigious societies and groups. There are some performances that have free entry, and the monthly cultural programs of Bank Employees Union is one such.

name: See India Foundation
description: Kalathil Parambil Crossroad, nr Valanjambalam Temple, Chitoor Rd. An evening Kathakali theater, where daily performances take place from 6PM-8PM. This is the oldest and first evening Kathakali theater in India. The show is preceded by a detailed discourse of Kathakali history and philosophy, elaborate make-up performances and a demonstration of Kathakali techniques.

name: Jawaharlal Nehru International Stadium
description: Good open multipurpose stadium where locals play regularly, free of cost. Badminton and tennis courts next to this ground can be used on payment of fees at sports office of St. Albert's College which owns them.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Indoor Stadium
description: It has badminton, tennis, squash, volleyball and basketball courts. Rooms for chess, caroms, table-tennis and board games are also available. For an entrance fee payable at the indoor sports office, you can play here or join regular users. There is a state-of-art fitness complex and billiards-snooker pool inside this stadium. An Olympic-sized swimming pool is available outside. Large football and cricket pitches are available free-of-charge. Locals play regularly here and you can join them.

name: Wonderla
description: second largest theme park in South India. Spread over 50 acres of land with more than 50 Rides and various shows, it has well maintained gardens and five restaurants as well as small cafes

name: Silverstorm Water Park
description: A good family theme park with 29 water and dry rides, a very large park and a Chinese village

name: Boating on the Kochi backwaters
description: Get the real feel of the Vembanad Lake through boating. There are many cruises offered by many private players as well as the Kerala State Inland Shipping Corp. Sunset cruises are popular. Many guesthouses offer the trip and in the centre you can arrange it by yourself as well. Speedboats also ply on the backwaters. Some premium hotels in Willingdon Island and Fort Kochi offer motorised watersports for its guests. Daily backwater tours can be organised directly through the state tourism office at Ernakulam Park Jetty. They cost ₹650 per person and must be booked at least the day before. The tour includes a stop at local small industries and food sites.

name: Kerala Kathakali Centre
description: Offers short-term courses in Kathakali, Kalaripayattu and percussion instruments for visitors. Ideal for learning a bit about the essence of Kerala's, although it is not so authentic being aimed mostly at tourists.

name: RLV College of Dance and Music
description: Established in the 1920s by the Maharaja of Kochi in Tripunithara as a remembrance to his late wife and daughter, this is one of the most popular music and dance colleges in the state. There are many short-term courses, making it ideal for interested visitors.

name: Sree Sankara School of Dance and Music
description: Popular school for learning classical Indian art forms, offering certificates and diplomas.

name: ENS Kalari
description: One of the most popular Kalari centres in the state. Part of Kerala Kalaripattyattu Association, this institute is guided by trainers who are versed in ayurveda, mathematics and physical education.

name: Art of Living-Ernakulam Chapter
description: Part of the international yoga and spiritual centre of Sri Sri Ravi Shankar.

name: Broadway Market
description: One of the Kochi's oldest shopping corners where you can buy anything from safety pins to motor scooters (light motorcycles). A spice market operates inside, offering the best of Kerala's spices, saffron and various oils. There is also a cloth market, a jewellery market, a fancy items market, a vegetable/fruit market and an electronic/watch market.

name: Cauvery
description: A government emporium well known for quality handicrafts at reasonable price.

name: Kalanikethan
description: A newly opened shop in Kochi, a place for women's wear.

name: Kalyan Silks
description: One of the largest silk saree showrooms and a good place to get many kinds of Indian and western clothing, including popular western brands, at very reasonable rates. Silk Sarees are its trademark and most of them are well priced.

name: Kasavukada
address: South End of Foreshore Rd near Church Landing
description: A good place to buy a wide range of ethnic Kerala dress like Mundu, Kasavu Mundu Neyriyattu and ethnic men's Jubas

name: Seematti
description: One of the posher silk and dress fashion centres and a trend setter in creating unique designs and special materials for its Sarees. Its owner - Beena Kannan - is a leading fashion designer and new designs come every six months. Most of its sarees are out-of-traditional kind, making its unique. It is comparatively more costly than other brands. The men's area is not so elaborate and has only few collections.

name: Village Shop
address: Behind Sony Center, Ravipuram, MG Road
description: Village Shop is a Home Furnishing store in Kochi. They sell hand-loomed soft furnishings.

name: Jayalakshmi Silk
description: The oldest and most popular destination for bridal collections and popular throughout Kerala. It also houses a very large men's collection with many traditional and modern outfits. It is suitable for a wide range of budgets.

name: American Express Foreign Exchange Services Pvt Ltd
Thomas Cook (India) Ltd
address: Palai Towers, 1st Floor, Right Wing, M G Rd

name: Blossom Book Fair
description: Good place to get brand new and second hand books at discounted rates.

name: Crossword
description: Stationery and bookstore, providing various fiction and non-fiction books and music CDs, branded pens like Cross, Sheaffer and Parker and other stationery.

name: DeeCee
description: A very large multi-lingual bookstore, famous for wide range of English fiction books.

name: Kurien's Tower
description: Has many good book stores within it. Includes DC Books.

name: Pai&Co
description: The first bookstore of the city, its very popular for all kinds of reading materials.

name: The Penguin Store
description: a desirable place to buy all sorts of books.

name: Alapatt Gold
description: One of the oldest with an extensive gold collection, ranging from traditional to modern.

name: H. Venkatesha Naik Jewellery
description: Rajaji Road, Near Kavitha Junction. Offers modern designs and lightweight collections. It also has an extensive diamond gallery and trendy collection of watches.

name: Josco Jewellers
description: A Good 916 gold and diamond jewellery.

name: Kirtilals
description: Opposite Maharaja's College Ground, MG Rd. A grand exclusive diamond gallery, featuring more than 2,000 diamond collections and platinum jewel designs.

name: Malabar Gold
description: Jewel Junction, opposite Grand Hotel, MG Road. An extensive gold, platinum and diamond collection. It has one of the largest watch gallery selling latest international premium brands like Rado, Tissot and others.

name: Oberon Mall
address: near Padivattom Signal Junction, NH Bypass Road
description: was one of the earliest large scale multi-format shopping malls here. A typical mall with wide range of branded stores, large hypermarket, anchor store of Reliance Trends (multi-brand apparels), book/stationery store, spa, beauty saloon, large food court and four-screen cinemas.

name: Centre Square
description: was the latest mall opened in Kochi and has a food court and an 11 screen multiplex called Cinepolis.

name: Bay Pride Mall
description: A small-sized family mall, one of the earliest in Kochi, in heart of city with a few brand stores, a small food court, a fitness centre, a gift shop and a music store. Also connects directly to Marine Drive.

name: Alphonsa Cosmetics Collections
description: Convent Junction. A good collection of all international and national cosmetics brands.

name: Goodwill Collections
description: TKM Park, Convent Junction. One of the largest cosmetic store with collections of jewellery and bags.

name: Le Mars
description: A popular multi-brand women's store.

name: Currents
description: Apple's premium reseller

name: Imagine
description: The first Apple premium reseller in Kerala

name: Lulu Connect
description: Gaming consoles, tablets, smartphones and other appliances.

name: QRS
description: A store for electronic appliances.

name: Reliance Digital
description: A showroom for all sorts of electronic gadgets.

name: The Grand Pavilion
address: Grand Hotel, Jewel Junction, MG Rd
description: Popular especially during evenings for its seafood, particularly karimeen pollichathu (smoked pearlspot fish) and Alleppey fish curry.

name: Ojeen
address: By-lane after SBT towards Broadway, Marine Dr
description: Variety of snacks from the Malabar region, juices and milkshakes. Ojeen is probably the only place in Kochi for the delectable, meat-rich Malabar snacks.

name: Arya Nivas
description: A chain of vegetarian restaurants run by Tamilians, famous for typical south Indian foods.

name: Hotel Thali
description: Very good Kerala-style cuisine.

name: Hotel Unnikrishnan
description: Famous for Kerala-style fish fries and set meals.

name: Indraprastha Gujarati Food Court
description: Famous for its unlimited North Indian thalis and various sweets. A full plate thali with five dishes, Roti and rice costs ₹50.

name: Krishna Kripa Seafood Restaurant
description: Good Kerala-style food, low prices and a great location.

name: Mughal Restaurant
description: Has a good range of north Indian foods and a good juice bar.

name: Banana Leaf
description: Good traditional Kerala food with non-veg and veg options.

name: Delhi Durbar
description: A good, small North Indian restaurant.

name: Kadaloram
description: Good typical Kerala buffet at about ₹300 per head.

name: Khyber Pass
address: First floor, Bimbis Restaurants, Jos Junction, MG Rd
description: A North Indian/Afghan food outlet with a wide range of tikkas and kebabs.

name: Mirch Masalas
description: Vegetarian Punjabi restaurant with good ambience.

name: Raju dhaba
description: Authentic north Indian dhaba food.

name: Sharma's Restaurant
description: Good North Indian food at low prices.

name: BTH Kempa
address: BTH Hotel, BTH Junction, Durbar Hall Rd
description: A classic hotel which dates back at least 100 years. Its restaurant, Kempa, is popular among high-end vegetarian travellers. Serves North Indian, South Indian and Kannadiga-Udupi dishes.

name: Chillis Andhra
description: Very tasty, as well as fiery food, particularly the chicken options. Few vegetarian options.

name: Hotel Dwaraka
description: It was the first star hotel in Kochi and it remains a popular option for Indian vegetarian food.

name: Ila
description: Tasty Travancore food, with both Southern Travancore veg options and Central Travancore Syrian Christian non veg specialities.

name: Sreekrishna Inn
description: This restaurant is famous for its classic look and theme, and offers a large range of Indian vegetarian dishes. The dosas are most famous, along with its elaborate thalis.

name: S36
description: Traditional North Indian cuisine, particularly Mughal specialty foods.

name: Tandoor
description: Tasty North Indian, particularly Punjabi, food. The Kadai chicken and ginger chicken is truly world class, and no other place in Kochi can offer their unique taste. The peas masala is also really superb. Their trademarks are romali roti and stuffed bread options. A full Kadai chicken serves at least 4-5 people. Caution, it is very spicy.

name: Royal Food Court
description: Good food with Arabic-Lebanese delicacies around the clock.

name: Street Menu
description: Offers a lot of grilled options at low prices.

name: Chiyang Restaurant
description: One of the oldest Chinese restaurants.

name: 14Avenue Restaurant
address: 14 Cross Rd, Main Avenue, Panampilly Nagar
description: Italian and continental cuisines, including lasagna, pies, pastas and steaks.

name: South Star
description: Well maintained, nice interiors. Food styles from North Indian, South Indian, Chinese and Arabic and a wide range of Biriyanis.

name: Arctic Circle
description: Steak, more than 14 sizzlers, such as an American styled sizzler with Texas mashed potatoes with mushroom sauce. 20 European dishes, along with a few continental salads.

name: Ayela & Keshai
description: A very good seafood restaurant with four theme courts, Kochi, Thai, Vietnamese and Japanese. It has a fresh seafood selection court, with the fish cooked in front of the guests. A multi-cuisine restaurant also operates at the site.

name: Conucopia
description: A cricket theme restaurant, operating inside Bat&Ball Inn, this restaurant is famous for its wide selection of Continental, Greek, Mediterranean cuisines.

name: Golden Dragon
address: Mercy Estate, Atlantis Junction, Ravipuram side of MG Rd
description: A pure Chinese restaurant without any Indianisation. Serves alcohol.

name: Hon. East India Company
address: Hotel Travancore Palace, Warriam Rd, Durbar Hall Rd
description: A historical themed restaurant operating within the four star Travancore Palace Hotel. Famous for its classic paintings and heritage photo galleries as well as its food. The evening buffet is one of the largest in town, offering the best of English, Kerala and North Indian cuisine.

name: Lokah World Cuisines
description: Offers nine international cuisines from an American Wild West theme to Vietnamese sea-food, Italian pastas and Arabic grills. This restaurant has a family hall, a smoking lounge, a street food area and French cafe along with bakery. Free wifi for guests.

name: Itty's Place
description: Itty's place is an eco-friendly restaurant made completely with bamboo, coir and wood having 3 sit-down options. Favourite Italy offers traditional Italian pizzas, pastas and subs.

name: Ming's Wok
description: Authentic Chinese cuisine prepared by professional chefs, using quality ingredients.

name: Spice Route
address: Level 4, Oberon Mall, NH Bypass Rd, Palarivattom
description: Themed around historical spice route with focus on traditional Persian foods.

name: Somewhere Else
description: It has a cafe and restaurant. The cafe serves a wide range of coffees and mocktails, whereas the restaurant has sizzlers, steaks, grilled wraps, burgers and desserts. Also offers some good biriyanis and Indianised European options. Free wifi for guests.

name: 24 Carat
description: A popular upscale multi-cuisine restaurant, themed around weddings, it is ideal for candle-light romantic dinners and high power lunches.

name: Central Park Bar
description: A posh, well-maintained bar having a designer lounge.

name: Glow&Corktales
description: Atlantis Junction-MG Rd. Dance floor and large lounge bar. It has night parties from Thursday to Sunday with various themes and age groups.

name: Oberoi Bar Beer and Wine
address: MG Rd, Padma Junction, North Kaloor, Kacheripady
description: A good small bar dominated by men.

name: Opium the Club
description: Palarivattom Jn., A posh upscale dance floor and large discotheque, it has various events from Tuesday to Sunday, each in various themes. (Closed on dry days)

name: Polakkulattu Sliverspoon Bar
description: A good, well maintained bar with branches in Palarivattom near Metlife, and in SA Rd at Janatha Junction.

name: Silca Bar
address: Hotel Mercy, Ravipuram area, MG Rd
description: A lovely, upscale bar lounge popular with businessmen and upscale visitors. Famous for its signature dishes and cocktails.

name: Velocity
description: A stylish bar with a wide range of liquors and beer.

name: Amaara Maradu
description: A unique heritage hangout set in a 200-year-old Mangayil house. Serves authentic Kerala coffee and popular varieties of dosas. Regular cultural performances, cooking class, ethnic handicrafts class are some of the popular activities there. The cafe also houses a large library for reading as well as venue of regular book exhibitions.

name: Barista
description: The place to cool down with coffee after a walk at Marine Drive. Not cheap though.

name: BTH Coffee Shop
description: A moderate priced coffee shop, famous for its traditional Kerala snacks and savouries along with dosas and idilies.

name: Cafe Cochin Lavazza
description: The only direct Lavazza coffee outlet in South India.

name: Cafe Coffee Day
description: A popular national chain, which is a standard coffee hangout with western style eateries and a wide range of coffee.

name: Cafe Persia
description: A unique Arabic themed cafe, famous for Sheeshas/Hookah smoking and an excellent range of Arabic coffee and tea, along with snacks.

name: Kashi Art Café
description: Serves great iced coffee, fresh lunches, and a variety of sandwiches and tasty cakes.

name: Teapot
description: A unique cafe which serves a variety of teas, particularly 6 unique Indian flavours. It also has good traditional English snacks.

name: YMCA Youth Centre
price: A/c starts from ₹800 and non A/c starts from ₹375
description: indoor sports, parking facility with a reasonable restaurant.

address: St Benedict Road, Near the North Railway Station

name: K. K. International
description: good restaurant attached.

name: Hotel Excellency
description: Very near to South Railway station, this is a moderate business hotel. Very good interiors, a restaurant and nice staff.

name: Hotel Kavitha International
description: Clean hotel, very near MG Rd at the heart of city. 24 hr reception.

name: John’s Residency
price: ₹700 for a double room (also for one pax)
description: At the Ernakulam side, it's a very laid back place, where the check in is sometimes done by phone at the reception with the number to call. The fact that is on the Ernakulam side make it cheaper. It's not far from the train station (Ernakulam Jn.), the metro Maharaja College it's even closer, and the ferry jeti (to reach Fort Kochi) it's also at 5 minutes walk. They have double rooms and apparently one single room (which is always taken)

name: Banana Hut Hotel
description: Basic rooms, but cheap and kind hosts. Leaving your bag there during the day is possible and was safe.

name: AJ Residency
description: Near Kaloor bus stand at Kaloor Road and nearby Palarivattom Shopping district. It has the Rahamaniya tender Chicken Restaurant at ground floor.

name: Hotel Aiswarya
description: A good well maintained hotel with nice interiors and good hospitality in heart of the city.

name: Hotel Bijus
address: Cannon Shed Rd, Near Boat Jetty
description: Ideal hotel for budget tourist. A well maintained, clean and nice hotel.

name: Abad Plaza
description: One of the oldest hotels in town. There is also another hotel just behind which belongs to this chain. It has good restaurants, pools, gyms, spa, supermarket, bookshop and business facilities in centre of the city.

name: Avenue Centre Hotel
description: A good hotel in an upscale residential area with a multi-cuisine restaurant and swimming pools.

name: BTH
description: The oldest business hotel of the town, BTH is a popular option, especially among Indian families. It has good lawns, a large swimming pool and vegetarian restaurants.

name: Mermaid Hotel
description: Spacious rooms with river views.

name: Old Courtyard
description: An old Dutch bungalow, remodelled with modern interiors. Famous for lovely dinner parties.

name: Sealord Hotel
description: One of the first star rated hotels in Kochi and offers rooms at moderate rates. Has good restaurants and a pub.

name: Time Square Hotel
description: A business hotel.

name: Dreams
description: A premium property which is a sister concern of Times Hotel-New York, with all 5 star facilities.

name: The Gateway Hotel Marine Drive Ernakulam
description: Near the harbour with good sea views. Popular amongst business visitors and upscale tourists. It has very large pools, cafe, gardens and own ferry services. This is a 4-star property of the Taj Group.

name: Gokulam Park Inn International
description: A 4-star property in the business corner of Kochi. Has a good convention centre and a host of facilities.

name: Harbour View
description: Ideal business class hotel, with lot of premium features, in the main area of city.

name: Holiday Inn
address: NH Bypass, Vennala 33/1739 A, Chakkaraparambu Junction
description: 132 king bedrooms, 47 twin rooms; 18 deluxe rooms; 12 executive suites, 1 presidential suite and 2 specially able rooms. Tea/coffee makers, iron and iron board, separate work area; LCD, TVs, mini bar and safe. Restaurant, cafe, sports pub, pool bar, outdoor swimming pool, fitness centre, multilingual staff and business centre.

name: Adams Wood House
description: Four clean rooms with comfortable beds. The owner,and his family are very friendly and helpful. Free Wi-Fi, help with arranging trips inside and outside of town. Breakfast available.

name: Sherlys Casa Grande
description: Features a lake view.

name: Amrita Institute of Medical Sciences (AIMS)
description: One of the top 10 leading specialist hospitals in South Asia. AIMS is reputed for its cost effective complex treatments and latest medical care facilities. Reputed for its cost-effective surgeries, the hospital offers several specialised over-all general check-ups

name: Lakeshore Hospital
address: Near Maradu Bridge, NH Bypass, Maradu
description: One of the most high tech hospital in South India famous for its innovative, modern medical treatment. Has various specialised departments including cancer care treatment and bone/neuro treatment. The cardiac division has the latest facilities and highly qualified dcotors. There are 8 other specialist clinics. The hospital is well-equipped with all emergency services. Also offers comprehensive medical check-up services.

name: Medical Trust Hospital
description: One of the oldest Super Specialty hospital in heart of the city, this hospital is one of the most important referral hospital in Kerala. Famous for its organ transplant operations. Has the largest number of intensive care facilities in the state. It's a very crowded hospital but is well organised. This hospital is part of Rapid Medical Action Force and they have an accident care.

name: City Hospital
description: A good hospital, with accident care facilities. It is famous for its orthopedics and paediatrics department.

name: EMS Co-operative Library
description: A well maintained library where subscribers can register by presenting proof of identity(non-residents of Ernakulam will have to pay 50% extra on admission and annual fees). There are many subscription plans (₹50 as admission fees, plus annual membership fees starting from ₹100). This library also has a park near it, though it is not very well maintained.

name: Ernakulam Public Library
description: The Ernakulam Public Library is one of the oldest public library in India started in 1839. Books could be rented for 2 weeks for various rental options ranging from ₹60 for four books to ₹15 for single book. A refundable caution deposit is required ranging between ₹1,000-250 depending upon membership class. There is a free reading room with good collection of all national and international newspapers and magazines. Try here if you like read some of the treasured archives or original historical manuscripts.

name: Eloor Lending Library
description: A chain of private lending libraries. To become a member, you must pay a ₹1,000 deposit (which is refunded when you close your membership). A 14-day loan costs 10% of the price of the books you take.

name: Kochi Central Police Station
description: This is the main police station in Kochi.

name: Kochi Women Police Station
description: A female-staffed police station dedicated to assist female travellers.

name: Foreigners Registration Office-FRO
description: The city commissioner is the FRO, who has powers and authorization for any immigration issues. For any visa conversion, loss/theft of foreign passports, extension of visa, overstay of visa, immigration clearance, reporting a missing foreigners then report at this office.

name: Bhai Bazar
description: Popular hangout of north Indian laborers. Very cheap for mobile telephones and accessories. Clothes and trinkets of the cheapest variety are available here.

name: Apsara Restaurant
description: Famous for their legendary mutton biriyani. Locals say they don't use any refrigeration and everything is given fresh.

name: Cooperative College Building
description: This old college is converted into a hostel where sleeping space is rented @ ₹10 per night. The customers are north Indian workers. Several other places are also available @ ₹500 per month.

name: Appan Thampuran Smarakam
description: Established in 1976 at Ayyanthole where Sri. Ramavarma Appanthampuran who lived the Kumarapuram Palace. This is also a cultural museum.

name: Archeological & Art Museum
address: Kollengode Palace, Chembukavu, Co Operative Rd, Chembukkav
description: It has the best collection of wood carvings, metal sculptures and ancient jewelers of the Cochin dynasty.

name: Basilica of Our Lady of Dolours
alt: Our Lady of Dolours Syro-Malabar Catholic Basilica
description: The Roman Catholic Minor Basilica built in 1875 is locally called Puthen Palli. The long steeple is visible from anywhere in the town. The chapel has 15 altars. It boasts neo-Gothic spires and the largest interior of any church in South India with a lot of mural paintings on the walls and ceilings.

name: Shakthan Thampuran Palace
description: Named as Vadakkekara Palace, was reconstructed in Kerala-Dutch style in 1795 by Sri. Ramavarma Thampuran of the erstwhile Princely State of Cochin, well as Sakthan Thampuran(Greatest ruler of the Cochin dynasty) is preserved by Archaeological Department.

name: Thrissur Zoo
price: Person above 12 years ₹20, person below 12 years & above 5 years ₹5, family ticket (father, mother & 2 children below 12 years) ₹40, still camera ₹25, handheld video camera ₹100
address: Town Hall Rd, Udaya Nagar, Chembukkav
description: It is a major attraction for children and students with a variety of animals. There is a special building which houses snakes. Two beautiful niches with majestic seating are arranged for senior citizens to take rest while their children enjoy the sprawling zoo campus.

name: Vilangan Kunnu
description: This hillock has been converted by the tourism department as an amusement park. While grown ups relish the scenic splendor from the hill top. Children can relax and play to their hearts. Lot of people use this place for their morning walk. Early in the morning walking to the top of hillock is a good exercise. View from top of the hill is really good especially at the time of sun rise and sun set. Now this place is under control of Thrissur District Tourism Promotion Council and they charge nominal fee for admission to amusement park and parking the vehicle.

name: Vaidyaratnam Ayurveda Museum
address: Thaikkattussery Rd, opp. Vaidyaratnam Post Office, Thaikkattussery
description: Vaidyaratnam Ayurveda Museum is a museum showcasing the richness, the variety and the evolution of the Ayurveda traditional medicine of India. The museum was inaugurated by A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, former President of India, on 28 December 2013.

name: Nehru Park
description: Nehru Park, Thrissur, is a children’s park named after the first Prime Minister of India Jawaharlal Nehru and is owned by Thrissur Municipal Corporation. Park is located in the heart of the city with great scenery spread across 8.5 acres. The park was inaugurated by the first Vice President of India Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan in 1959.

name: Valiyalukkal Temple
description: Beautiful Bhagavathy Temple in a photogenic sprawling sylvan compound.

name: Our Lady of Lourdes Metropolitan Cathedral
description: Our Lady of Lourdes Metropolitan Cathedral, one of the largest churches in Kerala, is located in the heart of Thrissur City in the state of Kerala, India. The main attraction is an underground shrine, considered a masterpiece of architectural design. Fr John Maliekkal is said to have planned and constructed this church.

name: Athirappilly Falls
description: This high waterfall at the threshold of the Sholayar ranges on the Western Ghats is a popular picnic spot. Two amusement parks, DreamWorld and SilverStorm, are located nearby. The falls are referred to as the Niagara Falls of India - you can spot two large falls reminiscent of the bridal veil and Horseshoe Falls at Niagara, and a smaller falls nearby. The falls are most famous for being shooting locations for popular Indian movies such as Ravan, Punnagai Mannan and Guru. From the entrance, a 5-minute walk leads to the head of the falls. From there, a walking path criss-crosses downward to the foot of the falls. The water falls into a deep well, making the location unseemingly dangerous, so the water area is off-limits to tourists.

name: Kallayikkunnu
description: This hill station is also known as Narimadakkunnu. This is a beautiful place. Many newly married couples prefer this place for still and moving photography, while many film makers also prefer this place for song scenes. It's a place of natural beauty.

name: Kerala Kalamandalam
description: It is in Cheruthuruthy and was founded by the Poet Sri. Vallathol Narayana Menon, to encourage the study of the ancient arts of Kerala such as Kathakali and Mohiniyattom.

name: Peechi Dam
description: It is a good picnic spot. Buses from Thrissur and by taxi. Boating is permitted in the reservoir and occasionally you can see wild tuskers on the forested banks, part of which forms a reserved forest.

name: Punnathur Kotta Elephant Sanctuary
description: It is unique in being the largest elephant park in the world with over 60 elephants.

name: Vazhachal Waterfalls
description: Close to dense forests and a part of the Chalakudy river.

name: Snehatheeram, Thalikkulam
description: A favorite beach picnic spot for local people with essential facilities, good restaurants and life guard on duty. This is similar in concept to Cherai beach; but a lot less crowded. This facility won a state tourism award in 2011.

name: Chavakad Beach
description: A seashore of rare scenic beauty. Acknowledged as one of the best beaches along the west coast.

description: Vegetarian breakfast, lunch and dinner. North Indian dishes served after 6PM. Famous for their Masala Dosai.

description: Continental and Indian restaurant

name: Konni Elephant Cage
description: Konni is the gateway to the forest bordering the district. In the past, wild elephants caught from the forests were brought here and put in wooden cages known as Anakoodu to be tamed and trained for work. It is situated 11 km away from Pathanamthitta.

name: Vagamon
description: A nice place to visit, with pine trees to explore!

name: Spices
description: Enjoy the Spicy flavours of Kerala. Walk among the cardamom plantations. Shop for spices.

name: jeep safari
description: The safari here is quite bad, you pay rate for whole car, price starting at ₹2000-3000 per car (2023). It consists of a 2-hour drive through Vandiperiyar to the "safari" place and 1 hour in nature. No chance of animals, it is really rare to see them far in horizon, there are too many people and too much noise. It is recommended for people who like the crazy off-road. It is better to go by walking because you can at least enjoy the scenery then.

name: boat safari
description: Better chances of animals you will get in morning with the boat ride from thekkady. ₹500 is entry fee to the reservation and ₹225 is for the 1.5h boat ride on periyar lake. (2023)

name: Hilltop Spices
description: Wholesale and retail dealers in cardamom, pepper, cloves, cinnamon and other spices, which are locally grown.

name: Red Frog
description: for Musical instruments, home accessories and spices

name: Summer Palace
description: Built by Srimoolam Thirunal, this was the favorite summer residence of Travancore Rajas. It is now a private residence.

name: Hope Church
description: More than 150 years old.

name: Ashley Bungalow
description: An early example of colonial architecture in a spectacular setting.

name: Tomb Of Peer Muhammad
description: The Sufi saint whom Peermade is said to be named after.

name: Panchalimedu
description: Hill station and viewpoint. Linked in legend to the Pandavas of the Mahabarata.

name: Amrutha Mala
description: Mountain peak attractive to hikers.

name: Grampi
description: Rock sculpture about 150 ft (46 m) high and about 3,800 feet (1,200 m) above sea level.

name: Thottapura
description: The place where the Travancore royal family stored weapons.

name: Baker Hills
description: Rolling hills with views.

name: Panchalimedu
description: A viewpoint, according to legend one of the many hiding places of the Pandavas and Panchali. From a pond known as Panchalikkulam, the Makarajyothi, the divine flame lit during the pilgrimage season in Sabarimala, can be seen.

name: Valanjanganam waterfalls
description: A main attraction of Kuttikkanam. The waterfall is about 75 ft (23 m) in height and is usually covered in mist.

name: Artificial forest
description: A dense pine forest covering , classified as a buffer zone by the Kerala state forestry department, with an estimated 30 species of birds, including rare endangered species.

name: Azhutha Diversion Project
description: A project constructed by the Kerala government on the Azutha river, diverting water to Idukki Reservoir through a 987 m long tunnel.

name: Valiyakoikkal Shree Dharma Shasta Temple
description: Here, you can see the gold ornaments which are supposed to be worn by Lord Ayyappa. Entry is restricted to Hindus.

name: Shines
description: You will find cabins in 1st floor where you can have drinks in privacy.

name: Orthodox Church of Mar Gregorious
description: It is here that Geevarghese Mar Gregorios, the first declared saint of The Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church, is entombed. The commemoration ormapperunnal is celebrated on the first and second of every November, and a large number of people flock to this place for worship. People prefer to get here at that time by walking from all over the Nation. The government recognised Parumala Church is known as the International Pilgrim Center.

name: Panayanar Kaavu
description: Temple considered one of the oldest in Kerala.

name: Amaravkavu
description: A devi temple with in the forest

name: Peripheral Villages
description: Manakkadu, Perumpillichira, Kumaramangalam, Muthalakudom, Thekkumbhagom, West Kodikulam, East Kodikulam, Parapuzha, Padikkapadam, Thennathoor, Koduveli, Vannapuram, Pannimattom, Mrala, Muttom, Purapuzha, Kolani, Karinkunnam, Vandamattom, Olamattom and Udumbannore.

name: Hotel Maurya Monarch
description: Right in the town, close to the Civil Station and the main river bridge. Moderately priced, quality seems to have declined.

name: Hotel Cicilia
description: ½ km from the town, board & lodge for the upscale and choosy traveller), close to the KSRTC Bus Stand, on the Thodupuzha-Muttom Road.

name: St. George Forane Church
description: Celebrates its feast during the month of May is an important location for Christian pilgrims.

name: Riverscape home stay
description: Set in the picturesque background of Kuttanad region of Kerala in Alappuzha District (also known as Alleppy) is the serene village of Edathua. Riverscape home stay is located in the centre of Kerala making day visits to tourist locations very convenient. Home stay in Edathua is surrounded by the backwaters, paddy fields, greenery and the Pamba River. Edathua is almost untouched by tourists making it an exclusive location for a vacation.

name: Krishnapuram Palace
description: Palace and museum with exhibits about the Travancore kingdom. The palace was built during the 18th century by Travancore Maharaja Marthanda Varma.

name: Elaveezha Poonchira
alt: Valley where leaves do not fall
description: A hill station with large hills around high. Beautiful hillocks named Mankunnu, Kudayathoormala, Thonippara and Poonchira are here. A pool here is remembered in local folklore as a bathing place used by Panchali, the legendary heroine of the Mahabharata.

name: Erumely
description: Important pilgrimage centre for Hindus and Muslims.

name: Ettumanoor
description: Famous for having an ancient Shiva temple. Wall paintings in the temple are thousands of years old. The temple is also famous for its seven and a half golden elephants, a sequence of seven large and one small statues of elephants.

name: Kumarakom
description: The place is famous for its bird sanctuary, house boats, backwaters, canals and the bungalow of Henry Baker (now run as part of a resort managed by the Taj group of hotels).

name: Manarcaud
description: St. Mary's Shrine here attracts people of all faiths. Various kinds of offerings are made here devotees.

name: Pathiramanal Island
description: This is a small white sand island. It gets its name from the brilliant reflection of moonlight from the sand.

name: Poonjar Palace
description: The Palace of Poonjar Royal family, one of major principalities of Travancore Kingdom, was home of one of Kerala's famous prince, Prince G.V. Raja. This building is famous for its collection of antiques, exquisite furniture, chandeliers, palm leaf engravings, jewel boxes, a variety of lamps, sculptures of Nataraja (Shiva as Lord of the Dance), grain measures, statues and weapons.

name: St. Mary's Church
alt: Known as Cheria Palli (the Little Church)
description: Belonging to the Malankara Orthodox Church was built in 1579 by the Raja of Thekkumkur for his Christian subjects. The interior murals, painted using vegetable dyes, depict Biblical themes.

name: St.Mary's Forane Church
description: One of the oldest churches of Kerala is the St Mary’s Church Kuravilingadu, which was supposed to have been established in 105 AD. It is believed that Mother Mary's first appearance in the world, was in Kuravilingadu. Our Lady appeared to a few children at Kuravilingadu, who were tending their flock in the bushes. Mary asked them to build a church at the place from where a miraculous perpetual spring sprouted, a spring which exists even today. The children reported this matter to the elders and a church was built there. The statue of the Blessed Virgin Mary kept at the side altar is unique. It is carved from granite and it is believed that it was brought from North India. This is a miraculous statue and the devotees call this statue "Kuravilingadu Muthiyamma". The granite cross in a single block of 48 feet in front of the church was erected around 1597. The devotees offer coconut oil in the lamps at the foot of the cross. On first Fridays devotees stand in a queue from early morning to late in the evening to offer oil. There is an ancient bell with the engraving in Syriac "Mother of God". Three bells were brought from Germany in 1911. There is a "perpetual" spring, believed to be miraculous. Moonnu Nompu" is the main feast of the church.

name: Thazhathangady Juma Masjid
description: One of the oldest mosques in India and is more than 1000 years old. The mosque is famous for its richness of architecture, wood carvings and the beauty. This mosque is situated on the banks of the Meenachil river. Thazhathangady Juma Masjid is also called as the “Taj Juma Masjid”. The ancestors of this Masjid came and settled in Kottayam, from different parts of Kerala. The Muslims who lived here played an active role in Freedom Struggle and other National Movements.

name: Thirunakkara Mahadeva Temple
description: A Shiva temple built in the Kerala style of temple architecture, and with interior murals depicting themes from the Hindu epics. It was built at the beginning of 16th century by the then Raja of Thekkumkur. The annual temple festival that culminates in a ceremony called the Aaraattu, attracts large number of devotees.

name: Vaikom Temple
description: Famous for its Shiva Temple.

name: Vembanad Lake
description: 83.72 km length and 14.48 km width. Cruise boats, house boats and traditional cargo boats.

name: Wagamon
description: Enchanting hill station at an elevation of 1100 m, with tea gardens and meadows.

name: Puthupally
description: Puthuppally St. George Church is one of the oldest and renowned churches of Malankara Orthodox Church. The patron saint of this parish is St. George. It's by the side of coconut palms and a wide stretch of paddy fields, at a beautiful and serene village called Puthuppally which is about 8 km from Kottayam Town. This church is the refuge of thousands of people all over the world who seek the intercession of St.George. It is believed that this church was established as a shrine of Changanacherry Pally which in turn was a shrine of Niranam pally, one of the "Ezhara Pallis" consecrated by St.Thomas Theapostle of India.

name: Public Water Transport Kottayam to Alappuzha
description: Kottayam to Alappuzha. 6.35 am , 11.30 am, 1.00 pm and 3.30 and 5.15 pm.

name: Annual Food Festival
description: Kottayam also has an annual food and flower show. These events are quite popular and are worth a visit, if you are in town when it happens.

name: Boat Races
description: Lots of boat races with traditional boats of different sizes - around 50 types - in the months of July, August and September during Onam.

name: Nalumanikkattu Paddy Fields
address: 10 km on Manarcaud to Ettumanoor Road
description: Local food, children's park and hiking options, very green surroundings.

name: Panchalimedu Hills
description: Trekking facility in snowy mountains above sea level, organized by Peruvanthanam village council. You can see the Alappuzha sea on clear days. Famous Panchaly Pond with legendary associations with the Indian epic Mahabharatha. According to the myths, Pandavas along with their spouse Panchali had a sojourn there at time of one-year exile. The place can be also accessed from Murinjapuzha (5 km) and Amalagiri (6 km) on the Kottayam - Kumily state highway (K.K road).

name: Bird Sanctuary
description: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary (also known as Vembanad Bird Sanctuary) is situated at Kumarakom in Kottayam district in the Indian state of Kerala, on the banks of Vembanad Lake. Set in the Kerala Backwaters the bird sanctuary is an ornithologist's paradise and a favourite haunt of migratory birds.

name: 100-Acre Water Lily Flower Farms
description: This view is available only during August and September every year. Visit during the early morning (6AM to 9PM local time) as the pink lily flowers wilt due to sunlight.

name: Kumarakom Heritage Resort
description: Has a swimming pool, banquet hall, ayurveda wellness, restaurant, lounge bar. Provides yoga, backwater cruise, inland water cruise, cycling, horse riding, fishing.

name: Niraamaya Retreats Backwaters & Beyond, Kumarakom
description: It is nestled on the banks of the Lake Vembanad with lush tropical gardens set around 27 luxurious villas.

name: Kumaranalloor Devi Temple
description: The place of Goddess Madurai Meenakshi at Kumaranalloor, Kottayam. Considered one of the most important Devi temples among the 108 durgalayas (devi temples) in Kerala. It is said to be more than 2400 years old, as per historical and mythological evidences as well as other sources of information. The architecture of the temple is notable for the unique structure of the nalambalam and sreekovil both of which have been built in the sreechakra style (ring like object with a handle, which is placed in the right hand of the devi). This kind of architecture is rarely found in temple architecture.

name: St. George Forane Church
description: Celebrates its feast during the month of May is an important location for Christian pilgrims.

name: Riverscape home stay
description: Set in the picturesque background of Kuttanad region of Kerala in Alappuzha District (also known as Alleppy) is the serene village of Edathua. Riverscape home stay is located in the centre of Kerala making day visits to tourist locations very convenient. Home stay in Edathua is surrounded by the backwaters, paddy fields, greenery and the Pamba River. Edathua is almost untouched by tourists making it an exclusive location for a vacation.

name: Nilakkal Sree Mahadeva Temple
description: Temple devoted to the Lord Shiva and halting place for Sabarimala pilgrims.

name: St Ignatius Orthodox MahaEdavaka Kaipattoor
description: This church was built at the end of the 19th century. It has been declared as 'Maha Idavaka'. The church has a Raasa every year in the month of December.

name: Omallur Raktakantaswami Temple
description: Raktakantaswami Temple Temple having idol of Lord Ayyappan, the temple celebrates the Yearly Utsav at summer of April and May. The Utsav goes on for 10 days. Possessions of more than 10 Elephants, elephants are decorated so beautifully one can feel the gods and goddess of heaven are on earth at that precious ceremony. Omallur is a small village 5km from Pathanamthitta town. There is a famous Rakthakanta temple also known as the Omallur Ambalam. This Rakthakanta Swamy Temple and the annual cattle fair held during March-April are the main attractions of Omallur. People from both within and outside the State participate in the fair.

name: Malayalapuzha Devi Temple
description: Malayalapuzha houses the one of the largest Devi (Goddess Durga) Temple and the goddess here is believed to grant boons to devotees and help them realise dreams. The temple has beautiful wall paintings and artistic stone carvings. This temple is famous for the ten day long Padayani performances held in connection with the annual festival in April/ May.

name: Thiruvalla Sreevallabha Temple
description: Sree Vallabha Temple is one among the one hundred and eight Vaishnava temples in India, hence it is also one of the important pilgrim centers of the Vaishnavites (worshippers of Vishnu) all over the country. The temple is extremely famous for its large Vedic school, where students are trained in Vedas and Hindu Tantric practices. The temple is also famous for its large Kathakali performances, performed daily in evenings.

name: Pandalam Palace
description: Located in Pandalam, the palace was once home of Lord Ayyappa, where he lived for 16 years, before becoming ascetic. The palace, thus became a major religious center, though the erstwhile royal family continues to live in the complex. A large temple is located within palace complex, known as Valiyakovil Temple, believed to home of Prince Ayyappa. The Palace also displays a large treasures of Lord Ayyappa's princely costumes and crown jewels along with his armory. Lord Ayyappa, before ascending to Sabarimala as a hermit, allowed his father to bring his princely costumes and jewels to Sabarimala, where he will wear it only on Makara Sankranti day for his father to see him princely costume. Ever since that, before Sankranti day, a grand procession starts from this palace, carrying the jewels and other treasure boxes to Sabarimala.

name: Niranam
description: Niranam church, is the first church to be established by St. Thomas when he landed in Kerala. It is one of the most important non-Catholic Christian pilgrimage center and seat of Kerala Orthodox Church.

name: Parumala
description: Parumala is renowned for the presence of the tomb of St. Gregorios (Parumala Thirumeni), the greatest orthodox saint of India belonging to the Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church. Parumala Thirumeni is the first declared saint of The Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church and the first Canonized Indian Saint. The church is recognized as major International Christian pilgrimage center.

name: Kalloppara St. Mary's Church
description: St.Mary's church at Kalloppara stands in close proximity to the Bhagavathi temple within one complex as an example of the communal harmony of the place. There are two pre-Christian era granite slabs inside the church with some inscriptions in ancient Pali language. There are several Hindu-Christian wall-paintings all over the place.

name: Manjinikkara Syrian Orthodox Church
description: Mar Ignatitus Elias 111, the holy Patriarch of Anthioch of Damascus, while on his state visit to India, died at this place in 1932. His mortal remains are kept in the church at Manjinikkara. Pilgrims from other parts of India and foreigners, visit this place frequently. The Church celebrates a festival in February every year which is attended by thousands.

name: Maramon Christian Convention Banks
description: Maramon is famous for the International Christian Bible Convention held here, on the vast sandy beds of the River Pamba. Started in 1896, the Maramon Convention is held annually by the Mar Thoma Evangelistic Association (MTEA), the missionary wing of the Mar Thoma Church. Though a religious convention of Christians it is attended by people belonging to all communities. The seven day convention takes place in February, have daily disclosures on various Biblical themes. Addressed by speakers of international repute and attended by devotees innumerable, this is one of the largest Christian conventions in the world and largest in Asia, with more than 1 million attending the programs. The centenary celebration of the convention was held in February 1995.

name: Charalkunnu
description: Charalkunnu is a picturesque hill station from where one can have a panoramic view of the low lying areas including river Pamba. Much of the hill station is least exploited, hence ideal for those who seeks quiet and idyllic holidays without much commercialization. The erstwhile Marammath Guest Palace of Travancore Kingdom, now serves as a major accommodation for tourists here, as other accommodation options are less.

name: Kakki reservoir
description: Kakki reservoir, set in sylvan background, is an upcoming tourist destination. The splendid artificial lake offers an exhilarating boating experience. The surrounding forest abounds in tigers, elephants, deer and monkeys, offering a wonderful insight into the wildlife of the area.

name: Konni Elephant Sanctuary
description: Konni is the gateway to the forest bordering the district. It is here wild elephants caught from the forests were brought here and put in wooden cages known as Anakoodu to be tamed and trained for work. It is situated 11 km away from Pathanamthitta. An elephant training college and elephant research center operates here.

name: Perumthenaruvi Water Falls
description: It's a small, yet beautiful waterfall, which is a popular picnic spot.

name: Mannadi Dalawa Memorial
description: Mannadi has a memorial dedicated to Kerala's most cherished national hero, Velu Thampi Dalawa, ousted Prime Minister of the erstwhile Kingdom of Travancore raised the first organized armed rebellion against the British in 1807 regarded as the first major armed mutiny against Britishers in India. It was here, Velu Thampi committed suicide after losing battle against British Army, in order to avoid capture. An ancient Bhagavathi Temple with exquisite sculptures is also nearby, from where Velu Thampi planned several of his attacks against Britishers, who shook the foundations of British Empire in South India. The Kerala Institute of Folklore and Folk Arts are also close by with large display of traditional folk costumes and murals.

name: Kaviyoor Rock Temple
description: The only surviving ancient cave temples in Kerala, built in ancient Tamil Pallava style, which is more of cultural interest than religious purpose. The temple is dedicated to Monkey God- Hanuman, hence today one can see hordes of monkeys dominating the temple and its surroundings. A regular feast for monkeys is a rare interesting sight for outsiders.

name: Vijnana Kala Vedi Cultural Centre
description: Established in 1977 by a French woman, Louba Schild, under the Indo-French cultural programme, this institute is dedicated to preserving the arts of Kerala. Everything from singing to dancing to cooking to community living is taught here. Large number of foreigners, particularly French nationals camp here, for learning Schild's Mohiniyattom, in which she has specialized.

name: Muloor Smarakom
description: Muloor S.Padmanabha Panicker (1869-1931) who was a famous Malayalam poet and an important social reformer of the century was born at Elavumthitta 12 km away from Pathanamthitta. His home at Elavumthitta is preserved as a monument by the Department of Culture, with several original manuscripts.

name: Thiruvabharanam Procession
description: The Thiruvabharana (Sacred Treasures) of Lord Ayyappa, which is preserved in Pandalam Palace, will be taken to Sabarimala as a grand procession. The procession starts in first week of January, only to reach at Sabarimala on Makara Sankrathi Day (second week of January). The procession is a religious experience, with huge number of people accompanying the 3 chests of treasures each held by one selected person. The procession will be accompanied by armed battalions of police, various religious bands and traditional accompaniments, which stops at all major temples, enroute. The spectacular sight is that, the sacred Krishnaparutthu (Lord Garuda- the sacred eagle of Lord Vishnu) appears before Pandalam Palace, which signs the start of procession and escorts the procession by flying over the procession, until reaching Sabarimala. On reaching Sabarimala, the Garuda flies around the temple for 3 times, before disappearing.

name: Boat Race
description: The Stretch of riverpamba at Aranmula (about 10 km from Chengannur) is the venue of the famous snake boat race. It is more a pageantry than a race. The snake boat is of an extra ordinary shape with a length of about 100 ft. The rear portion towering to a height of about 20 ft and the front portion tapering gradually.The boat resembles a snake with its hood raised. The race is held on the last day of the week long Onam festival to commemorate the crossing of the river by Lord Krishna. The participants cheerfully row up and down the river to the tune of songs known as Vanchippattu.

name: J&F
description: Serves authentic North Indian dishes like tandoori naan, kababs and various other Kashmiri and Punjabi dishes. This food joint is very popular among college students, and its fame, though spread through word of mouth, is fast catching up with the residents of Pathanamthitta. The serving and preparations are hygienic, although the prices are a bit exorbitant.

name: Cafe de Kashmir
description: Similar to J&F.

name: Mannil Regency
description: Veg & non-veg.

name: Aryabhavan
description: Veg only.

name: Hotel Evergreen Inter-Continental
description: Veg & non-veg.

name: Consumer Fed Wine Shops
description: Here you can buy the drinks but will need to find a place to drink.

name: Shines
description: one of the cheap and best bars

name: Rubber Plantation
description: Tapping and processing of rubber.

name: Bharananganam Church
description: Where the mortal remains of St. Alphonsa are kept.

name: Shrine of St. Mary
description: You would not miss this tall granite shrine with its massive statue of Jesus Christ at the top, reminding you of the one in Rio de Janeiro (ignore the size difference!). If you happen to visit Palai in the first week of December, you should not miss the most important festival of Palai, which is the feast of St. Mary at this shrine.

name: Kadappattur Temple
description: It is well known pilgrim place on the way to Sabarimala. Lord Siva is the idol here. The temple is situated on the bank of river Meenachil. In every year July 14th is celebrated as the birthday of "Kadappatturappan", beacause in that day the idol is appeared.

name: Ann's Bake House
description: A good place for short eats. The cakes and pastries that you get there are tasty and cheaper than what you pay for in the larger cities.

name: Coffee and Snacks
description: Famous for their Cutlet, Pudding, Chicken Fry, Vellayappam, Dosa and Beef Fry.

name: Hotel Maharani
description: The only approved two-star hotel.

name: Vaikom Mahadeva Temple
description: Famous for Prathal (mid-day food offering by individual to others) and also Annathanam (served by the temple). Having this full fleged meal is very sacred too.

name: St.Joseph Forane Church
description: A centuries old Roman Syrian Catholic Church with ancient and rare interior architecture near the Vembanad Lake shore

name: Udayanapuram
description: Village backwater cruise, Visit different villages and village activities, ayurvedic treatment centre, Home stay with traditional Kerala food, night fishing etc.

name: Nalukettu Homestay
address: Thottuchira, Near Nanadam market, Opp. Athurasramam English Medium School
description: A traditional wooden Nalukettu style Home stay with tiled roofing, which facilitates with well furnished air conditioned room, wifi, hot water, Library, traditional Kerala food, boating facility, ayurvedic treatment and rejuvenation facility, night fishing in the canal (4-5 feet depth).

name: Vilappuram
description: A small place, home of the famous Vilappuram Devi Temple (Anandavilasam Bhagavathi Temple). In the same compound there is the famous Anandavilasam library, affiliated to Kerala State Library Council having more than 1200 members and around 13000 books. In the library there is the facilities of computer, internet, telephone etc. Children's Wing, Ladies Wing, Women's Home Library Scheme, Continuing Education Centre etc are available here.

name: Polachira
description: A favourite haunt of migratory birds. Now it is a developing zone in tourist concept. Now there is a bridge over polachira which connects road named Polachira Bund Across Road. It is the shortest route from Chathannoor to Varkala. You can go to see elephants in Anathavalam at Chirakkarathazham from here and it is only one km from Polachira.

name: Temples
description: If you interested you can visit the famous temples of Chathannoor, Bhoothanatha Kshethram,Kanjiram vila bhgavathi kshethram, Chennamath Kshethram, Vilappuram bhagavathy kshethram, paniyil thekkevila bhagavathi temple, paniyil guru mandiram. etc. Do not forget to visit Valiya Pally (St George Orthodox Church)-the ancient and parent church of all the Christian churches in and around Chathannoor.

name: Thirumukku Mosque
description: The Mosque is an important place to visit. Hundreds of people will be coming here for the Friday Juma.

name: Polachira
description: Go to and see the beautiful views of the nature then you can go to Anathavalam to see elephants. Do not forget to stay some time at Mannathipara here to have a better look of Polachira.

name: Kotherimukku
address: Sree Dharmasasta Temple, Uliyanadu School Rd, Kotheri
description: This is lord Ayyappa Temple.

name: Sree Dharma Sasta Temple
description: This is a temple of lord Ayyappa..Hundreds of people come every Saturday for Shani pooja (Saturn prayers).

name: Temple festivals
description: Sree Bhoothanatha Temple, Kanjiramvila Bhagavathi Temple, Chennamath Shiva Temple, Vilappuram Bhagavathy Temple, Vayalunada Bhagavathi Temple etc are famous temples in this town. Festivals in these temples attracts peoples from other places also. "The Nedum Kuthira" of Sree Bhoothanatha Temple on the festival is the biggest of its kind in South Kerala. The second largest festival is in Chennamath Shiva Temple.

name: St George Orthodox Church
description: Christhos Marthoma Church ,Malankara Catholic Church etc are famous churches in this town. St George Feast (Perunnal) of Valiya Palli falls on the first week of May every year and thousands of devotees throng to the church to celebrate the feast and in the colourful procession.

name: 8-Wonders Resort
description: An Ayurvedic and yoga resort with splendid view, straight on the cliff. Comfortable bungalows and rooms with attached shower/toilet. Garden, sit-outs, restaurant; some nice and peaceful beaches are very close. English, Malayalam, Hindi, some Spanish spoken.

name: AsinMomo Homestay
price: Homestay ₹350-₹800, pending on length and season, double or single occupation
description: A Homestay, Bed and Breakfast. Simple, comfortable rooms with attached shower/toilet. WiFi, garden, sit-out, home made food and drinks by the owner Jessini,a Washing machine is there and very close, some nice and peaceful beaches. English, Malayalam, Hindi, German, French, Italian and some Spanish spoken.

name: Aleema Beach Resort
description: A really romantic place in the backside of Odayam Beach with the great view over the entire beach. 5 rooms, with sit-outs, a roof top, garden are there. Breakfast is available, and local food by order is made by Safers family. Great atmosphere ! saferkasali@yahoo.com

name: Alumkadavu
description: Scenic place, with blue green stretches back water, coconut palms, back water cruise, house boats, Ayurvedic treatment centers.

name: Aryankavu
description: Pilgrim centre, old trade route for merchants from either sides of western Ghats, famous for shrine of Lord Sastha, fine sculptures and mural paintings.

name: Chavara
description: Famous for the mineral sand and place of Catholic saint Sister Alphonsa.

name: Kalayapuram
description: It is believed that old Kalayan royal family were ruled from this place, hence the name Kalayapuram.

name: Karunagappally
description: Famous mosque and dome of martyrs, a unique pilgrimage center. Old military station of Kayamkulam Rajas.

name: Kottarakkara
description: Erstwhile capital of Elayadathu Swarupam, a ruling family. Famous for Kath Kali (a dance drama).

name: Kundara
description: A prominent place in the area famous for industries.

name: Mannadi
description: Famous as the place where Veluthampi Dalawa laid down his life.

name: Mayyanad
description: Famous for its shrines and temples.

name: Neendakara
description: Famous for its fisheries industries.

name: Sasthamcotta
description: Biggest freshwater lake in Kerala.

name: Thenmala
description: Dam site with dense forest is famous for eco tourism.

name: Sakthikulangara
description: Where the Ashtamudi lake meets the Arabian Sea. Here you will find a leaning lighthouse, similar to the leaning tower of Pisa.

name: Infant Jesus Cathedral
alt: Malayalam: ഇൻഫന്റ് ജീസസ് കത്തീഡ്രൽ, Portuguese: Igreja do Bom Jesú
description: A vestige of the Portuguese rule of Kollam, established in 1614.

name: St Thomas Fort
description: Some limited standing ruins of an old colonial fort. You can see two different sides of the building, the first from the harbour side (where it is visible at some distance), and the second from the opposite side. The site is slightly overgrown so beware of snakes if you venture close. An auto-rickshaw from the Main Road bus stop cost ₹50.

name: Thangassery Lighthouse
description: A modern lighthouse in a historic Christian quarter that is possible to climb in the afternoons. Best to combine with the Thangassery Fort, as the two sites are in easy and shaded walking distance.

name: Munroe Island Canoe Tours
description: Vijeesh runs canoe tours which are an excellent way to explore Munroe Island. You get to go places that the house boats can't and will literally be going through the village and get to see life there. He has great English and an excellent personality. Also runs a home stay on the island. Rickshaw ~₹400 from Kollam or local train, contact him via email/phone for train details.

name: Thangassery Beach
description: A fishing harbour.

name: Joy Allukas
description: For clothes, gold, footwear etc.

name: Kairali Handicraft
description: Handicraft from Kerala.

name: RP Mall
description: Carnival multiplex, Devi and Jajji's beauty salon, Reliance footprint & Trends for clothes, Fab India, Blackberry, Food Court, Game Zone

name: Fayalwan hotel
description: Famous for Mutton related items.

name: Salim Hotel
description: Famous for Mutton related items.

name: Ramees Hotel
description: Non Veg and Arabian Dishes

name: Thirumullavaram Hotel
description: Famous for Fish items.

name: Hotel Bright
description: Famous for their mutton chops.

name: Hotel Sea Palace
description: It has a bar.

name: Hotel Sudarshan
description: It has a bar.

name: Mariyalayam Bar
description: Bar and Resataurant.

name: Government Guesthouse
description: It is noisy as the guest house is on the national highway in the centre of the city.

name: Munroe Island Backwaters Homestay
description: Vijeesh and his family have a very quiet homestay. You eat with the family(pay what you think the meal is worth) and they are very friendly. The guest house is very modern and very clean. It was built in 2011 so is very new. Visjeesh will also take you on canoe tours of the backwaters which last the afternoon. Best way is to contact him via email or phone and he replys very fast. Rickshore is about ₹400 from Kollum bus station. Vijeesh can also arrange a driver for you if he knows what time you pull in.

name: Hotel Prashanti
description: It has a vegetarian restaurant. It's a walkable distance to the beach. It has both air conditioned and non air conditioned rooms.

name: Nani Hotel
description: Excellent location. For slightly more money than the government-run Tamarind Hotel (miles from anywhere, and nothing special) this place gets you a much nicer environ and location. Reception staff speak excellent English, others apparently cannot. At check-in I was told that no fan rooms were available, and was forced to pay for AC. However, upon complaining about the tax it was quickly considered included in the room rate instead of added on as usual: worth trying. Wifi is available but is charged at ₹50/hr, or ₹300/24hr: you wonder why the bothered installing it!

name: Tamarind Hotel
price: ~₹1200 incl. tax for an AC room (No fan rooms available)
description: An inconvenient location and poor value for the price make this a terrible selection, save for the view out over the water. The rooms are spacious, just about three times what you'd expect them to cost. A classic study in a government-run business; all the makings of success, but none of the right decisions, and an evidently rapidly progressing trend toward total apathy.

name: Mariyalayam Munroe Island Residency
description: offers a selection of 12 air-conditioned rooms. All rooms have been done up with period interiors and furniture, and come equipped with modern amenities. Spread over 1.5 acres of land with ample car parking space, drive-in-dine.

name: The Quilon Beach Hotel & Convention Centre
description: There is a pool facing the beach that looks quite nice. The beach has a children's park in it. During some days there are also cultural events conducted on an open-air stage on the beach.

name: Jatayu Earth's Center Nature Park
price: ₹400 + tax for cable car and sculpture visit. Tickets must be purchased online
address: Jatayu Nature Park Road, Jatayu Junction, Chadayamangalam
description: This rock-theme nature park has a sculpture of Jatayu, a bird that is a character in the epic Ramayana on top of a mountain. It is the world’s largest bird sculpture (200 feet (61 m) long, 150 feet (46 m) broad, 70 feet (21 m) in height. You can take a cable car ride to the sculpture. The view from the gondola is nice, and the sculpture is worth a look. Many other facilities are planned, but not yet open to the public. There will be a museum inside the sculpture and a temple to Rama. As of Jan 2019, the helicopter ride advertised on the website was not actually available. A food court where you can purchase snacks is also available - try the vazhaniyala appam, the vegetable cutlets and the banana fries - all of these are very tasty. There is a "12D" show at the cable car station that costs extra.

name: Vizhinjam Cave Temple
description: The granite cave encloses a one-celled shrine with a loose sculpture of Vinadhara Dakshinamurthi. The outer wall of the cave depicts unfinished reliefs of Shiva as "Tripurantakara" on the left and as "Nataraja" with Parvati on the right.

name: Vizhinjam Harbour
description: Head down to the harbour at sunset for some spectacular shots of the area with the seaside mosque in the background. The atmosphere is quite lively with fisherman heading to and from the sea. Note: Once the sun is down, it is probably best to head back to Kovalam unless you are with a guide. While hostility/violence to foreigners is very rare, you do not want to get caught up in a scuffle between the rivaling Christian and Muslim communities.

name: Vizhinjam Lighthouse
description: The old lighthouse, at the southern beach is a local landmark, for being one of the oldest lighthouses of Kerala, guiding ships to the nearby Vizhnjam port. The lighthouse can be visited 3-5PM daily.

name: Azhimala Shiva Temple
description: The Tamil-style koil is known for the tall Gangadhareshwara sculpture, the tallest Shiva sculpture in Kerala.

name: Lighthouse Beach
description: The largest and southernmost beach of Kovalam, known for its 35-m-high lighthouse which towers over it atop Kurumkal hillock. Most of the foreigners stay on Lighthouse Beach. Many hotels, restaurants, lodges and shops are here. There are some vendors on the beach, but they are not too pushy.

name: Hawa Beach
description: The second-largest beach of Kovala, and it takes less than five minutes to walk from Lighthouse Beach. It is named for the topless European women who used to throng there. It was the first topless beach in India, although topless bathing is banned now.

name: Samudra Beach
description: The northernmost crescent, usually crowded on weekends. It is very popular with the locals, day-travellers, and passing-by tourist buses. During the week it's quiet. A large promontory separates this part from the southern side. Samudra Beach doesn't have tourists thronging there or hectic business. The local fishermen ply their trade on this part.

name: Chowara Beach
description: Aanother spectacular white sandy beach around down south of Kovalam, and has a slew of resorts and lodges, and offers a breathtaking view of the sunset from atop the nearby cliff.

name: Bethel
description: A good vegetarian restaurant in Kovalam. Friendly staff and comfortable, cozy, open-air seating with two levels. They serve delicious Keralan, and other Indian foods, as well as a medium selection of (equally tasty) Continental and Chinese cuisine. The owner (who cooks there) was a chef in an upscale veg restaurant in Varkala for 8 years.

name: Fusion restaurant
description: First floor restaurant on the beach front with beautiful ambiance and great food. Unique menu offers food from the East, the West and fusion of both. Great seafood. Good service. Super atmosphere. Highly recommended.

name: The German Bakery
description: Go for the date shake and the excellent banana pancake. A full range of baked goods are available too. Plus one of the best views in Kovalam! Easily the best and most popular place for breakfast on the main beach.

name: Hotel Sea Rock
description: Famous for their grilled sea food.

name: Spice village Restaurant
description: Near the Lighthouse Beach with traditional Kerala cuisine and European dishes as well as continental with fresh vegetables and fishes updated

name: Suprabatham
description: One of the best vegetarian restaurants in Kovalam. Friendly waiters.

name: Devi Beach Resort
description: Opened December 2011 with basic large rooms which are spotless, ideal for those with difficulties using stairs the hotel has 5 ground floor rooms and 5 first floor rooms ideally situated for the beach and overlooking paddy fields each room has western style en-suite shower room and private balcony

name: Green Valley Cottages
description: Room service with good vegetarian restaurant right next door. Located next to the remnants of a former rice paddy field just off the beach.

name: Hotel Sea Breeze
description: From ₹600

name: Hotel Sea View Palace
description: The hotel is established in 1994 and is located right on the beach front with beautiful view of the beach and the Light house offering clean and cosy rooms with homely ambiance.

name: Hotel Shirleys Beach
description: A family run place. The rooms are spotless and well managed.They also conduct fixed departure tours which are so cheap and they also run their houseboat company in alleppey.its all under one roof!

name: Muringa Vila
description: A small family run guest house with stylish apartments (some with kitchen) and the Little Shanti Coffee Shop, serving local and international foods on their sea- view terrace. Located at Kovalam's Main Beach (or Leela Beach) right behind the Ganesh Temple. All rooms with private bathrooms and sea facing balconies.

name: The Beach Hotel
description: Private veranda towards the sea.

name: The Beach Hotel II
price: Double non AC room ₹3,000, Double AC room ₹4,000

name: Pappukutty Beach Resort
description: It has 38 well furnished A/C Rooms with all modern amenities inside. It also has a beach facing restaurant, swimming pool.

name: Sea Face Hotel
description: Pool and balcony to the sea.

name: Hotel Samudra
description: A 3-star deluxe hotel

name: The Leela Kovalam
description: A 5-star hotel with a private beach. The Heritage wing houses the famous Halcyon castle, the honeymoon palace of Travancore Queens which costs almost thrice than other rooms. Almost all suites are sea facing, as sea surrounds all the three sides of the property.

name: Taj Green Cove Resort & Spa
description: The property is spread across 10 acres of land, on the northernmost beach of Kovalam, offering a breathtaking view of the backwater, lush landscapes, coconut palms, and unspoilt beaches.

name: Travancore Heritage
description: A seaside resort in Chowara near Kovalam. It is built with traditional Kerala style architecture in 15 acres of land, landscaped with coconut palms.

name: Turtle on the beach
description: A 4-star boutique luxury hotel. It is right next to Hawa Beach. The road to beach is a steep 300 m narrow stretch (used by cars as there is a car park at the end). Great view of the cliffs and beach from sea facing rooms.

name: Vivanta by Taj - Kovalam
description: A 5-star hotel in Kovalam, overlooking the Arabian Sea.

name: Somatheeram Ayurveda Village
description: Here you can experience Ayurvedic therapies, wellness packages and Yoga practices.

name: Amritapuri Asramam
description: A Hindu pilgrimage centre for worshipers of Mata Amritanandamayi Devi.

name: Prabrahma Temple
description: Very old temple.

name: Kettukazhcha
description: Visit during festival times which is March and April.

name: Thazhava
description: Of archaeological interest.

name: St. Jude Church
description: A famous religious place. This church's festival takes place at the last week of October every year. Sunday mass is 7:30AM.

name: KTDC Restaurant
description: Breakfast: ₹250, Lunch: ₹450

name: Achencoil
description: An important pilgrim center. Famous for its Sastha temple with a Sastha installed several centuries before the Christian Era.

name: Anchal
description: Known for its cattle market.

name: Kunnicode
description: Famous as Muslim pilgrim center.

name: Jetayu Para
description: Huge rock. Legend says Jatayu, the giant bird in the epic Ramayana, fell after failing in its attempt to stop Ravana from taking sita away. Ideal place for trekking.

name: Palaruvi Water Falls
description: One of the famous waterfall in Kerala.

name: Pattazhi
description: Famous for its ancient Bhagavathy temple.

name: Pathanapuram
description: An old trading center.

name: Suspension Bridge
description: Erected in 1877, is the only one of its kind in south India and it is 400 ft long.

name: Kulathupuzha
description: With forest range, well known for its ayyappa temple, templefish pond, elephants and reeds.

name: Varkala beach
